tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (a)༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas gshin po rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'a
(a)༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas gshin po rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'a

tei:div.tei:p: (a)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas gshin po rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga bzhugs so// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas gshin po rjes su 'dzin par 'dod na gnyis te/ sngon du bsnyen pa dang*/ las kyi rim pa'o// dang po ni/ dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsam/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥbarjod/ se gol gtogs/ thal mo sbyar la/ chos dbyings mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rjes rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bar// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don bsgrub lhur mdzad pa'i// bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ akṣo bhya sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i arghaṃ sogs dang*/ kun gyi mthar pra tītstsha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes sbyar la mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags byas la/ badzra muḥs tshogs rten gshegs su gsol la/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms te bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas shū n+ya tās dngos po thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgoms te/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas stong pa'i ngang las glang po ches bteg pa'i khri sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni sogs kyi sgra bar snang la grags par bsams la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gzungs kyi yi ge rnams kha dog dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ tshur 'dus sngags kyi yi ge la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog ind+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa sa gnon dang*/ g.yon pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang*/ dar gyi sham thabs can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu so gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsam/ de nas lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis sbyar ba'i tshigs dbus ma la mdzub mo gnyis rwa'i rnam par bya/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung gnyis rtse sprad pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya ste/ de nyid gnas gsum du gtugs la/ kaṃ ka ni lan gsum bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs te/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o// de nas snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags kyis spyan drang*/ mdun du padma dang zla ba'i steng du bcom ldan 'das kyi sku 'od zer dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de la sngar bzhin mchod/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab ste/ ye shes pa mdun du spyan drangs pa'o// de nas bdag dang mdun gyi sangs rgyas gnyis ka'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du/ kaṃ ka ni sngags g.yas skor du bkod/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi sangs rgyas kyi thugs kar phog pas/ de'i thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'od zer gyi tshul du byung nas bdag gi snying gar thim par bsams la/

na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni/ nas/ nañtsa swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas/ mthar mdun gyi lha la mchod par bsams la/ mchod bstod bya/ dngos grub blangs la/ oṃ badzra muḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ rang dam tshig pa rkyang pa'i nga rgyal gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngos la/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /de ltar thun bzhi'i rim pas gzungs khri'am 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na sangs rgyas kyi zhal ston pa dang*/ bris sku g.yo ba la sogs pa'i mtshan ma bzang po thob par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa las kyi rim pa la dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni logs su shes par bya la/ gshin po rjes su 'dzin pa'i don du nyin gcig pa'i cho ga bya ba la gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas khang byi dor byas la/ mi 'khrugs pa'i bris sku dgram/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma cha gsum bsham/ mdun du sbyangs stegs kyi steng du rus pa'am/ ming byang bzhag rang gi mdun du bum pa chu dang*/ nang rdzas kyis gang ba dang*/ rdo rje dril bu sogs 'og tu dgos pa thams cad 'tshog par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi/ bdag bskyed bya ba dang*/ bum pa bzlas pa/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa/ tshe 'das rjes su gzung ba dngos so// dang po ni/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun gyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba'i bar sngar ltar bya/ gnyis pa ni bum pa/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par bsgom pa'i ngang las/ pad zla'i steng du bhrūm̐ las bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par bskyed/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgya bya/ spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas de bum pa'i nang du byon pas/ bum nang gi padma dang zla ba'i steng du mi 'khrugs pa'i zhal phyag gsal btab/ de la mchod bstod byas la bum nang gi mi 'khrugs pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du gzungs kyi phreng ba bkod pa la dmigs te/

gzungs ci nus bzla/ mthar sngar ltar mchod bstod byas la/ dung chos kyi chu phul bas lha zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsis sdig pa 'khrud nges kyi nus pa can du gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa ni/ mdun gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ de'i nang du rdo rje'i gur/ gur gyi nang steng gi phyogs su rdo rje'i bla re/ rwa ba'i phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar gyur pa'i nang du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma sum cu so gnyis pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba gru bzhi pa'i steng du/ bhrūm̐ las gzhal yas khang rta babs dang bcas par bskyed/ nang gi phyogs mdog shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte ba seng ge'i khri dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de las gtso bo sngar bzhin bskyed/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du sham̐ las dpal be'u/ de las lha mo padma can/ sku mdog dkar mo phyag g.yas na dpal be'u bsnams pa/ mer tsam̐ las 'khor lo/ de las 'jigs byed ma dkar mo g.yas na 'khor lo bsnams pa/ lhor pam̐ las padma/ de las 'od ldan ma dmar skya/ g.yas na padma bsnams pa/ srin por dham̐ las rgyal mtshan/ de las rnal 'byor ma sngon mo g.yas na rgyal mtshan bsnams pa/ nub tu tsham̐ las gdugs/ de las mdangs ldan ma sngon mo g.yas na gdugs 'dzin pa/ rlung du kam̐ las bum pa/ de las dkar sham ma dmar skya g.yas na bum pa 'dzin pa/ drug po 'di dag gi phyag g.yon pa khu tshur dkur 'dzin pa/

byang du shaṃ las dung*/ de las dri med ma ljang gu g.yon pas dung thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yas pa gung mdzub sbyar nas dung gi steng du 'jog pa/ dbang ldan du mam̐ las gser nya/ de las yid gzhungs ma ser mo// g.yon pas nya'i mgo dang*/ g.yas pas mjug ma 'dzin pa/ lha mo brgyad po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ 'dzum zhing yid du 'ong ba'i rnam pa can/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs kyis mdzes pa/ zla ba'i gdan dang zla ba'i rgyab brten can/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro bar bsam mo// de nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ brjod pas/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsams te/ dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'o// lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs bkod de/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa'o// rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs par bsams la/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta akṣo bhya/ e hye hi zhes pas spyan drangs/ bsdu na des chog spro na sngar gyi dad pa sogs kyi tshab tu/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi sogs/ spyan 'dren/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs bsal ba/ byon legs/ gdan dbul sogs bya/ de ltar spyan drangs pa'i bcom ldan 'das lha dgu po gzhal yas khang gi nam mkha' la bzhugs par bsams la/ mchod pa bsdus pas mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta udbha wā ya swā hā/ zhes pas lha thams cad mnyes par bsams te/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'o// de nas dam tshig pa dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis ka la sngar bzhin dmigs la gtso bo la gzungs ci nus bzlas/

'khor rnams la/ oṃ maṅga la shri ye swā hā/ oṃ maṅga la tsakra swā hā/ oṃ maṅga la padma swā hā/ oṃ maṅga la dhwa dza swā hā/ oṃ maṅga la tsha traṃ ka swā hā/ oṃ maṅga la ka la sha swā hā/ oṃ maṅga la shaṃ kha swā hā/ oṃ maṅga la ma ka ra swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas la/ dkyil 'khor brtan bzhugs byas te/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa'o// de nas mchod pa'i phyir bdag nyid gtso bo las cha gcig chad nas shar sgor gnas par bsams la/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ 'dod yon lnga rnams dbul/ bsdu na nyer spyod tsam gyis rung*/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bstod pa rgyas pa'am/ de tsam mi nus na/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo'am/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs bya ste/ mchod bstod bya ba'o// de nas gtor ma cha gsum gtang*/ bzhi pa rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga ni/ sngar bzlas pa byed pa'i skabs rnams su yungs kar ram bye ma la sngags kyi nus pa bsdu/ de nas rten de stong par bsgom pa'i ngang las zla ba'i steng du tshe 'das bskyed/ snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rnam shes a thung gi rnam par bkug la bstim/ de nas bum chus gtor ba'am/ me long gi ngos la shar ba la bkru zhing gzungs kyi rjes la che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru zhes brjod cing bkru/ yang ming ngam rus pa la yungs kar ram/ bye mas brab cing gzungs bzlas/ de nas sdig bshags dang skyabs 'gro bya/ sems bskyed dpog go /mthar tshe 'das kyi shes pa a thung gi rnam pa can/ mi 'khrugs pa'i thugs kar thim par bsam mo// gsum pa rjes ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod/ nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gtso bo la bsdu/ gtso bo rang la thim par bsams la bsngo ba dang smon lam gdab/

bkra shis bya'o// slob ma la dbang bskur byed na/ sa chog spyi dang mthun par byas pa'i gnas su/ sta gon bya ba la bzhi ste/ dang po sa'i lha mo'i sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su maṇḍal la me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ de bam̐ las sa'i lha mo bskyed pa la/ mchod pa dang gtor ma dbul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ gnang ba byin te de nyid du thim par bsam mo// gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ maṇḍal dri'i chus byug der me tog gi tshom bu dgu bkod pa cho ga gsum gyis lhar bskyed pa nas mchod bstod kyi bar dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs ltar bya/ mi 'khrugs rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod// sogs kyis snyan gsan dbab bo// gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ bshad zin to// bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma khrus bya ste 'khod la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir dkyil 'khor der zhugs la dbang blang snyam pa gyis shig ces brjod la/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// zhes sogs kyis myang 'das kyi bsam pa bskyed/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas/ zhes sogs kyis rna gtad/ dga' chen sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ sku gsung thugs byin brlab/ de la mchod/ so shing*/ khyor chu/ srung skud/ ku sha chos bshad pa/ rmi lam brtag pa rnams bya/ rjes la dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod byas nas nam mkhar bteg la/ las kyi rjes bsdu'o// dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/ sta gon byas pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor sgo rkyang*/ phyi padma'i khor yug rdo ra/ me ri/ nang padma 'dab brgyad dang bcas pa'i las thig spyi dang mthun par gdab/ der rdul tshon lnga dang*/ kha dog lnga'i thig skud bzhag pa bsang sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las thig skud dang*/ rdul tshon sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa nas/ thig skud dang rdul tshon ljang gu/ aḥlas don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i bar du bskyed/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu dang*/ rdul tshon bkug nas thim par bsams la/ mchod pa dang bstod pa dbul/ rigs lnga zhu ba'i ye shes kyi thig tshon du gyur par bsam/ kaṃ ka ni zlos shing thig skud bsgril/ tshon byin gyis brlabs pa'o// de nas slob dpon mi 'khrugs pa dang*/ slob ma bkra shis kyi lha mo'i nga rgyal gyis ye shes kyi thig gdab/ dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bri/ dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun par bris pa'i dbus su rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la bkra shis kyi rtags brgyad bri/ mchod pa sna tshogs kyis dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor/ de nas dkyil 'khor sgrub pa nas/ gtor ma'i bar sngar ltar byas la/ rang gis bdag 'jug blang ngo*// de nas sngar sta gon byas pa'i slob ma rnams la dbang bskur te/ phyag dang maṇḍal phul nas/ dga' chen sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ rgyun bshags bya/ gdong g.yogs/ me tog gi phreng ba sbyin/ bgegs bskrad la/ kye dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin// zhes dri/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags// zhes lan gdab/ slob ma'i snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ de'i steng du/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje bzhag la/ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ sogs kyis brtan par bya/ mgor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod zhes sogs kyis gsang ba gdams/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis yol ba'i nang du khrid par bsams te/ phyi 'jug gi cho ga'o// de nas slob mas slob dpon la gsol ba gdab/ cho ga gsum gyis mi 'khrugs par bskyed pa'i thugs kar zla ba la a dmar po bsam/

de'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes a yig dmar po dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ slob ma'i snying gar thim par bsams la/ gzungs zlos shing rol mos dbab/ tiṣṭha badzra dang*/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag pas brtan par bya'o// de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la/ yang dag dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ nam mkha'i kha dog dri/ me tog dor/ de mgo la bzhag mig phye/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa rnams bya ste/ 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// de nas dbang gi don du maṇḍal dbul/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su/ dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ slob ma cho ga gsum gyis mi 'khrugs par bskyed/ dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur bar bsams la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ gzungs kyi gsham du/ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa btags te dbang bskur bas slob ma'i rgyud la yod pa'i sgrib pa thams cad dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi 'khrugs par gyur par bsams la/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag cing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta utabha wā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod de dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o// de nas sdig pa bkru ba'i ched du lha thams cad kyis bum pa'am/ med na sngar gyi bum pas khrus bya zhing*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang*/ oṃ maṅga la shri ye/ che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du/ ji ltar bltams pa dang*/ maṅga la tsakra/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i sogs dang*/ maṅga la padma/ zhes sogs nas/ 'di ni shes rab sogs dang*/ oṃ maṅga la ma ka ra che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru zhes brjod cing bkru/ de nas rma bya'i sgros sdig pa rnams byabs par bsams la/ gzungs kyi mthar che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa na ya swā hā/

zhes byab/ de nas gnas gsum du rdo rjes reg cing*/ gzungs kyi mthar sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad las rakṣa zhes brjod pas bsrungs la/ me long nas yungs kar gyi bar bkra shis rdzas brgyad sbyin/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod de/ dbang gi mtha' rten no// de nas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyis dam tshig bsdus te gzung*/ yon dbul lo// bla mas dkyil 'khor mchod bstod/ rdul tshon gyi lha gshegs/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba sogs spyi dang 'dra bar bya'o// shu bhaṃ// //

༄༅// dri med gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bsgom bzlas bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo buddha ya/ gtsug tor dri med kyi gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa byed par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ rang skad cig gis rnam snang du gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsams la/ gtsug tor chen po'i rigs kyi bdag /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa// rnam snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal zhing*// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud// ces pas phyag bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod yon/ de bzhin du me tog nas/ sil snyan gyi bar sngags bsgyur la dbul/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs kyis rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ oṃ badzra muḥ gshegs su gsol/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms te bsod nams kyi tshogs so// de nas swa bhā was stong par bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs te sngon 'gro'o// stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma so gnyis pa'i lte bar ram̐ las nyi ma de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ rwa ba dang*/ gur dang*/ bla re dang*/ me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor du gyur/ de'i nang du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar/ bhrūm̐ las skyes pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin/ sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du/ pha gu dang*/

drwa phyed dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ pu shus mdzes pa/ steng thog rim par phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis spras pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ lha snam cha chen gcig shar sngo lho ser nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i dbus su/ ling tshe dgu phyogs kyi mdog can rdo rje phreng bas zlum por bskor ba'i dbus kyi re mig dkar po'i dbus su seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che/ lhor rta/ nub tu rma bya/ byang du nam mkha' lding gi khri bsam/ dbus kyi khri'i steng du padma dang zla ba la/ oṃ las rang nyid skad cig gis rnam par snang mdzad dkar po zhal gcig phyag brgyad dang po gnyis kyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya thugs kar mdzad pa/ gnyis pas mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya/ gsum pas g.yas kyi 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon gyis 'khor los mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ bzhi pa gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes pa'o// de'i mdun du yum gyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse mo gsum pa gyen du langs pa/ g.yas su nyi ma/ rnam snang dmar po g.yas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ g.yon du zla ba/ rnam snang dkar po g.yas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'ang g.yon khu tshur dkur 'jog cing*/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa ldem bag gi tshul can/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa'o// shar gyi ling tshe la aṃ las mi bskyod pa sngon po/ g.yas sa gnon gyi phyag rgyas rdo rje/ g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ lhor baṃ las rin 'byung ser po/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas rin po che/ g.yon mnyam gzhag nub tu saṃ las 'od dpag med dmar po/ phyag gnyis ting 'dzin mchog gi phyag rgyas padma dmar po bsnams pa/ byang du dzam̐ las don grub ljang gu/ g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas sna tshogs rdo rje/

g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga ni rdo rje'i skyil krung can no// shar lhor lam̐ las spyan ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon mig 'bras 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu mam̐ las mā ma kī sngon mo/ g.yas rin po che/ g.yon rdo rje/ nub byang du pam̐ las gos dkar mo dmar mo/ g.yas g.yon gnyis kas padma/ byang shar du tām̐ las sgrol ma ljang gu/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon utpal bsnams pa'o// lha snam gyi shar lhor ram̐ las gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo/ g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon me long*/ lho nub tu sham̐ las sgra rdo rje ma ser mo/ g.yas rin po che/ g.yon pi wang*/ nub byang du gaṃ las dri rdo rje ma dmar mo/ g.yas padma/ g.yon dung chos/ byang shar du sam̐ las ro rdo rje ma ljang gu/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon ro'i snod bsnams pa/ lha mo brgyad ka'ang nu 'bur zung dang ldan pa sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams can no// shar gyi snam bu'i g.yas su maiṃ las byams pa/ g.yon du kṣiṃ las sa'i snying po gnyis ka'ang dkar po g.yas 'khor lo thugs kar 'dzin pa/ lho'i g.yas su khaṃ las nam mkha'i snying po/ g.yon du bam̐ las phyag na rdo rje/ gnyis ka ser po g.yas rin po che/ nub kyi g.yas su mam̐ las 'jam dbyangs/ g.yon du lam̐ las spyan ras gzigs/ gnyis ka dmar po g.yas padma/ byang gi g.yas su sam̐ las sgrib pa rnam sel/ g.yon du sam̐ las kun tu bzang po gnyis ka ljang gu/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ sems dpa' thams cad kyis g.yon khu tshur dkur brten pa/ lha mo dang byang sems thams cad sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o// shar sgor dzaḥlas rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po g.yas lcags kyu/ lho sgor hūm̐ las rdo rje zhags pa ser po g.yas zhags pa/ nub sgor bam̐ las rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar po g.yas lcags sgrog /byang sgor hoḥlas rdo rje 'bebs pa ljang gu g.yas dril bu 'dzin pa de rnams kyis g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad cing sbrul gyis brgyan pa/

zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs kyis mdzes par byas pa bsams te bsnyen pa'o// lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bkod de nye bar sgrub pa'o// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rnam snang chen po'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pa'i sngags rgya bya/ sngar bzhin mchod dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs rang dang dbyer med du bsams te sgrub pa'o// yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la mchod de/ mgon po thugs rje can rnams kyis// bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rgyal ba rnams kyi ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las de bzhin gshegs pa lnga la rin po che'i cod paṇa dang*/ shar dang shar lho pa rnams la rnam snang*/ lho dang lho nub pa rnams la rin 'byung*/ nub dang nub byang pa la 'od dpag med/ byang dang byang shar ba la don grub kyis dbur brgyan par bsams te sgrub chen no// de nas 'og nas 'byung ba ltar mchod bstod byas la/ gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po/ de'i mthar bzla bya'i gsang sngags g.yas skor du 'khod par bsams la/ de klog pa'i tshul du bya zhing*/ na ma st+ri ya dhwi kā nāṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya garbhe dzwa la dzwa la/ dharmā dhā tu garbhe/ saṃ ha ra ma ma ā yuḥ saṃ sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa manta uṣṇī ṣa bi ma le/

bi shuddhe/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ am̐ bam̐ sam̐ dzam̐ swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas/ mthar mchod pa rnams yo ga ltar bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ so so'i tshigs bcad dang sngags kyis dbul/ snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings sogs kyis rigs lnga'i bstod pas bstod la/ oṃ badzra muḥs bsgoms pa'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor rnams rang rnam snang 'ba' zhig la bsdus la/ bdag rnam snang gi nga rgyal gyis cho ga'i bya ba'am/ spyod lam la 'jug go /gtsug tor dri med gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sgrub thabs 'di rgyud sde'i dbang phyug mkhas grub khyung po lhas pas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi zhabs tog tu dmigs nas drin chen bla ma dam pa'i zhal las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bdag bsod nams rin chen gyis rje nyid kyi spyan sngar su bris su bkod pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// // ༄// 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dge legs kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dge legs kun 'byung zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis mkhyen brtse ye shes nyi 'od kyis// las nyon srid pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas// rnam grol thar pa'i snang ba rgyas mdzad pa// thub dbang 'gro ba'i mgon la gus phyag 'tshal// bde gshegs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// 'gro ba'i 'chi bdag bar chad kun zhi zhing*// spyin bdag bsod nams rgyas par bya phyir du// 'od zer dri med cho ga bshad kyis nyon// 'dir rigs gsum spyi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pas/ bya ba'i rgyud spyi dang*/ bye brag la mkhas pa'i sgrub pa pos/ 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi gzungs las bshad pa'i/

gzungs kyi cho ga nyams su blang bar bya ba la gnyis te/ sngon du bsnyen pa dang*/ las kyi rim pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ rnal 'byor dang bcas pa'i bzlas brjod dang*/ dus rgyun gyi bzlas brjod do// dang po ni/ khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/ gnas dben par sangs rgyas kyi rten gyi spyan sngar/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma gsum bshams la/ yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas/ gso sbyong rang gis blang ba'i cho gas/ nyin zhag gi mtha' can gyi gso sbyong la gnas par bya'o// de nas stan la 'dug ste/ mchod rdzas rnams la/ oṃ a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bgegs bsal/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ rin po che'i snod du mchod rdzas rnams so sor bskyed la/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs bzla zhing*/ rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya'o// de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ khams gsum gyi sems can sdug bsngal drag pos gzir ba rnams/ byang chub mchog gi go 'phang la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis/ 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi cho ga la 'jug par bya'o// snyam pa'i kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad ni rang gi sems las byed pa po gzhan med pas sems kyang don dam par spros pa thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu bdag med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsgom pa ni/ don dam byang chub kyi sems so// de nas stong pa'i ngang las rang gi lus/ sgyu ma lta bur gyur pa'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i dbus su/ dzi na dzika ces pa'i gsang sngags kha dog ser po/ 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ 'od zer des sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/

snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la thim pas/ rang gi sems nyid gsang sngags kyi yi ge'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ lag pa gnyis thal mo bkan pa las/ mdzub mo gnyis cung zad bkug pa/ snying ga mgrin pa/ smin mtshams/ dpung mgo gnyis rnams su bzhag la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta udbha we swā hā/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab bo// 'di ni bdag gi bya ba ste/ rgyud sde gzhan gyi lugs kyi bdag bskyed kyi dod yin no// de nas mdun du pam̐ las padma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po kha gyes pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de zhu ba las 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug tu rdo rje'i rwa ba gru bzhi pa/ steng gi phyogs su bla re/ phyi rol ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga pas bskor ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma sum cu so gnyis pa'i lte bar/ am̐ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ pam̐ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu/ de'i steng du bhrūm̐ las gzhal yas khang pa/ gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin/ sngo ljang ser dmar dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rtsig pa'i steng na rin po che'i pha gu ser po dang*/ steng gi bya 'dab las drwa ba dang*/ drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing*/ mda' yab dang*/ pu shu dang*/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo du mas mchod pa byed bzhin pas bskor ba/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i/ rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i dbus su chos kyi 'khor lo/ de'i steng du gdugs/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan du mas mdzes par byas pa/ gzhal yas khang pa'i nang gi lha snam/ shar dmar/ lho ser/ nub ljang*/ dbus dkar po/ byang nag po ste/ steng phyogs ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i gdung gis rim par phub pa'i rtse mor/

rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang par gyur par bsam mo// de nas mdun du dung chos su dri bzangs dang bcas pa'i chu la me tog dkar po blugs pa'i mchod yon dang*/ spos kyi reng bu/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye bas bzung la/ mthe bong gnyis g.yab cing*/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das// bdag gi mchod yon 'di bzhes nas// mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta e hye hi/ zhes brjod la/ mchod yon bzed zhal gyi nang du sbrengs/ grogs gzhan gyis rol mo ci nus pa byas la/ lha rnams spyan drang ngo*// de ltar spyan drangs pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams sems can gyi don la byon/ gzhal yas khang pa'i nang du so so'i gdan la bzhugs par bsams la/ dbus su seng ge'i khri sna tshogs padma dang*/ zla ba'i gdan la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pa/ sku mdog ser po zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis kyi chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ na bza' chos gos ngur smrig bsnams pa/ dbu'i gtsug tor la sogs pa'i mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ 'od zer gyi drwa bas mdzes par byas pa mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de'i g.yas su padma dang zla ba'i gdan la spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon padma dkar po thugs kar bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o// sangs rgyas kyi g.yon du padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po khro bo'i lus kyi nyams can/ g.yas rnga yab dang*/

g.yon rdo rje 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i mdun du khyab 'jug nag po mkha' lding la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na 'khor lo dang dung*/ g.yon gnyis na be con dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mdun du drag po dkar po khyu mchog la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ mgrin pa sngon po can/ g.yas rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon ral gri 'dzin pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdun du tshogs bdag sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ 'jig rten skyong ba gsum ka'ang lha'i gos dang rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa'o// phyi rol nub kyi lha snam gyi g.yas ngos su tshogs bdag dkar po/ glang po che'i gdong pa can zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas dgra st+wa dang*/ g.yon la phug 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ spyi bor mar me bzhag pas/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa la mchod pa 'bul ba/ gzhan yang gzhal yas khang gi nam mkha'i khams thams cad/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags kyi lha rab tu mang pos gang bar mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par bsams la/ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs kyis thugs dpag mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dbul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ gis khrus gsol bar bsam/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥ.oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi shwa dha nā ya swā hā/ zhes pas sku phyi'o// de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag 'bul/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wast+ra a laṃ ka ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas gos rgyan dbul/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta padma tsand+ra ā sa na tiṣṭhan tu swā hā/ zhes pas lha so so la gdan phul bar bsam mo// de nas 'og nas 'byung ba ltar lha so so'i sngags lan gsum gsum brjod cing phyag rgya bstan par bya ste/ de la lag pa gnyis phan tshun khu tshur bcangs nas/ mthe bong gnyis bsgreng ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyi'o// de nyid las/ mthe bong g.yas pa gcig tu bstan pa ni spyan ras gzigs kyi'o// lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo phan tshun bsdams pa las/ gung mo gnyis phyung ste brkyang ba rtse mo gcig tu byas pa rdo rje'i rtse mo 'dra ba byas pa phyag rdor gyi'o// thal mo khong stong sbyar nas mthe bong gnyis gshibs nas cung zad gtod pa khyab 'jug gi'o/ mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan sor mo gsum thur du brkyang pa drag po'i mdung rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya'o// lag pa gnyis bkan te mdzub mo dang srin lag rnams bsnol bar dkris la/ mthe bong gnyis lag pa'i nang du bcug nas/ sor mo lhag ma rnams ni thams cad kyang 'dra bar so so nas lag pa'i steng du gdu bu ltar bkug pa ni g.yung drung ris kyi'o// de ltar phyag rgya rnams bstan pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sgrub pa po'i don mdzad pa las mi 'da' bar bsam mo// de nas mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī shākya mu na ye sa pa ri wā ra/ sngon du 'gro bas/ arghaṃ gyis mchod yon/ pādyaṃ gis zhabs bsil/ prokṣa naṃ gis bsang gtor/ badzra puṣpes me tog dhū pes bdug spos/ ā lo kes mar me/ gandhes dri/ nai wi tes zhal zas/ shaptas rol mo/

sngags kun gyi mthar/ pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes sbyar la dbul/ de nas/ thabs mkhas thugs rje shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing*// zhes sogs kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa gang shes dang*/ sems can sdug bsngal me tshogs kyis gdungs la// zhes sogs spyan ras gzigs kyi dang*/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na// zhes sogs kyis phyag na rdo rje dang*/ sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru// chos bzhin sgrub par/ zhes sogs 'jig rten pa rnams la bstod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba gdab bo// de nas bzlas pa bya ba'i phyir/ bdag gi snying ga'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ bzlas bya'i gsang sngags bris pa ltar bkod la/ de las 'od zer byung sgrub pa po'i thugs kar zla ba la zhugs pas/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsams la/ na maḥsapta nāṃ/ samyaksaṃ buddha ko ṭī nāṃ/ pa ri shuddhe ma na si/ a bhyā ra rtsi ta/ pra tiṣṭha tā nā na/ na mo bha ga wa te/ a mi tā ā yu ṣa/ ta thā ga ta sya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shuddhe/ ā yur bi sho dha ne/ saṃ ha ra saṃ ha ra/ sarba ta thā ga ta bīrya ba le na pra ti saṃ ha ra/ ā yūḥsā ra sā ra/ sarba ta thā ga ta satwa sa ma ya/ bo dhi bo dhi/ bu dhya bu dhya/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ ma ma sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi shuddhe/ bi ga ta ma laṃ/ tsha ra su buddha buddhe/ hu ru hu ru swā hā/ zhes pa rtsa ba'i sngags dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mā la bi sho dha ni/ ru dha ba le/ pra ti saṃ skā ra/ ta thā ga ta dha tu dha re/ dha ra dha ra/ saṃ dha ra saṃ dha ra/ sarba ta thā ga ta a dheṣṭha na a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ zhes pa snying po'i sngags te bcom ldan 'das kyi'o// oṃ dzi dzi dzi naṃ/

ga dhi ya ti dhi ni swā hā/ zhes pa spyan ras gzigs kyi'o// na mo ratna tra yā ya sye/ na mashtsaṇḍa pā ṭi sye/ ma hā yakṣa se na pa ti sye/ na maḥtsaṇḍa pra ma ra dha nā ya swā hā/ hi ri mi ri dhi ri ṇi swā hā/ zhes pa phyag na rdo rje'i 'o// na mo badzra pā ṇi sye/ oṃ lo la tsakra ya swā hā/ zhes pa khyab 'jug gi'o// oṃ pa shu pa ti ni la kan tha u ma tri ya swā hā/ zhes pa drag po'i 'o// na mo oṃ badzra pa ṇi sye/ oṃ bhra ma ra ti ni swā hā/ zhes pa tshogs bdag rnams kyi ste/ smra ba gzhan spangs nas ji tsam nus kyi bar du bzlas so// de nas sngar bzhin mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa rnams byas la/ spyan drangs pa'i phyag rgya las mthe bong phyir bkyed la/ gshegs su gsol ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs dang*/ dzi na dzika gatstsha/ zhes brjod pas lha rnams gshegs su gsol/ gzhal yas khang mi dmigs par bsam/ rang gi snying ga'i gsang sngags zla ba la bsdu/ zla ba rnam smin gyi lus la bsdus la/ sgyu ma lta bu'i blos/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas su bsngos/ thun mtshams su gtor ma rnams cha gsum gyi cho ga ltar gtong ngo*// de ltar thun bzhi'i rim pas sdig pa dag pa'i mtshan ma ma byung gi bar ram zla ba gsum mam/ zhag bdun gyi bar du nyams su blangs na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis mkhyen cing gzigs te byin gyis rlob pa mdzad par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa dus rgyun gyi bzlas brjod ni/ nang re bzhin khrus dang gtsang sbra dang skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dmigs la/ de rnams kyi gtsug tor nas 'od zer byung*/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ 'od zer slar 'dus te rgyal ba rnams kyi gtsug tor du thim pas rgyal ba rnams dgyes te/

ka la ping ka'i dbyangs lta bu'i sgras gsang sngags gsungs pa'i sgra'i rjes zlos bdag nyid kyis byed par bsgoms la/ rtsa ba'i sngags tshar re re ma chags par 'don/ mthar dge ba bsngo ba sogs byas na/ longs spyod dang bde ba mi zad par thob par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa las kyi rim pa la gnyis las spyi'i cho ga dang so so'i las kyi cho ga'o// dang po gang du maṇḍal bris pa'i sar/ mchod pa lnga dang*/ gtor ma gsum dang*/ 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'tshogs par bya/ rang rdo rje dril bu bzung nas/ kha nub tu phyogs te gso sbyong blang ba dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba nas brtsams te/ lha gshegs su gsol ba'i bar bsnyen pa ci lta bar bya/ de nas sa blang ba'i phyir/ gtor ma dang po phyogs skyong la phul la dkyil 'khor kyi sa phyogs 'di bdag cag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa 'byung po spyi la phul la/ sngar bzhin sa blangs/ gsum pa gnod 'tshe byed pa'i bgegs la byin la/ phyi rol du bskrad cing*/ tshar bcad par bsams te/ cha gsum gyi gtor ma ltar ro// de nas sa sbyang ba'i phyir/ sa stegs byed dgos na/ khru gsum gyi tshad du sa stegs dang zha la bya/ de dag mi dgos na/ las thams cad pa zlos shing dri bzangs kyi chus khru gsum gru bzhir byugs la byi dor bya/ der rdo rje bsdams pa brkyang ba bzhag ste/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan lnga brjod pas sa phyogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam/ oṃ bhū khaṃ zhes brjod cing lag pa gnyis sa la reg pas sa'i nyes skyon thams cad dag nas/ sa phyogs nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams te/ sa'i cho ga'o// de nas nyi ma gnyis pa'am/ de nyid kyi dgongs thun la'ang rung ste/ sa chog byas pa'i gnas der/ dkyil 'khor du bya ba dang*/ maṇḍal du bya ba'i lugs gnyis las/ dang po ltar na/ sta gon byed dgos pas/ de'i sngon du dkyil 'khor sgo rkyang cha chen bcu drug gi thig gdab/

rtsig pa'i nang cha chen brgyad la/ dbus kyi sa gzhir cha chen bzhi gru bzhir gdab/ de'i phyi cha chen gcig lha snam/ de'i phyi'ang cha chen gcig mchod pa'i snam bu bya/ phyi'i thig rnams spyi dang mthun pa gdab/ lha'i gnas rnams su/ me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ lugs 'di la bum pa dkyil 'khor gyi grwar mi shong bas/ bum pa dang mchod rdzas rnams dkyil 'khor gyi mthar bsham/ de nas bdag gi bya ba sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun gyi tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsang zhing sbyangs te/ gzhal yas khang du bskyed/ lha so so'i sngags lan bdun bdun bzlas pas/ me tog gi tshom bu de gzhi dang gdan du grub par bsam/ de nas lha spyan drangs pa'i cho gas spyan drangs te/ so so'i gdan gyi steng du bkod/ zhal phyag rnams gsal gdab/ de la mchod yon dang gdan phul la/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan pa rnams bsnyen pa bzhin bya/ bzlas pa mi mdzad/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// zhes sogs kyis tshigs bcad dang sbyar la rgyas par dbul/ bstod pa dang gsol gdab sngar bzhin bya/ de nas g.yas spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dang*/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas/ shākya seng ge bcom ldan 'das// rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag ni snying brtser gyur nas su// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal// bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la// de bas gnang ba mdzad pa'i rigs// sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang*// byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang*// gsang sngags lha gzhan gang lags dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*// gang yang 'byung po mthu bo che// gang su lha yi spyan mnga' ba'i// sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yi// sang ni dkyil 'khor bzang po'i ming*// 'od zer dri med ci nus kyis// cho ga bzhin du bri lags na// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su// tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod la/

snyan gsan dbab/ de nas gtor ma cha gsum btang*/ slar yang tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod bya/ nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ lha rnams gshegs su gsol te/ lha sta gon no// dbang bskur ba'i bum pa dang*/ slob ma sta gon ni dbang mi bskur bas mi dgos so// de nas thig skud gsar pa kha dog lnga pa/ las thams cad pa'i sngags zlos shing so sor bsgril/ de nas gcig tu bsgril la/ gtso bo'i sngags lan bdun bzlas pas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi thig skud du gyur par bsams la/ mdun du dkon mchog gsum dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha bzhugs par mos la/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// zhes sogs kyis phyag byas nas/ shar du thig skud bsdogs te bzung*/ de nas lhor phyin la/ kha byang du bltas/ sgrub pa'i grogs mchog byang du 'dug ste/ kha lhor bltas pa'i lag tu thig skud gtad de/ de nas g.yas skor gyis shar du song ste/ nub tu bltas la tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de nas lhor song ste byang du bltas nas gnyis pa gdab/ de nas mer song ste byang du bltas la shar gyi rtsa thig dang*/ de nyid du 'dug ste nub tu bltas pas lho'i rtsa thig dang*/ rlung du 'dug ste lhor bltas pas nub kyi rtsa thig dang*/ de nyid 'dug nas shar du bltas nas byang gi rtsa thig dang*/ mer 'dug ste rlung du bltas la zur thig dang*/ bden bral du 'dug ste dbang ldan du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa btab la/ oṃ badzra sū tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ sa gzhi dang bar snang gnyis ka la gdab bo// de nas rdul tshon kha dog lnga pa mdun du bzhag pa bsang zhing sbyangs la/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du bsgoms la/ las thams cad pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis dbang ldan nas re khā lnga nang nas rim pa bzhin/ dkar dmar ser ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa lnga g.yas bskor du sgo tshad gcig gi bar bris la/

rin po che'i snod kyis bkab phyis sbrel ran pa dang*/ snod blangs te mtshan ma brtag cir sbrel lo// de la dbus kyi sa gzhi gru bzhi pa dkar po/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub ljang*/ byang nag po'o// gzhan rnams me ris bar spyi dang mthun par bri/ dbus su gdan ser po gru bzhi pa'i steng du pad zla la 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa 'od zer 'phro bas bskor ba/ mgo shar du bstan pa bri/ de'i g.yas su gdan zlum po la pad zla'i steng du sdong bu dang bcas pa'i padma dkar po/ g.yon du khri zlum po la pad zla'i steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse mo gsum pa/ de'i mdun nub phyogs su gdan zlum po la dung dkar po/ dbus kyi 'khor lo'i mdun du zlum po la mdung rtse gsum pa/ de'i g.yon du g.yung drung ris bris te/ rig pa mchog las g.yung drung ris ni dkyil 'khor gru bzhi lam pa gnyis rim du bris te/ ngos bzhi nas shad bzhi drangs la tshigs bcad de/ g.yas phyogs su 'khyil pa bri'o// shad bzhi po dag kyang rin po che'i phreng bas bskor bar bya'o// zhes pa ltar ro// lha snam phyi ma'i zur bzhir/ sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad re/ nub kyi snam bu'i byang ngos su tshogs bdag gi gzugs spyi bor mar me dang bcas pa bri/ de ltar bris pa rdzogs pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' dri bzangs po'i chus byug mchod pa ci 'byor bas mtha' bskor/ rgyal mtshan brgyad phyogs mtshams brgyad du btsugs/ grwa bzhir bum pa dang*/ phyogs bzhir mchod pa rnams 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin du bshams la/ sgrub mchod sogs cho ga la 'jug go /maṇḍal du bya ba ltar na/ sa stegs kyi dbus su khru do gru bzhir tshangs zur dang bcas pa'i thig gdab la/ tshangs thig gi g.yas g.yon phyed mar byas pas re mig bzhir 'gyur/ de'i nang ma'ang phyed du byas la/ dbus kyi sa gzhi gru bzhi pa dkar po la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gnyis kyi mtshan ma dgod/

de'i phyir lha snam phyogs mdog la 'jig rten skyong ba gsum gyi mtshan ma dgod do// de nyis 'gyur gyi lha snam phyi ma phyogs mdog tu byas pa'i grwa bzhir padma 'dab brgyad/ de dag gi steng du spos chus bkang ba'i bum pa dkar po mgul chings kha rgyan dang bcas pa bzhi bzhag shar gyi mchod snam steng du/ du ba 'thul bzhin pa'i rin po che'i spos snod gsum/ lho'i snam bu la zas bzang dgu sna tshogs pa dang*/ dkar gsum dang*/ 'bras chan sbyar ba dgod do// nub kyi snam bu la dri chus gang ba'i dung chos dang*/ me tog sna tshogs dang*/ 'bras bu sna tshogs kyi snod bzhag byang gi snam bu la gtor ma dang*/ dri chus gang ba'i bum pa'am/ rin po che'i snod dri bzangs kyis bkang ba bzhag nub byang gi grwar tshogs bdag dkar po glang sna can/ g.yas dgra st+wa/ g.yon la phug 'dzin pa/ bris la de'i spyi bo'i steng du mchod pa'i mar me bzhag go /de ltar maṇḍal gru bzhir bris pa'i mtha' skor du/ sngar ltar mchod pa dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ gtor ma cha gsum yang bsham mo// de lugs gnyis las maṇḍal rkyang par byed pa 'di gzungs kyi dgongs par snang ngo*// de nas maṇḍal gyi mdun du 'dug la/ gso sbyong blang ba nas/ bdag gi bya ba'i bar bya/ mdun gyi rdul tshon/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs nas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i bar sngar bzhin bya/ de nas maṇḍal gyi mdun du dngul la sogs pa'i snod bzhag la/ der rang ngam/ sgrub grogs kyis lha re re bzhin mchod yon sbrengs pas spyan drangs te/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig sogs dang*/ shākya mu ne e hye hi zhes pas sangs rgyas dang*/ arya a wa lo ki te shwa ra e hye hi zhes pas spyan ras gzigs dang*/ badzra pā ṇi e hye hi zhes pas phyag rdor dang*/ biṣṇus khyab 'jug dang*/ ru dras drag po/ ga ṇa pa ti e hye hi zhes pas tshogs bdag rnams spyan drang*/

so so'i gdan gyi steng du lha rnams bskyed/ de la byon legs nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan pa'i bar sngar ltar bya/ mchod pa'i skabs su/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// zhes pa'i tshigs bcad dang sbyar la/ rgyas par dbul/ gtso bo la bzlas pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ gzhan rnams la ci nus pa byas pa'i rjes su/ dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lha la brtan bzhugs bya/ de nas mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ sngags dang tshigs bcad dang bcas pa'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa rgyas par dbul/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos// zhes sogs kyis na bza' dang*/ rin chen sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga/ bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi mchod pa rnams spyi dang mthun pa bya/ bstod pa dang*/ gsol ba btab pa sngar bzhin byas pa'i rjes la/ lha rnams kyi gtor ma rnams sbyangs nas/ las thams cad pas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar/ khaṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhal zas/ kha dog dri ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa/ 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bltas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī shākya mu na ye/ lo ke shwa ra/ badzra pā ṇi/ sa pa ri wā ra/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo// zhes sogs gsum mam/ bdun gyi mthar/ mchod bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo// de nas gnas de nyid dam/ phyi rol du gtor ma cha gsum btang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi cho ga ste 'og nas 'byung ba'i las thams cad pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'o// gnyis pa so so'i las la gnyis/ gshin po la phan gdags pa'i cho ga dang*/

tshogs bsags shing sdig pa sbyang ba'i cho ga'o// dang po la gnyis/ bzlas brjod byas te sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ mchod rten byas te sdig pa sbyang ba'o// dang po ni/ sgrub mchod yan sngar bzhin tshar ba'i rjes la/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs su tshe 'das kyi rus pa'am/ ming byang bzhag la/ mdun bskyed kyi lha la/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pas/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ngan 'gro'i lam bcad du gsol/ mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du khrid par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tor nas/ 'od zer can gyi snang ba chen po byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ slar 'dus nas mdun gyi rus pa'am ming la thim pas/ de'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs par bsams la/ gtso bo rkyang pa'i rtsa gsang sngags lan bdun cu rtsa bdun du bzlas so// yang bzlas pa ci nus byas la/ bye ma'am yungs kar la bsngags te/ rus bu la gsang sngags bzlas shing brab bo// de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod pa rgyas par 'bul ba nas/ bkra shis kyi bar dang*/ 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin du byas na/ tshe 'das ngan song du lhung ba yang*/ de'i mod la mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa mchod rten la brten te sdig pa sbyong ba ni/ mchod rten 'bum phrag la sogs pa cho ga bzhin btab pa'i nang du/ 'di'i gsang sngags bris pa bcug ste/ rab gnas tshul bzhin du byas la gnas dben par bzhag pa'am/ yang na mchod rten chen po byas la/ der sngar gyi mchod rten rnams re re nas dbu zhabs ma log par bkur sti dang bcas te bzhugs su bcug srog shing brtan pa'i cho ga 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin dang*/

rab gnas byas na/ tshe 'das de dag dga' ldan du skye bar 'gyur zhing*/ mchod rten de la phyag dang bskor ba byas pa'i gang zag kyang byang chub kyi lam las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba nas/ gsang sngags gzhan gyi bcad pa dang*/ mnan par mi nus pa'i bar gyi phan yon thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro// //gnyis pa tshogs bsags shing sdig pa sbyang ba'i cho ga la gsum/ rang ngam gzhan gyi 'chi ba bslu ba'i cho ga mchod rten gyi srog shing 'dzugs pa'i cho ga pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i cho ga'o// dang po ni/ cho ga mi byed pa'i nyi ma 'ga' zhig gi gong du/ ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten la bskor ba lan bdun cu rtsa bdun bya/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa sngags lan bdun cu rtsa bdun bzlas/ mchod rten bdun cu rtsa bdun cho ga bzhin btab pa'i nang du/ 'di'i rtsa sngags gser ram/ ma 'byor na gi wang ngam/ snag tshas bdun cu rtsa bdun bris la bcug rab tu gnas pa tshul bzhin du byas/ de nas mchod rten rnams dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du bkur sti dang bcas te bsham/ sngar ltar dkyil 'khor mchod pa yan chad tshar ba dang*/ grwa'i bum pa bzhi bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ baṃ las rin po che'i bum pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang bar bsam/ mdun gyi de bzhin gshegs pa gtso 'khor gsum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas de rnams kyi sdug bsngal dang sdig pa rnams zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod/ de thams cad las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun lta bu byung nas/ bum nang gi chu la thim pas/ ye shes kyi chur gyur par bsams la/ rtsa sngags bdun cu rtsa bdun dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzlas la/

ye shes kyi chur bsams te bum bzlas so// de nas bsgrub bya khrus bya/ gos gsar pa gyon/ ku sha'i stan la/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs nas phyag 'tshal du bcug la bzhag mdun du ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang*/ khyad par zhal zas mang du bsham/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gus pa'i yid kyis/ slob dpon gyi rjes zlos bya zhing*/ phyag 'tshal du bcug ste/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas thog drangs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa lag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa/ khyab 'jug dang*/ drag po dang*/ tshogs bdag la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do bstan pa skyong du gsol/ zhes dang*/ ji snyed su dag zhes sogs kyis phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa'i skabs su mdun gyi mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ rgyas par dbul du gzhug de nas sdig pa bshags pa nas bsngo ba'i bar/ yan lag bdun pa tshang bar byas pa'i rjes la/ bsgrub bya pus mo btsugs thal mo sbyar/ lag tu bdug spos 'dzin du bcug la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mos gus byas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pas/ bdag gi dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ngan 'gro'i lam bcad du gsol/ gshin rje'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug

de nas mdun gyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bsgrub bya'i lus la phog pas/ gzhan srog bcad pa'i sgrib pa la sogs pa tshe thung ba'i rgyu dang*/ sdig pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing bkrus par bsams la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang*/ rtsa sngags bdun cu rtsa bdun zlos bzhin du/ lho nub kyi bum pa nas g.yas skor gyis blangs la/ 'thung zhing khrus byed du bcug de'i tshe slob dpon rkyang pas sngags bdun cu rtsa bdun 'don/ mi nus na/ sgrub grogs sam/ dge slong gtsang ma bzhis/ bsgrub bya'i mtha' skor du klog tu bcug la grangs tshang bar bya/ de ltar 'thung zhing khrus byas pas/ tshe thung ba'i rgyu sdig pa dang dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam/ yang mdun gyi sangs rgyas kyi thugs ka nas 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun 'o ma lta bu mang po byung ba/ bsgrub bya'i spyi bor thim pas tshe'i dngos grub thams cad thob par bsams la/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad 'don/ me tog gtor zhing rol mo bya'o// de nas dpon slob rnams thal mo sbyar te/ mdun du 'dug la gsol ba gdab ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dang*/ phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ 'phags pa chos skyong ba'i tshogs thams cad bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gis 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi gzungs nas 'byung ba'i cho ga bzhin/ de'i rtsa ba'i sngags bdun cu rtsa bdun bris te nang du bcug pa'i mchod rten bdun cu rtsa bdun btab te/ mchod cing mnga' gsol ba yang bgyi/ dkyil 'khor bris te 'phags pa'i tshogs dang chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang bcas pa rnams gdan drangs te/

mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba rnams kyis mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ gzungs sngags bzlas shing*/ 'byung po rnams gtor mas tshim par byas pa'i mthus/ che ge mo la sogs pa las dang nyon mongs pas mnar zhing*/ nad dang sdug bsngal gyis gtses nas dus ma yin par 'chi bas nyen te/ skyabs su song ba rnams la thugs brtse bar dgongs nas/ sngon gyi smon lam bzang po las blangs na ste/ che ge mo la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dang*/ gnod pa thams cad byang zhing*/ zhi ba dang*/ phan pa dang*/ bde ba bla na med pa'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab cing*/ ji ltar 'tshal ba bzhin du 'grub pa'i dngos grub dam pa stsal bar ci gnang*/ sngon bram ze ser skya'i zla ba la thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas/ dpal gyi mgur nas 'di skad du/ gang la la 'di'i cho ga byed par 'dod na/ tshes brgyad dang*/ bcu gsum dang*/ bcu bzhi dang*/ bco lnga rnams gang yang rung ba la mchod rten ring bsrel can la/ bdun cu rtsa bdun bskor la/ gsang sngags 'di lan bdun cu rtsa bdun bzlas brjod byas khrus byas la/ dkyil 'khor byas nas gsang sngags kyi yi ge bdun cu rtsa bdun bris te/ de'i gsang sngags 'don pa dang*/ yi ge 'dri ba yang khrus byas la gos gtsang ma gyon te/ lus spos kyis byugs nas/ zas gtsang ma zos la/ me tog dang bdug spos kyis mchod de/ de la rin po che sna bdun yang yon du phul lam/ yang na bdag gi nyams kyis ci 'byor pa phul yang rung ste/ sems mgu bar bya'o// chos btsun par bya ba'i phyir/ bsti stang dang rim gro cher bya'o// gsang sngags kyi yi ge la yang dkon zhing rin po cher 'du shes bzhag ste/ mchod rten che chung ji tsam nus pa bdun cu rtsa bdun gdab par bya zhing*/ de re re'i nang du gsang sngags bcug ste/ sems rtse gcig tu mchod pa chen po byas na/ tshe zad pa las tshe slar nur te tshe ring bar 'gyur ro// sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa/

tshe rabs grangs med pa'i sdig pa thams cad byang nas/ nam du sems can dmyal ba dang*/ dud 'gro dang*/ yi dwags kyi skye gnas thams cad du skye bar mi 'gyur ro// gang du skye ba'i gnas thams cad du sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran par 'gyur/ yid la bsam pa thams cad kyang de bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bdun cu rtsa bdun snyed la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur/ nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// gang la la zhig nad tshabs chen pos cher btab te/ 'chi ba'i dus byed pa la thug na/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi par byas la/ de'i steng du tshon sna lnga'i ri mor bris te/ dbus kyi char ni 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ dung dang*/ mdung rtse gsum pa dang*/ g.yung drung ris dang*/ padma rnams bri'o// grwa bzhir yang*/ padma re re bris te/ de'i steng du spos chu'i bkang ba'i bum pa re re grwa bzhir gzhag go /bdug spos kyi snod bkang ba spos sna tshogs 'thul ba yang gzhag go /kha dog sna lnga'i mdog tu kha zas sna tshogs dang*/ zas dkar gsum dang*/ 'bras chan du sbyar ba bzhag yang dri'i chu dang*/ me tog dang*/ 'bras sam/ 'bru'i snod phor bu re re blug pa dang*/ yang kha zas sna tshogs sbyar ba'i gtor ma spos chus bum pa gang dang sbyar te/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gzhag go /gtor ma de dang 'bras kyi drung du nye bar tshogs kyi bdag po'i gzugs bris la/ de'i spyi bo'i steng du mar me gzhag go /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs su nad pa bzhag la/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du kha bstan pa'i nad pa'i mdun du yang mchod pa'i bshos bzhag ste dbus su gzhug go /de nas sngags mkhan gtsang sbra cher byas te/ nad pa de la gsang sngags bdun cu rtsa bdun gyis btab te cho ga 'di ltar byas na/ nad pa tshe zad de 'chi ba'i dus byed du nye ba/ zhag bdun na dran pa nyams shing 'khrul par 'gyur ba yang*/

tshe slar nur zhing tshe ring por 'gyur ro// rmi lam gyi sdug bsngal yang myong bar mi 'gyur/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad/ che ge mo la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad la 'phral du 'grub par ci gnang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag par tshad mar gyur pas/ ji ltar bka' stsal pa bzhin du/ bden pa mngon sum du bstan pa ci gnang*/ zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje dang bcas pa'i spos chu dang*/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bsrungs la/ phyag 'tshal du bcug ste/ gnas gzhan du btang ngo*// de ltar byas na tshe zad pa yang*/ slar tshe 'phel te/ tshe shin tu ring bar 'gyur ro// de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod pa rgyas par dbul/ bstod pa bya/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa mang du brjod pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ mchod yon dbul/ lha rnams gshegs su gsol/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis rdul tshon phyags la/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor/ las kyi rjes rnams bsdus la/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod do// //gnyis pa srog shing 'dzugs pa'i cho ga ni/ mchod rten gyi bum gdan man chad grub tshar ba dang*/ de'i nye logs su sa'i cho ga nas/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi bar phal cher sngar dang 'dra bar bya/ 'on kyang sngar gyi grwa'i bum pa bzhi mi dgos pas/ de'i tshab tu dung chos dri bzangs kyis bkang ba re bzhag snam bu'i nub tu bkod pa'i mchod pa rnams lhor bkod/ til nag dang*/ ma sha dang*/ 'bras bsres nas btsos pa'i thug pa dang*/ dkar gsum gyis bkang ba'i snod dam bum pa dang*/ shing tog sna tshogs dang*/ a ru ra la sogs pa'i 'bras bu dgu bcu rtsa dgu nub tu dgod/ byang du sngar bshad pa'i rdzas dang*/ spos dang me tog sna tshogs dgod/ gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra bar bya'o// shing bzo ba dang*/ yi ge pa gso sbyong gi sdom pa la gnas pas/

tsandan la sogs pa shing bzang po la srog shing byas pa'i phyogs bzhir khung bu gru bzhi pa re btod la/ der gser dngul lam/ gi wang ngam/ ma 'byor na/ snag tshas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bi pu la yaṣṭi/ ma ṇi ka na ka rā dza/ bi bhū ṣi ta yaṣṭi/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sa manta bi lo ki te/ sa ra sa ra/ ma ma sarba pā paṃ/ be sho dha ni/ saṃ bo dha ni/ pra ba ra yaṣṭi/ ba ra ma ṇi dhwa dza ru tsi ra/ ma la bi shuddhe/ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dgu bcu rtsa dgu bris la gzhug gal te chung bas nang du mi shong na/ srog shing gi phyogs mtha' dag nas dkri/ der dar la sogs pa'i na bza' bzang pos dkri'o// 'od zer dri med kyi gzungs rdzogs pa bris la/ srog shing gi stod kyi char bcug snying po'i sngags srog shing gi rtsa ba dang*/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs bris la/ srog shing gi rtse mor bcug ba dan dang rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan la/ mchod rten gyi dbus su bcug la/ dge slong gtsang mas bzung ba'am/ srog shing shin tu che na/ srad bu mang du btags pa/ phyogs mtha' dag nas skyes bus 'then/ de la dar gyi lda ldi dang*/ me tog gi chun 'phyang mang du btags la bzung*/ mchod rten gyi phyogs bzhir mchod pa sna tshogs pa dang*/ 'phan gdugs dang*/ rol mo mang du bsham/ de nas gtor ma btang ba yan chad kyi sgrub mchod tshar ba dang*/ slob dpon sgrub grogs dang bcas pas snam sbyar gyon/ spos dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas shar phyogs du song la/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po brgyad/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po/ rgyal po chen po bzhi/ tshangs pa dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ khyab 'jug rnams 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// zhes sogs dbyangs dang bcas pa bya/ sangs rgyas rnams mdun du mngon du byon nas srog shing byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// de nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/

phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan la sogs pa shar phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// de bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan med pa'i dpal la sogs pa lho phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa= bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od 'phro la sogs pa nub phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa= bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba'i dbang po la sogs pa byang phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa= ting nge 'dzin gyi glang po dam pa'i dpal la sogs pa byang shar gyi= padmo dam pa'i dpal la sogs pa shar lho'i= nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba'i dpal la sogs pa lho nub kyi= gdugs dam pa'i dpal la sogs pa nub byang gi= padmo'i dpal la sogs pa 'og phyogs kyi= dga' ba'i dpal la sogs steng phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa= ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po brgyad la= gnod sbyin dbang po nor bu bzang po la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po brgyad la= 'phags pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma yul 'khor srungs la sogs pa rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ sred med kyi bu rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// bstan pa bsrung du gsol/ zhes dang*/ ji snyed su dag sogs kyis phyag bya/ mchod pa'i skabs su/ ci nus pa'i mchod pa dbul zhing*/ rol mo'i sgra dang*/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs bzlas/ de nas dkar gtor gsum bshams pa'i dang po/ sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/

oṃ aṣṭa ma hā yakṣa se na a dhi pa ta ye/ sa pa ri wā ra/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo/ zhes sogs kyis gnod sbyin dang*/ gnyis pa/ oṃ tsa ma ra ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes sogs kyis rgyal po bzhi dang*/ gsum pa/ oṃ brahma rṇa/ i shwa ra/ biṣṇu sa pa ri wā ra zhes sogs kyis tshangs pa la sogs la gtor ma dbul/ re re'i mthar yang*/ bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku'i rten 'di la/ mchod pa dang rim gror byed cing bsrung ba dang*/ srog shing brtan pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod do// de nas sdig bshags sogs yan lag bdun pa'i lhag ma rnams byas la/ oṃ bi pū la zhes sogs kyi sngags nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'don/ bdug spos rgyun mi chad du 'thul/ de'i tshe spyan drangs pa'i 'phags pa rnams srog shing la thim pas/ chos kyi skur byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ bzlas pa zin pa'i mthar/ srog shing la me tog gtor la/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang*/ gadgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'phags pa thams cad/ mchod rten gyi srog shing 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas/ mchod rten chos kyi skur byin gyis brlab cing ring bsrel dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum du brjod/ de nas thal mo sbyar la/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad dang*/ khyad par dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po brgyad dang*/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi dang*/ tshangs pa dang dbang phyug dang*/ sred med kyi bu la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gis 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi gzungs las 'byung ba'i cho ga bzhin/

'phags pa gdan 'dzom par mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs su gsol te/ 'phags pa rnams spyan drangs nas mchod cing*/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ mchod rten srog shing btsugs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ 'phags pa thams cad kyis/ mchod rten 'di chos kyi skur byin gyis brlabs te/ ring bsrel dang ldan par mdzad nas/ mchod rten la mchod pa dang*/ rim gro byed cing*/ srog shing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ che ge mo la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas/ tshe ring zhing nad med pa dang*/ bar chad kyi bgegs thams cad dang bral ba dang*/ mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces/ dge slong dang*/ dge slong ma dang*/ dge bsnyen dang*/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la zhig gis/ bsod nams kyi 'bras bu chen po thob cing*/ yon tan thob par 'dod pas/ gsang sngags kyi rgyal po'i cho ga sngar bstan pa bzhin du bya ste/ dgu bcu rtsa dgu yi ger bris la/ sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten gyi mdun du dkyil 'khor gru bzhir byas la/ ba'i lci bas byugs te/ grwa bzhir dri bzang gi chus bkang ba'i snod re re bzhag go /bdug spos kyi snod du 'thul ba yang bzhag nas/ snod chen po'i nang du me tog dang dri chu dang*/ 'bras skam po rnams blugs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhag pa dang*/ yang til nag po dang*/ sran ma ma sha dang*/ 'bras rnams bsres te btsos pa'i 'bras thug gi kris ra zhes bya ba dang*/ zas dkar gsum dang*/ 'di rnams bum pa'i nang du blug pa dang*/ yang shing rtog sna tshogs pa dang*/ 'bras bu dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang*/ kha zas ming gi smos pa 'di rnams dang*/ spos dang me tog la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bkram la/ gsang sngags kyi yi ge mchod rten gyi srog shing gi nang du bcug nas/

mchod rten gyi phyogs bzhir phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon sum du dmigs te phyag byas la/ sems rtse gcig pas gsang sngags 'di gdon par bya'o// 'di lta ste/ oṃ bi pu la/ bi ma le/ sra wa re/ dzi na ba re/ sa ra sa ra/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ dhā tu garbhe/ a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ ā ya ta to pa ṇi swā hā/ sarba de wa ṇi/ ba ha ya/ bi shuddha/ a dhiṣṭhā na/ sa ma ye swā hā/ bdug spos 'thul ba rgyun mi chad par bya zhing*/ gsang sngags lan nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'don na/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po brgyad dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po brgyad dang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ dbang phyug chen po dang*/ sred med kyi bu rnams/ de'i mod la/ mchod rten de la mchod pa dang*/ rim gror byed/ srog shing brtan par byed do// de bas na gang du yang*/ sangs rgyas bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang*/ gadgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang gnas der gshegs te/ mchod rten de la mchod pa dang*/ chos kyi skur byin gyis brlab cing*/ ring bsrel dang ldan par mdzad do// de ltar sems thag pa nas cho ga tshul bzhin du byas na/ yon tan de dag dang*/ gzhan yang mchod rten de yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che las byas pa'i bsod nams thob par 'gyur/ rin po che'i rnam pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma las mchod rten byas pa dang 'dra bar 'gyur te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po dang ldan zhing lus rnam par dag la/ tshe ring zhing nang med pa dang*/ bgegs thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang gang la la zhig mchod rten 'di mthong ngam/ mchod rten de'i dril bu'i sgra thos na yang*/ las kyi sgrib pa dang*/ sdig pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur te/ mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang yongs su byang nas 'chi ba'i dus byas pa'i 'og tu bde ba can gyi 'jig rten du skye'o// gang la la zhig gis mchod rten de'i ming thos pa tsam yang 'chi ba'i dus byas nas/

bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam thob par 'gyur ro// tha na bya dang ri dwags la sogs pa sems can gang gis mthong ba de yang tshe 'phos nas/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas spangs te/ bsod nams dang ldan pa'i lus thob par 'gyur ro// zhes bka' stsal pa'i phan yon thams cad che ge mo la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad la 'phral du 'grub par ci gnang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag par tshad mar gyur pas/ ji ltar bka' stsal pa bzhin du/ bden pa mngon sum du bstan pa ci gnang*/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba nan tan du gdab bo// de tsam mi nus na/ 'dod don gsol gdab spyi dang mthun par bya'o// de bzhin du/ phyogs gzhan gsum du yang 'phags pa spyan drangs pa nas/ gsol ba gdab pa'i bar tshar re re bya/ mjug tu shar phyogs nas bkra shis brjod/ cho ga'i bar la/ las byed rnams kyis/ phyogs bzhi nas rtsig pa bya ba sogs/ srog shing brtan pa'i thabs bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mjug gi bya ba/ snga ma ltar rdzogs par byas na/ ji skad bshad pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung ngo*// //gsum pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i cho ga ni/ dang por srog shing gi sngags dang*/ snying po'i sngags/ sgrib sel gyi gzungs/ srog shing brtan pa'i gzungs bzhi po/ re re zhing dgu bcu rtsa dgu bris la/ de nang du bcug pa'i sātstsha dgu bcu rtsa dgu pa tshan pa bzhi bya/ de rnams kyi 'phang lo'i nang du/ na mo na ba na ba ṭī nāṃ zhes sogs kyi sngags bris la bcug rab gnas cho ga bzhin du bya/ de nas gnas dben par dkyil 'khor bri ba sogs/ sgrub mchod sngar bzhin du bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha snam mam/ ma shong na tha mar mchod rten rnams bkod/ de dag la mchod pa dang*/ gnas brgyad kyi mchod rten gyi bstod pa 'don/ rol mo dang bcas pas bskor ba lan gsum mam bdun byas la/ na mo na ba la sogs pa'i gsang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dam/

dgu bcu rtsa dgu 'don na/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ mchod rten rnams la yan lag bdun pa dbul nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dang*/ phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ 'phags pa chos skyong ba'i tshogs thams cad bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gis 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi gzungs nas 'byung ba'i cho ga bzhin/ 'phags pa rnams gdan 'dzom pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'phags pa rnams spyan drang*/ mchod cing bstod nas/ bzlas brjod bgyis pa dang*/ gsang sngags bzhi po re re zhing nang du bcug pa'i mchod rten dgu bcu rtsa dgu bgyis te/ gsang sngags yi ger bris nas mchod rten gyi snying por bcug pa'i mchod rten bgyis te/ mchod cing bstod nas/ bskor ba byas te/ gzungs bzlas pa'i mthus/ che ge mo la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing*/ gnod pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi nas/ phan bde bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i dngos grub stsal bar ci gnang*/ sngon gsang ba'i bdag po la/ dpal gyi mgur nas 'di skad du/ gang la la zhig gis pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par spyod 'dod pa des/ snga ma bzhin du dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa byas te/ sa dang lci bas byugs la de'i steng du spos kyi skyang nul gyis byugs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi grwa bzhir dri'i chus gang ba'i snod re re bzhag la sngar bstan pa'i gsang sngags bzhi po dag las/ rnam pa gcig kyang dgu bcu rtsa dgu bris te/ rang gi lag gis mchod rten chung ngu dgu bcu rtsa dgu gdab cing*/ gsang sngags rnams gcig kyang re re'i nang du gzhug go

/de nas/ yang gsang sngags 'di dgu bcu rtsa dgu yi ger bris te/ mchod rten gyi 'phang lo rnams kyi nang du bcug la/ mchod rten rnams dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhag ste/ me tog dang*/ byug pas mchod la/ lan bdun bdun bskor zhing*/ gsang sngags 'di yang gdon par bya'o// na mo na ba tī nāṃ ta thā ga ta/ gaṃ gā nā dī pā lwa kāṃ/ ko ṭi ni yu ta sha ta sa ha swā ṇāṃ/ oṃ po po ri/ tsi ri ṇi tsa ri mo ri ko ro tsa la ba ri swā hā/ cho ga 'di ltar byas na/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par spyad par yang ma zad do// des ni rin po che'i mchod rten bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gadgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed byas par 'gyur ro// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu snyed la mchod cing bsnyen bkur byas par 'gyur ro// de'i gong du yang*/ lha thams cad kyis mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs bsdus te/ mchod rten de la yo byad sna tshogs sbyar nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i pho brang dang*/ yo byad sna tshogs sbyar nas mchod par 'gyur te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag snyed kyis mkhyen cing gzigs te byin gyis brlab par mdzad do// rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po'i bsod nams dang yon tan thams cad thob par mdzad do// yang gang la la zhig gis gsang sngags kyi rgyal po 'di snying po ma nor bar yi ger bris la rtag tu 'don te/ mchod pa'i las byas la lus la phog na/ rig pa de nyid kyis bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa mdzad de/ phas kyi rgol ba'i dgra thams cad dang*/ sha gnyer ba rnams dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags la sogs pa thams cad kyis gnod par mi 'gyur te/ 'jigs shing skrag nas so sor 'byer bar 'gyur ro// gang la la zhig gis rig pa 'don pa de dang gtam byas pa yang mtshams med pa lnga'i las kyi sgrib pa yang yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro// gang la la zhig gis sngags 'di'i sgra thos sam/

grib ma phog gam/ lus la reg kyang rung ste/ de'i tshe rabs gzhan gyi las kyi sgrib pa dang*/ sdig pa thams cad yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro// gang rig pa 'don pa de'i lus la dug gis mi tshugs/ mes mi tshugs/ chus khyer bar mi 'gyur/ gnod pa thams cad kyis kyang glags mi rnyed/ thog 'bab par mi 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa mdzad cing*/ spyan ras gzigs kyis 'tsho bar mdzad do// lha thams cad dang dam tshig can thams cad kyis kyang*/ de la stong grogs byed par 'gyur te/ gzhan gyi rig sngags dang*/ byad dang sbyor ba thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// de lta bas na/ rigs pa 'don pa gnas gang na 'dug kyang*/ gsang sngags 'di'i cho ga don du gnyer bar byas te/ gsang sngags yi ger bris la/ lam gyi bzhi mdo'am/ sum mdo skye bo mang po phan tshun 'gro ba'i gnas su mchod rten byas la/ de'i nang du bcug na 'gro ba thams cad dang*/ bya dang sbrang ma dang*/ tha na grog sbur yan chad kyis mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ reg pa dang*/ de la phog pa'i sa dang*/ rdul dang*/ rlung dang*/ grib mas phog na yang byol song dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ ngan song la sogs par ltung ba/ sems can dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur ba'i sdig pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/ 'chi ba'i dus byas nas/ bde 'gro mtho ris lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur te/ sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa yang yongs su byang nas tshe rabs rjes su dran pa thob par 'gyur zhing*/ mi ltung ba'i blo gros can du 'gyur ro// zhes bka' stsal pa'i phan yon thams cad che ge mo la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad la 'phral du 'grub par ci gnang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa tshad mar 'gyur bas/ ji ltar bka' stsal pa bzhin du/ bden pa mngon sum du bstan pa ci gnang*/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de tsam mi nus na/ ji ltar rigs pa'i tshig gis gsol ba drag tu gdab bo// de nas rjes kyi cho ga rnams sngar bzhin bya'o// de ltar na rang la pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhing der ma zad/

sa'i mchod rten de rnams kyang rin po che'i mchod rten bye ba khrag khrig byas par 'gyur ba nas/ sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran pa dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa'i chos can du 'gyur ba'i bar gyi yon tan mtha' dag thob par 'gyur ro// //

༄༅// a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang bzhugs so// ༈ /na maḥshrī mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod na/ maṇḍal dri bzangs kyis byug pa la me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i mthar/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham/ rang sgrub thabs ltar bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song nas/ mdun gyi me tog gi steng du sa bon tsam las 'jam dbyangs bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bcug mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab bo// de nas mchod pa rnams dbul/ ci shes pa'i bstod pa bya/ gtor ma dgos 'dod 'byung bar byin gyis brlab/ a kā ros phul/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ de nas mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa ci nus zhig bya ste/ slob dpon gyi bya ba'i rim pa'o// de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas/ phyag dang maṇḍal phul nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs sam/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyis rgyun bshags bya'o// rjes gnang dngos gzhi la/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung*/ dam bca' ba'i lung gsum gyi dang po ni/ slob ma 'jam dbyangs su bsgom du bcug slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/ thugs ka nas 'od 'phros mdun bskyed dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku dpag tu med pa byung ste/ slob ma la thim par dpon slob gnyis kas bsam/ de nas gnyis ka'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du shes rab kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar a dhīḥ rtsibs bzhi la g.yas skor du ra pa tsa na bkod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'khor lo las sngags kyi phreng ba zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i khar zhugs/ snying ga'i 'khor lo la thim pas shes rab rgyas par bsams la/

sngags kyi rjes zlos lan mang du bya/ yang slob ma'i mgrin par dhīḥmago phugs su bstan par bsams la/ de'i 'od kyis ngag gi nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi yon tan thams cad bsdus par bsams la dhīḥzhes ci nus bzlas so// gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung ni/ slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis de'i mgor me tog bzhag bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes brjod pas/ slob dpon dang 'jam dbyangs gnyis kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ gsum pa dam bca' ba'i lung ni/ slob mas thal mo sbyar la/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus da nas bzung ste/ ci srid byang chub snying po la mchis gyi bar du/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// lan gsum brjod/ bsgom bzlas ma chags par byed par 'dod na 'dir khas len du bcug go /de nas sdom pa bsdus te khas blangs pa dang*/ yon 'bul ba rnams bya ste rjes gnang ngo*// de nas mdun bskyed kyi lha la mchod bstod bya/ dngos grub blangs la gshegs su gsol/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// // ༄༅// 'od dpag med kyi tshe sgrub bzhugs so// ༈ /sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du tshe dpag tu med pa'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o// oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi gnas khang nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su gyur pa'i mdun du/ rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i steng du/ skad cig gis rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng du/
