'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ dbu gtsug tor dang bcas shing tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum pa gdang ldan zhing 'od zer gyis brgyan pa/ na bza' chos gos ngur smrig dang bcas shing*/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i mtha' skor du bla ma brgyud pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor zhing mngon sum du bzhugs pa/ 'jig rten 'dren pa sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya a pa ri mi ta arghaṃ sogs/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pas bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gi mthil gyi lhung bzed las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' lha dang mi'i bram ze dang*/ drang srong tshe'i rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ phyag gi mthil gyi lhung bzed kyi nang gi bdud rtsi la thim pas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur par bsam/ de nas rang gi sna bug gnyis nas rlung phyir btang ba lhung bzed la reg pas/ rlung de 'od zer lnga'i rgyun lam du gyur par bsam/ yang rang gi rlung phyir btang*/ slar nang du rngubs pas lhung bzed kyi nang gi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ sna sgo gnyis nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad mer gyis khengs par bsams la lan bdun nam gsum bya/ mthar de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la shes pa gtad la/ oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzī wanti ye swā hā/ lnga brgya bzlas/ mthar sngar bzhin gsol ba btab nas bcom ldan 'das rang la bstim pa'am/ mi dmigs par bsam pa gang rung byas nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /nas/ de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam bya/

dge legs bsam 'grub la gnang ba'o// // ༄༅// 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis 'phags pa seng ge sgra bsgom par bgyi'o// oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las siṃ las seng ge dkar po mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du/ paṃ las padma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du yi ge hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad bcom/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid 'phags pa seng ge'i sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pa padma dkar po bsnams pa/ rgyan spangs shing dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing dbu'i gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ de'i g.yas su tri shū la la sbrul gnyis mgo gyen du bstan nas dkris pa/ g.yon du padma dkar po la gnas pa'i thod pa 'bru dang*/ bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'phags pa seng ge sgra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ snying gar zla ba la hrīḥdakar po'i mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/

bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa dang*/ nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bcom par bsam zhing sngags bzlas par bya'o// oṃ āḥhrīḥsiṃ ha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ gzungs ring ci nus bzlas 'di bzhin/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ārya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa twā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ a ka ṭe/ bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭe/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭe/ ka ro ṭa birye swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa dang*/ nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'jig rten dbang phyug 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /phu gsum pa la gnang ba'o// // ༄// sna tshogs yum gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas// rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ lha mo sna tshogs yum padma'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog dkar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ padma dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can du bsgoms la/ oṃ phreṃ bi shwa mā tā/ badzra kaṇḍa kā na/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ma ma shāntiṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes mi tshig gis bar ma chod par sum brgya la sogs pa bzlas la/ mthar rlung bum pa can bzung*/ mjug tu dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo'o// zhes pa grwa pa gcig la gnang ngo*/// / ༄// rma bya chen mo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i tshe sgrub nyams su len par 'dod pas/ tho rangs bya khwa ta'i skad mi grags pa'i tshe mal nas langs te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ rang gi spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ maṃ ljang gu las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su 'dus pa las/

rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo sku mdog ljang gu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas rma bya'i mjug sgro dang*/ g.yon pas mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du bskyed/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du maṃ ljang gu/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ thugs ka'i maṃ yig la thim pas/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku gang ba spu'i bu ga'i sgo thams cad nas zags/ rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ snying gar thim/ lus thams cad 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsams la/ oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzī wanta ye swā hā/ zhes ma yengs par stong phrag re bzlas/ mthar bcom ldan 'das ma la mos pa rtse gcig tu byas la/ margad mdog mtshungs nyi ma lta bur gsal// nyon mongs dug 'joms rma bya'i mjug sgro dang*// dngos grub kun stsol bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams// rma bya chen mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das mas bdag gi tshe'i bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi nas/ tshe ring du 'tsho bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod pas bcom ldan 'das mas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ rjes bsngo ba bya'o// dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i man ngag rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi dka' 'grel las byung ba'i don ma nor bar bkod pa'o//

// ༄// so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal so sor 'brang ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di bsgrub par 'dod na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi rjes su/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ gis stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ yi ge praṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma sku mdog dkar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pas ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas 'khor lo dkar po thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis zlum po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra nag po'i thor cog la/ me tog gi phreng ba'i cod paṇa gyis mdzes pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ dar gyi sham thabs can du bsam/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i praṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas bcom ldan 'das ma so so 'brang ma la/ sangs rgyas sras bcas kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la dbyer med du 'dres/ nam mkha' nas rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pas/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing*/ bdud rtsi'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas thugs kar zla ba'i steng du praṃ dkar po/ de'i mthar/ sngags g.yas skor du bkod par bsam/ de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas tshe dang dbang phyug thams cad 'od dkar po'i rnam pas snying ga'i yi ge la thim par bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badzri ṇi ma hā pra ti sa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ngag bcad de ci nus su bzlas/

mthar rang so so 'brang mar gsal ba'i mkha' nang nas/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sku dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas par bsam zhing*/ sngags ci nus bzlas nas/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag la tshe dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i dngos grub blangs la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas su bsngo/ 'di ni rdo rje gur gyi le'u bco lnga par/ bud med gang zhig bu 'dod pa// so so 'brang ma rtag dran bya// ces pa'i don/ rje btsun chen po'i gdams ngag ltar/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos bris pa'o// // ༄// rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od 'phros/ bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa la/ rang nyid dpal rta mgrin sku mdog nag po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing*/ spyi gtsug na rta mgos mtshan pa/ sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad dpal rta mgrin gyi rnam par spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag la gnyis su med par thim/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dbang bskur/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/

thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad par bsams shing*/ oṃ hrī padmānta krita badzra kro dha ha ya gri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas so// bcom ldan 'das bdag gi nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ bgegs dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /khro rgyal rta mgrin 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /a ka e jo'i don du mdzad pa'o// // ༄// bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod pa'i cho ga bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo buddhā ya/ 'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// sras dang slob mar bcas la gus btud de// bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim// ma nor gzhung gi dgongs pa 'dir nges bya// 'dir byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho'i zhal snga nas// chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi sku rim du/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi cho ga dang*/ gtsug tor dri med kyi cho ga gnyis mdzad pa las/ dang po nyams su len par 'dod na/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ sa gzhi bstar ba spos chus zlum por byug pa la/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ spro na tshon phye'am zhes gsungs pas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi yis brgyan pa/ phyi padma'i phreng ba dang*/ 'od zer lngas bskor ba'i dbus su/ mchims pas/ padma rim pa gsum gyi dang po la brgyad/ bar pa la bcu drug phyi ma la nyer gnyis byed pa ni gzhung dang mi mthun pas/ 'dir dbus su/ lha snam dkar po gru bzhi pa/ de'i phyi rol du/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i lha snam gru bzhi pa gnyis byas la/ de'i dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ me tog gi tshom bu'am/

tshon spungs re re/ de'i phyi rol du mtshams bzhir re re dang*/ phyogs bzhir gsum gsum ste bcu drug de'i phyi rol du/ shar sgo'i g.yon phyogs nas nub sgo'i bar la/ mtshams gnyis su re re/ shar nub tu gsum gsum/ byang phyogs su bzhi ste bcu gnyis bkod/ lho sgo'i g.yas g.yon du re re dang*/ sgo bzhir re re bkod do// de rnams kyang padma'i dbus kyi tshom bu dgu ni/ me tog gi tshom bu'am/ tshon spungs su byas la/ gzhan rnams ni padma dang zla ba'i gdan re re bya'o// mdo dang gzhung gnyis kar de tsam las bshad pa mi snang yang*/ rgya ston gyis/ snam bu tha ma'i g.yas gral du phyogs skyong bcu/ nyi ma dang zla ba gnyis te bcu gnyis po g.yon gral dang mthun par dgod par 'dod la/ mchims la sogs pas phyogs skyong bcu po tsam zhig dgod par 'dod do// de'i mtha' skor du/ lha re re la mchod pa rnams bdun bdun las mi nyung bar bsham/ maṇḍal de'i shar phyogs su bum pa dri bzang gi chus gang ba kha rgyan dang bcas pa dang*/ rdo rje gzungs thag kyang bzhag go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba mang du byas la/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar/ bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring thams cad dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces stong nyid dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i don du de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa la/ phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa 'bul ba dang smon lam khyad par can rnams gdab par bgyi'o// zhes sems bskyed nas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// zhes sogs cho ga bklag go

/spyan drangs pa'i tshigs bcad ni/ tshul khrims rnam dag shes rab shin tu dag /dad ldan snying po nyan thos che rnams kyis// mgon med gyur pa bdag la rjes bzung ba'i// don mdzad thugs rjes gshegs par mdzad du gsol// zhes sam/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// zhes sogs shlau ka gsum brjod pa'i mthar rol mo bya/ de ltar spyan drangs pa'i rjes sogs gzhung bzhin nam/ des dmigs pa mi gsal na/ rgya ston gyis/ spyan drangs pa'i lha rnams kyi zhal phyag gsal 'debs par 'dod pa shin tu legs pas/ de ltar spyan drangs pas so so'i zhing khams nas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la gshegs te/ mdun gyi maṇḍal rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang chen po gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhis mdzes par byas pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ bar gyi snam bu rim pa gnyis pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ chos dkon mchog gi ngo bo yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas dang po chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya/ gnyis pas rdo rje/ g.yon dang po mnyam gzhag gnyis pas pusti 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes par byas la/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ rin po che'i khri seng ges bteg pa brgyad la/ shar du ston pa shākya thub pa sku mdog ser po g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ lhor sgra dbyangs rgyal po ser po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam gzhag nub tu mya ngan med mchog dpal dmar skya mnyam gzhag byang du mtshan legs ser po g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang g.yon mnyam gzhag byang shar du sangs rgyas sman gyi bla sku mdog sngon po g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas a ru ra dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas lhung bzed bsnams pa/

shar lhor gser bzang dri med ser po phyag gnyis kyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ lho nub tu chos grags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs sku mdog dkar dmar phyag gnyis kyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ nub byang du mngon mkhyen rgyal po sku mdog dmar po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang na bza' chos gos ngur smrig mnabs shing rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ sku la mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ gsung dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa/ thugs shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis mdzes par byas pa'o// bar gyi snam bu dang po'i shar gyi dbus su byang chub sems dpa' 'jam pa'i dbyangs gur gum gyi mdog can phyag g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon utpa la'i steng na pusti 'dzin pa/ de'i g.yas su skyabs grol dkar po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje khu tshur gnyis brla'i steng du bzhag nas/ g.yon du snyems pa'i tshul gyis cung zad 'gying ba/ de'i g.yas byang shar gyi grwar nyi ma ltar rnam par snang byed dmar ser g.yas utpa la'i steng na nyi mas mtshan pa'i glegs bam/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur dkur brten pa/ 'jam dbyangs kyi g.yon du phyag na rdo rje ljang gu g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ de'i g.yon shar lho'i grwar zla ba ltar snang byed dkar po/ g.yas utpa la'i steng na glegs bam zla ba tshes pas mtshan pa/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur dkur brten pa'o// de nas gleng bzhi nas 'byung ba bcu gcig ni/ lho'i snam bu la spyan ras gzigs dkar po g.yas padma 'dzin pa/ de'i g.yon du blo gros chen po ser po mig gis spras pa'i padma 'dzin pa/ byams pa mgon po ser po klu shing gi me tog sdong bu dang bcas pa'i ril ba spyi blugs kyis spras pa 'dzin pa/

lho nub kyi grwar spobs pa brtsegs dkar po ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu rnam gnon don yod dkar po ral gri 'dzin pa/ blta na sdug dkar po padma'i sdong bu'i steng du glegs bam rin po ches spras pa 'dzin pa/ mun pa nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros dkar po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang gi grwar bsam pa legs par sems dpa' dkar po bum pa 'dzin pa/ byang du lhun po brtsegs dkar po zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i padma'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ sangs sangs po'i dbyangs sngo skya utpa la rin po ches 'bar ba dang rdo rjes mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ rdo rje rtse 'dzin rgyal po ser po rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa/ bcu gcig po rnams g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur dkur brten pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyis na bzas mdzes pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// snam bu tha ma'i shar sgo'i g.yas su gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ji 'jigs ser po g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ de'i g.yas su rdo rje smug nag ral gri/ rgyan 'dzin ser po dbyug to/ byang shar gyi grwar gza' 'dzin sngo skya dbyug to/ byang du rlung 'dzin dmar po rtse gsum/ gnas bcas dud kha ral gri/ dbang 'dzin dmar po dbyug pa/ gtun 'dzin ser po dbyug to/ nub byang gi grwar smra 'dzin ser po st+wa re/ nub tu bsam 'dzin ser po zhags pa/ sngo 'dzin sngon po dbyug to/ rdzogs byed dmar po 'khor lo/ g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis padma dang dar zab kyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' lhab lhub tu mnabs pa/ lto ba 'phyang zhing gsus khyim che ba 'jigs shing rngams pa'i cha lugs can te/

de lta bu'i gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon rnams kyang g.yon gral la bzhugs pa'o// g.yas gral la/ gzhung ltar na/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gnyis bkod pas chog la/ rgya ston sogs ltar na/ shar sgo'i g.yas su shing rta'i steng du nyi ma dmar po phyag gnyis kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ de'i g.yon du ngang pa'i steng du zla ba dkar po zla ba/ tshangs pa ser po gdong bzhi pa ngang pa la gnas pa g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon bum pa/ shar lho'i grwar brgya byin ser po glang po che la gnas pa rdo rje/ lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la gnas pa me thab/ gshin rje sngon po ma he la gnas pa dbyug to/ srin po nag po ro langs la gnas pa ral gri/ chu lha dkar po chu srin la gnas pa sbrul zhags/ lho nub kyi grwar rlung lha sngo skya sha ba la gnas pa ba dan/ nub tu gnod sbyin ser po rta la gnas pa dbyug to/ dbang ldan dkar po glang la gnas pa rtse gsum/ sa'i lha mo phag pa la gnas pa phyag gnyis kyis bum pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i cod paṇa dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa ste/ de ltar phyogs skyong rnams g.yas gral la bzhugs par 'dod pa ni gzhung las/ ku be ra la sogs pa zhes pa'i sogs khongs tsam la brten pa 'dra'o// shar sgor rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung sku mdog dkar po phyag gnyis kyis pi wang 'dzin pa/ lho sgor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri/ nub sgor spyan mi bzang dmar po sprul zhags/ byang sgor rnam thos sras ser po ne'u le 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs can rin po che'i cod paṇa dang*/ lha rdzas kyi dar dmar po'i lhab lhub kyis mdzes pa'o// de ltar spyan drangs pa'i lha mdun du bzhugs pa rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gsal btab cing*/ bdag nyid lhar mi bskyed pa 'di ni/ lha rje dpon lta bu la dngos grub len pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi lugs yin no// sku mdog dang phyag mtshan rnams la mi 'dra ba du ma snang yang*/

'dir rgyal sras thogs med kyis gsung ltar byas so// de nas spyir phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ re re nas phyag 'tshal zhing smon lam gdab pa rnams gzhung bzhin bya/ shāka thub kyi skabs kyi gzungs stong rtsa brgyad dang*/ phyag rdor gyi skabs kyi gzungs gnyis brgya rtsa re/ gser bzang gi gzungs ci 'grub bzlas/ smon lam thams cad kyi skabs su rang ngam gzhan gyi ming gzhug go /de nas gzungs sngags bzlas la khrus bya zhes pa'i don/ sngar gyi bum pa/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre zhes sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du hrīḥlas padma dang*/ āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dbus su bhrūm̐ aṃ dzrīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ rnams dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro bar gyur/ zhes bya ba'am/ yang na gzungs kyi phreng bas bskor bar dmigs la/ 'phags pa'i tshogs zhes sogs kyis mchod pa phul nas/ dpal bai ḍūrya'i gzungs mthu dang nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa khyed kyis bdag gam bsgrub bya ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i rgyud la tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib pa byang nas/ chos kyi rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ gzungs thag nas bzung nas bzlas pas/ sngags phreng gzungs thag la brten te song nas dung chos kyi chu la phog pas de lud nas bum par lhung ste/ yig 'bru rnams la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsams la/ tadya thā ghu me sogs dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te gu ru bai ḍūrya sogs sum brgya tsam bzlas/ mthar sngar bzhin mchod la dung chos kyi mchod yon dbul zhing gsol ba btab pas/ yig 'bru rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i chur bsam mo// mthar rang nyid kyis khrus bya zhing*/ bsgrub bya gzhan la bya dgos na/ khrus dang bkra shis rgyas par bya'o// 'di rnams ni mchims kyi bzhed pa ltar bris pa'o// skabs 'dir mdo klog mkhan gzhan med na sher phyin gyi mdo dang*/

'di'i mdo brgyad brgya pa lan bzhi bcu zhe dgur 'don par bshad pas ci nus su klag go /gsum pa rjes ni/ spyir mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul zhes pa gtang rag mchod pa yin pas/ sngar gyi phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi zhes pa nas gsol bar 'tshal lo'i bar byas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi mdo bklag cing*/ gshegs gsol tshar ba'i rjes la/ bkra shis rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya'o// gzhung nas zin pa 'di tsam zhig gis kha ma bskangs na cho ga chad par 'gyur la/ lha so so'i bstod pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa'i tshigs rnams skabs su/ sbyor ba dang*/ phyogs skyong dang gnod sbyin gyi skabs su gtor ma 'bul ba rnams ni cho ga rgyas par 'gyur bas byas kyang mi 'gal zhing*/ ma byas kyang cho ga chad par 'gyur ba'i nyes pa ni med do// gang dag lha rnams zhal phyir bltas kyi tsa ka li la pho brang du ming btags pa/ bon po'i lugs kyi rten bsham pa dang*/ sngon du mchod pa byin brlab bya ba dang*/ byin brlab skor bzhi'i skabs su dbyangs kyi tshig cho ga'i dkyus su sbyor ba dang*/ spyan 'dren dang*/ shāka thub kyi skabs su gnas brtan bcu drug gi cho ga sbyor ba dang*/ chos dkon mchog gi skabs su/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi phyag mchod sbyor ba dang*/ skyabs grol sogs kyi skabs su don zhags lha lnga'i phyag mchod sbyor ba dang*/ spyir phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ gtang rag gi skabs su/ bka' gdams brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal sogs 'brel med kyi bstod pa mang po byed pa dang*/ bye brag tu gshin po'i don du cho ga byed na/ spyan drangs pa'i rjes su ming byang ngam rten bshams nas/ de la bgegs sbyang ba nas skyabs 'gro'i bar byed cing*/ khrus kyi skabs su khrus dang dug phyung sogs byed pa dang*/ mjug tu skye sa bcu gnyis kyi smon lam byed pa dang*/ sman bla longs sku'i rjes gnang zer nas/

rnal 'byor bla med kyi dbang bzhi mdor bsdus zhig sbyor ba dang*/ de'i rdzogs rim yin zer nas thig le dang sems 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor 'ga' zhig byed pa dang*/ cho ga'i gnas skabs su sha chang dang sgog btsong*/ phyi dro'i kha zas la longs spyod pa rnams ni blun po rnams kyis rang bzor sbyar ba'i lhad kho na yin pas bdag legs su 'dod pa'i mkhas pa blo gros can rnams kyis dug bzhin du spang bar bya'o// gzhan yang sman bla sprul sku'i rjes gnang zer nas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor kha cig la dpe byas pa lta bu'i cho ga yang snang mod/ bzlas lung tsam zhig bya ba'i rgyud yin pas shin du rigs na'ang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa gcig la gcig bstim byed pa sogs brtag dgos so// dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchims kyis/ cho ga rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod pa las/ 'di 'bring po yin zhes gsungs pa la kha cig cho ga rgyas par grags pa ni 'di'i spyan 'dren gyi skabs su phyogs skyong spyan drangs pa sogs kyi tshig mang po dang*/ mchod pa bsham pa'i tshul rgyas su btang ba tsam zhig yin la/ bsdus par grags pa ni/ spyir phyag 'tshal ba'i skabs logs su phyung ba yin pas/ cho ga rgyas bsdus gnyis/ bka' gdams pa 'ga' zhig gis byas pa yin gyi/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa ma yin no// zhes zer ba'ang bden pa 'dra'o// 'di lta bu'i cho ga khyad par can 'di ni ston pa sangs rgyas kyi dus mchod rnams la byas na bsod nams che ste/ de'ang rje sa skya pa dang*/ jo bo a ti sha ltar na/ me mo yos bu'i lo/ dpyid zla tha chung sa ga'i tshes brgyad dang skar ma rgyal 'dzom pa ni sku bltam pa'i dus so// shing mo lug gi lo dpyid zla tha chung gi tshes brgyad ni rab tu byung ba'i dus so// lcags mo byi ba'i lo dpyid zla tha chung gi tshes bco lnga ni mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i dus so// de nyid kyi dbyar zla 'bring po chu stod kyi tshes bzhi nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus so// byi lo ston zla tha chung smin drug gi tshes bco lnga ni lha las babs pa'i dus so// byi lo dgun zla tha chung mchu'i tshes bco lnga ni cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i dus so// me mo phag gi dpyid zla tha chungs kyi tshes bco lnga ni yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus so// kha che paṇa chen dang*/

khro lo ltar na/ lha las babs pa'i dus ni ston zla 'bring po'i tha skar gyi nyi shu gnyis yin la/ gzhan rnams snga ma dang 'dra bar snang ngo*// de ltar dus khyad par can bdun la/ dge ba spyad na bsod nams mtha' yas pa thob par gsungs shing*/ khyad par du'ang*/ cho 'phrul che dang mngon byang chub// 'khor lo lha las babs pa'o// zhes pa dus chen po bzhi'i dus su/ dge ba spyad pa ni sa ya phrag brgya'i 'gyur du/ lung sil bu dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las gsungs so// zhes 'byung bas/ bde gshegs 'khor dang bcas pa mchod pa la sogs pa'i dge ba la brtson par bya'o// rgya chen tshogs gnyis bde blag rdzogs byed pa'i// bde gshegs mchod pa'i cho ga dri med 'di// ngan rtog rang bzo'i skyon gyis ma gos par// blo ldan bsod nams rin chen don du sbyar// 'di sbyar dge ba bdag gis gang thob des// bskul ba po dang sems can thams cad kyi// lam gyi bar chad mtha' dag zhi ba dang*// thub dbang byang chub dam pa'i gnas thob shog /ces pa 'di yang*/ deng sang 'di'i cho ga shin du dar yang*/ cho ga'i dgongs pa ltar dag po byed mkhan ches nyung bar mthong nas/ de rnams la phan par gyur cig snyam pa'i bsams pas/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos mdo brgyad brgya pa dang*/ cho ga'i gzhung la zhib du dpyad nas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong bsod nams rin chen no// i daṃ shā sa nashtsa sarba satwā hi to bha wantu// //

༄// dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed rang gi blang ba'i cho ga bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo buddhā ya/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed sngar slob dpon la thob nas phyis rten gyi spyan sngar rang gi len par 'dod na/ thub pa chen po'i rten gyi drung du ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po bshams/ rang rten la kha phyogs nas 'dug mdun du ston pa thub pa'i dbang po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bcas pa bzhugs par bsams la/ phyag gsum phul la maṇḍal sems bskyed pa zhu ba'i yon du phul nas/ thal mo sbyar la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod de blangs la/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na massaṃ ghā ya/ na mo mant+ra de ba ta bhyaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ zhes phyag byas la/ mchod rdzas rnams bsam gyis mi khyab par bsams la/ phun tshogs lha rdzas las grub yid 'ong ba'i// mchod yon me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo la sogs mchod tshogs 'dis// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos// dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod// ces brjod la rol mo dbul/ me tog dor/ bdug spos dbul lo// de nas phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dang*/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ci srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog

'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ dgongs gsol dang*/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi dbang gis lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba/ de thams cad so sor bshags shing slar yang mi bgyid do// ces sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ so so skye bo'i dge ba dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la dga' zhing rjes su yi rangs bar bgyi'o// zhes dge ba la rjes su yi rangs pa dang*/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sras dang bcas pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi bzhed pa de dag la sems can thams cad kyi don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba 'debs so// zhes chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa de dag la yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so// zhes pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba dang*/ 'jam dpal ji ltar mkhyen cing dpa' ba dang*// kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*// dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo// zhes bsngo ba lan gsum bya ste/ sbyor ba'o// de nas yid la 'di ltar bsams te/ bdag gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i dngos po dus gsum gyis bsdus pa thams cad nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la spyi mthun du ltos pa med par sbyin pa/

byin pa'i nor la bdag kha mi 'dzud pa ltar rang gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams sems can thams cad la dbang bar bsgom/ de nas sems can rnams kyis bdag la lus kyi rdeg btsog byed dam ngag gis mi snyan par brjod dam sems kyi chags sdang ci skyed kyang rung ste/ thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa bon thebs par bsgom mo// bdag sems can thams cad la spyir 'khor ba'i longs spyod dang*/ ji ltar dgos pa'i bran dang*/ gang mkho ba'i grogs dang ji tsam dgos pa'i bar lhun grub tu 'byung bar 'dod pa zhe thag pa nas rkang gi khong rus pa'i gting nas bsgoms la/ ngag tu dgongs gsol dang*/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa de dag gis sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba'i phyir smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba'i phyir smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ re re'i mtshams su blo sbyang bsgom pa dang spel bar bya ste/ dngos gzhi'o// de nas/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// da ni bdag gi ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// ces pa rang dga' ba bsgom/

bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// zhes gzhan dga' ba bsgom du gzhug par bya/ de nas mdun gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis bslab bya gsungs par bsams la/ byang sems kyi bslab par bya ba mdor bsdus na/ theg pa chen po'i bla ma la gus par bya ba dang*/ nag po'i chos bzhi spang bar bya ba dang*/ sems can blo'i mi spang ba dang gsum mo// smon pa'i bslab bya bsdus pa sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa'i bsam pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i bslab bya bsdus pa/ don med pa'i sdig pa mi byed pa dang*/ ci nus kyis dge ba sgrubs shig gsungs par bsam/ de'i nag po'i chos bzhi ni/ bla ma dang mchod par 'os pa bslu ba dang*/ gzhan chos dang dge ba byed pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang*/ theg chen la zhugs pa'i gang zag thams cad la smod cing tshig ngan pa smra ba dang*/ g.yo sgyus gzhan la ngan byed pa ste bzhi po 'di spang bar bya'o// zhes gsungs par bsams te bslab bya brjod pa'o// de nas gtang rag gi phyir mchod pa gsar pa bshams la/ ji snyed su dag sogs bzang spyod nas bshad pa'i yan lag bdun pa phul la/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// sogs dang*/ byang chub sems ni rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skye 'gyur zhing*// skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang na su bzhugs pa// de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub gyur cig /ces sogs kyis bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam ci nus pa gdab ste rjes so// de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas/ rang gis blangs na byang sems kyi sdom pa nyams pa'ang sor chud nas sdom ldan du 'gyur bas/

yang yang len pa la 'bad par byas na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// // ༄// gso sbyong rang gis blang ba'i cho ga bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo buddhā ya/ gso sbyong rang gis len par 'dod pas/ dkon mchog gi rten dang spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gzugs kyi mdun du/ mchod pa ci 'byor pa bshams la khrus byas nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pas 'dod chags bral bar 'gyur// dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gus// zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing*// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che// skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che// 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che// bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal// gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis// mnyam med mkhyen chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal// gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam par rab sprul nas// rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun// bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la// lus dang ngag yid dwang bas phyag bgyi'o// bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis// rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du// zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis// rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag

/de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa// thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos// de dag bsngags pa mi bzad rgya mtsho rnams// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// ces pas phyag byas/ de nas ting ting shag la sogs pa'i rol mo rnams dbul zhing*/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*// sil snyan rnams dang byug pa bdug mchog dang*// mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// na bza' dam pa zhes sogs nas/ mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba// de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos// bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// zhes brjod/ de nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis na// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*// bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa ci mchis pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras// rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rangs// gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes// mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la// 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul// mya ngan 'das ston gang bzhed de dag la// 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir// bskal ba zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*// bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi// phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rangs bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes yan lag bdun pa ni sbyor ba'o// de nas rten gyi spyan sngar pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs/

thal mo sbyar la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po bya ba byas shing byed pa byas pa/ khur bor pa/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid pa kun du sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de dag gis sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang*/ phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ gso sbyong nges par mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du gso sbyong nges par yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o// deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing*// gzhan gyi nor yang blang mi bya// 'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing*// brdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o// skyon ni mang po nyer bsten pa'i// chang ni yongs su spang bar bya// khri stan mthon po mi bya zhing*// de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas// dri dang phreng ba dang ni rgyan// gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya// ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni// srog gcod la sogs mi byed ltar// de ltar du ni bdag gis kyang*// deng nas srog gcod la sogs spang*// sdug bsngal mang 'khrugs 'jig rten kun// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod pa ni dngos gzhi'o// de nas de ltar tshul khrims blangs pa las byung ba'i dge ba pha mas thog drangs sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig snyam du bsams la/

dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags shing*// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba// dam pa gnyis po thob par shog /khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing*// tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan// rloms sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis// tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /ces bsngo ba dang smon lam bya ba ni rjes so// de ltar dang por slob dpon la thob nas/ phyis rang gi sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas nyin re bzhin ma chags par blangs na/ theg pa chen po so sor thar pa rgyun chags su gnas la/ de'i rten la dge ba ci spyad pa rnams bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ro// de'i phyir bdag bde legs su 'dod pa dag tshul 'di la nan tan du bya bar rigs so// //maṅga laṃ// //

༄༅// mchod sbyin chen mo'i zin bris bzhugs so// ༈ /myur du spyon/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra e hya hi/ zhes spyan drangs nas/ de ltar spyan drangs pas mdun gyi maṇḍal rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ gser gyi ri bdun/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun/ gling bcu gnyis/ phyi rol lcags ri dang bcas pas yongs su bskor ba'i lhun po'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs pa'i lha snam rim pa drug gi lte bar sdong bu dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs padma 'dab ma bcu pa'i lte ba'i dbus su/ seng ge'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po phyag gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ shar du glang po che'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs padma la/ mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ lhor rta'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad zla la/ rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ nub tu rma bya'i khri'i steng du pad zla la 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ byang du mkha' lding gi khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad zla la don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che yis brgyan cing rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i g.yas su seng ge'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad zla la/ ston pa shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu g.yas gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa chos gos ngur smrig bsnams pa/ dbu'i gtsug tor dang bcas pa sprul pa'i sku'i cha byad can/ g.yon du rin po che'i bum pa'i steng du gsung rab pusti dang*/

dar zab sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes pa/ phyi rol gyi pad 'dab rnams la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams sprul pa'i sku'i rnam pa can dang*/ phyi rol gyi lha snam rnams la 'jam dbyangs dang*/ spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams dang*/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i yum gyi tshogs rnams dang*/ khams gsum rnam rgyal la sogs pa khro bo'i tshogs rnams dang*/ gdung ba sel ba la sogs pa rang rgyal rnams dang*/ shā ri'i bu la sogs pa nyan thos kyi tshogs rnams dang*/ bha ra dhwa dza la sogs pa'i gnas brtan chen po rnams dang*/ grags 'dzin ma la sogs pa dgra bcom pa pha ma'i tshogs dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sku gdung dang mchod rten thams cad dang*/ dbyangs can ma la sogs pa sgra'i lha mo'i tshogs dang*/ dpal chen mo la sogs pa nor lha'i tshogs dang*/ gzugs can snying po la sogs pa sangs rgyas dang spyod yul gcig pa'i lha'i tshogs dang*/ 'dod pa'i lha la sogs pa chos khams 'byed pa'i lha'i tshogs dang*/ pho nya sa lha la sogs pa ci bgyi'i tshogs dang*/ gtsang ris sde lnga la sogs pa gzugs khams kyi lha rnams dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po la sogs pa 'dod khams kyi lha'i tshogs dang*/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa phyogs skyong ba bcu dang*/ yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po la sogs pa'i rgyal po chen po sde bzhi dang*/ nyi ma dang zla ba la sogs te gza' chen po brgyad dang*/ smin drug dang snar ma la sogs pa rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ yang dag shes dang rgyal ba khyu mchog la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi tshogs dang*/ gadgā la sogs pa bkra shis kyi bdag po'i tshogs dang*/ lha klu dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa sde brgyad kyi tshogs dang*/ ri'i lha dang shing gi lha dang 'byung ba bzhi'i lha la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i tshogs dang*/ lha'i bla ma dang phur bu la sogs pa bstan bcos rigs pa'i lha'i tshogs dang*/

dung can ma la sogs pa gzungs kyi lha mo'i tshogs dang*/ gzhon nu gdong drug la sogs pa lha'i bu mthu bo che'i tshogs dang*/ lngas rtsen la sogs pa gtsug lag khang gi bdag po rnams dang*/ nor bzang dang gcen bcu la sogs pa sku gzugs srung ma'i tshogs dang*/ shānta rakṣi ta la sogs pa sngon gyi mkhan po'i tshogs dang*/ shī la a ti la sogs pa chos kyi rgyal po'i tshogs dang*/ dri za'i rgyal po la sogs pa ri dwags sman gyi lha'i tshogs rnams te/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi rgyan cha lugs dang ldan zhing rang rang gi g.yog 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas rnam bzhis bsdus pa'i rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyang mchod sbyin bzhes pa'i slad du ri rab kyi mtha' skor du 'khod par bsams la/ de nas thal mo sbyar la/ bdag gi rgyun bshags byed pa sems can thams cad kyis byed par bsams la/ sangs rgyas gtso la sogs pa lan gsum brjod/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs bzlas pa'i tshe/ rol mo ci 'byor dbul/ de nas mgron spyi la/ gtor ma gcig dang lha bshos gcig dbul zhing*/ dus gsum rgyal ba la sogs brjod/ de nas so so'i gtor ma rgyas par dbul ba la/ gtor ma gcig dang zhal zas dbul zhing*/ sarba buddha da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo sogs/ lan gsum gsum re dang*/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bla med zhes sogs brjod la dbul/ mchod pa 'bul zhes pa thams cad kyi rjes su/ bdud rtsi bsil dngar dam pas mchod// 'jig rten mtha' dag skyid pa dang*// bstan pa rgyas par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa thams cad la sbyar zhing*/ gtor ma snga ma gtang*/ yang phyi ma bshams la/ saddharma ratna/ saṃ gha bo dhi satwa/ sarba buddha bo dhi satwa/ sarba buddha bo dhi satwa sarba ma ṭi ka ādya kro dha a bhi mant+ra de ba/ ārya pra tye ka ārya shra ba ka

ārya ma hā sthā wi ra la kha ṭa da sha ārya a ha ra hata/ ādya ādya tsadya ma hā wā gī shwa ra shrī shapta swā ra/ bha ga wa ti ba sun dha ra shrī de wī/ buddha gu hya a dhi de wa/ buddha sa da sya/ rū pa dha dhū de ba/ ma hā pra hma ṇa sa dhi pa ti/ de wi ind+ra/ lo ka de ba/ ma hā tsa tu ra rā dza/ da sha di ka lo ka pā la/ maṅga la de ba/ de ba a su ra aṣṭa/ lo ka de ba/ shast+ra de ba/ dha ri ni de wi/ de wa ku ma ra/ be ha ra a ti/ be ha ra a dhi pa ti a dhi u pa ārya/ bho tra ku sha la mi tra tsa dharmā rā dza/ bho tra de wa/ thams cad kyi mthar sa pa ri wā ra sbyar/ de ltar so so'i gtor ma rdzogs pa dang*/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang*/ chos thams cad kyi zhes sogs lhug pa nas/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs par gyur cig gi bar lan cig brjod la/ gtor ma rnams gtsang sar dor ro// de nas rjes kyi bya ba la/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo// gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad kyis dbul/ snang stong rdo rje sogs rigs lnga'i bstod pa bya/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang*/ sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ zhes sogs kyi maṇḍal la bkod pa'i lha rnams gshegs su gsol/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung la bkra shis bya'o// ser/ byang chub sems dpa'/ sngo/ khro bo/ dkar/ rang rgyal/ ljang*/ nyan thos/ dmar/ gtsang ris dpal mgon/ tshon mdog go/ // ༄// gtor chen gyi lhan thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gi gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po bgyis pa 'di'i mthus/ yon bdag gam bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi nad dang*/ gdon dang bgegs dang*/ phyi dang nang gi bar du gcod pa dang*/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/

gzhan gyi rigs sngags dang*/ rbod gtong dang*/ byad dang*/ 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa'i gnod pa thams cad phyir bzlog tu gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ bstan pa dang sems can mang po la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed cing*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten dang gtsug lag khang la gnod par byed pa'i dgra dang bgegs thams cad zhi ba dang bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ gang dag zhi bas mi 'dul ba'i gdug pa can mchis na/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs su sprul nas/ bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs du ma dang bcas pas drag po'i las kyis gdug pa can de tshar gcad du gsol/ bdag gi nyes pa'i tshogs ci yang ma bgyis shing*/ gdug pa can 'di'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa grangs med par byas pas gdug pa can 'di tshar bcad par rigs so// rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// // ༄// gser sku rdo rje 'chang chen du mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo buddha ya/ gser sku rdo rje 'chang du mdzad na/ mtha' skor la rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang sems brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu rnams bla ma gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor yin pas mdzad na legs/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar kye rdo rje/ bde mchog khyung gi 'og dbu'i steng thad du chos rje seng ge ba sogs khang pa rang gi chos thob pa'i bla ma gang shong*/ ldem gnyis spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dbyangs su mdzad na don gyi rigs gsum mgon po tshang mar 'gyur/ gdan khri la rdo rje'i g.yas g.yon du gur mgon lcam dral/ de'i 'og bstar la phyogs skyong bcu/ rgyal po bzhi/ de'i 'og bstar mchod pa'i gzhi la dbus su dzambha la nag po/ g.yas su dzaṃ ser/ g.yon du nor rgyun ma/ rin chen sna bdun 'dod 'jo'i ba dang brgyad/

bkra shis rtags brgyad rnams gang shong ba bya/ khri'i gdong la yon bdag dang lha bzo ba 'di zhes bya bas/ dgos pa 'di'i ched du lo zla tshes grangs 'di la rab gnas grub par byas/ zhes sogs kyi dkar chag gzong gis brko/ thub dbang du mdzad na mtha' skor la sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga sprul sku rigs lnga'i phyag rgya can spel mar bya/ phrag gong g.yas g.yon du mar me mdzad dang byams pa gnyis/ khyung gi 'og tu bla ma sngar dang 'dra/ g.yas g.yon gyi ldem gnyis shā ri'i bu dang mauṅgal gyi bu gnyis/ khri'i 'bul dang dkar chag sngar dang 'dra/ thag tshad 'di bzhin byas na chen po gcig yong bar gda' bas/ khri sum cha/ sku sum cha/ sku'i steng gi rgyab yol sum cha byed par gda' na'ang*/ da lan khri mtho ba rten 'brel bzang bas sum cha byed/ rgyab yol kyi sum cha nas mtho do sku la bsnan na legs pa cig mchi/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs bris skur mdzad na dkyil 'khor thob thang yin pas bsod nams che/ gyang ris su mdzad na rgyun du lha 'ga' zhig dbu zhabs bsgyur nas bzhugs dgos pa de mi 'thad ces zer bas/ rang rang gi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i zhing khams re mdzod/ ras bris kyi grwa zur du sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i lha gang shong*/ steng bstar la so so'i dbang bka'i bla ma brgyud pa/ 'og bstar la chos skyong*/ phyogs skyong*/ rig ma bcu drug khro bcu sogs skabs su gang bab re bris pas khyab lags/ gser sku'i nang du nang rdzong gzhan pas gzungs rnams shog dril du 'jug pa bsod nams che/ gzungs rnams chos sku'i ring bsrel yin par gsungs gda'/ gos dar rnams gzungs kyi na bza' mdzad nas stod smad thams cad du bcug pas khyab/ yang gos dar gang 'dzom/ rin po che'i rigs dang 'bru sna zas sna bzang po dar ram ras kyi khud du gril ba rnams dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi 'khor lo nor lha'i gzungs/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rnams pad gdan gyi dbus su bzhugs/

pad gdan gyi nang gi g.yas g.yon gnyis su chos skyong phyogs skyong gza' rgyu skar/ rgyal chen sde bzhi sogs dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga'i gzungs rnams dar gyis gril nas dri bzangs dang lhan cig bzhag bla ma bzang po'i gdung rus dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa rang gi gdung rus la thub dbang ngam/ mi 'khrugs pa'am/ tshe dpag med sogs kyi par sku'am/ yang na tsha tsha chung ngu la gser tshon btang ba mang rab byas la gtsug tor nas thugs ka'i thad du bzhag pas chog thugs ka'i thad rang du nyid kyi rtsa ba'i yi dam gang yin gyi gser sku'am lder sku shing brkos sogs chung ngu cig byas la/ mu tig dang gser la sogs pa'i phreng bas brgyan// dri bzangs mang po dang lhan cig tu sku mdog dang mthun pa'i dar gyis gril/ de'i phyi nas shog bu sngon po la gser yig gis bcom ldan 'das che ge mo zhes bgyi bas bdag sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe 'dir tshe ring ba dang longs spyod rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs tshe 'di phyi gnyis ka la dmigs pa'i 'dod don gang yin pa bris la dkri/ de gos dar mang pos dkris la thugs kar bzhag gzungs kyi nang nas gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ tshe dpag med/ sbyong rgyud tshe dpag med rnams kyi gzungs tshar lnga brgya re tsam mang bar bris la/ mjug tu ma ma ā yuḥpuṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes pa bris la bcug na bza' ther ma'am dar gyi chos gos lta bu 'dug na gzungs kyi phyi g.yogs na bza'i tshul du dpung pa man chad skyil krung yan chad la mdun rgyab khyab pa mdzad pas rung*/ gzhan zhabs lh+wam sogs 'jug tu mi rung*/ gdung rus la tsha tsha'am lha sku byas na ma gtogs rus pa dngos su bcug na yul de la gnod par 'dul ba lung dang*/ rab gnas don gsal du bshad gda'/ gal te gzungs kyis kha ma khengs na/ lte ba man chad la spang spos dang shug pa zhib mor brdungs pa sogs spos sna mang po ras sam dar gyi khug mar bcug pa mang pos 'gengs/

lte ba man chad skyil krung yan chad la 'jam dpal dang*/ sdud pa sogs mdo phran gyi pusti'i bar bar du gur gum sogs dri bzangs po skam po'i phye ma gtor ba glegs shing med par byas pa gos dar dang rten khebs mang pos dril nas bzang logs yar bstan/ phyi logs mar bstan pa/ snga logs kyi gug skyed gser sku'i rgyab phyogs dang zhabs kyu mdun du bstan la gzhug pad gdan man chad ma khengs na/ 'bru sna dang zas sna mang po thum bur byas la bcug gnod sbyin gyi 'khor lo'i ma dpe rje btsun chen po'i phyag dpe ltar dag par bri/ sngags rnams kyi ring cha thung cha sogs shin du dag par byas nas phul yod pa 'di la ma dpe mdzad nas/ de 'bri ba'i byang bu 'byor na gser dngul leb brdungs/ ma 'byor na zangs leb brdungs srab 'jam gru bzhir byas pa la/ zangs dang dngul la gser/ gser la mtshal gyis bri/ 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags kyi bzlas pa dang*/ dkar gsum gyi gtor ma phul ba'i sgrub pa dge slong bzhis zhag bdun bya/ de nas 'khor lo'i mtha' ma la sbrang dkar po la gur gum dang ka ra phye ma btab pas byugs la steng 'og ma nor bar kha sbyar/ dar ram ras skud ser po mdud pa med pas rgya gram du 'khor lo nub nub kyi dkri/ de gos dar ser po mang pos dkris la gzhug go /mo 'khor 'og pho 'khor steng*/ ma ṇi bha dra dang tsand+ra kānt+yai gnyis shar du yong ba byed dgos/ pad gzungs ma gtogs gzhan rnams gdung rus kyi bris kyang chog cing bsod nams che/ pad gzungs rnams la nor lha'i sngags rnams nges par gser dngul gyis bri/ chos skyong phyogs skyong sogs gser dngul ma 'byor na mtshal dang snag tshas bris kyang rung*/ spyir pad gzungs gdung rus la 'bri ye mi nyan/ gzungs gzhug byed pa'i sngon du gzungs rnams la rab gnas re bya/ gser sku dang nang rdzong rnams la sbyang ba gsum sngon du 'gro bas bgegs bskrad bya/

nang du 'jug mkhan gyi mi dge slong sdom brtson dang*/ grogs byed kyi mi dge tshul dang dge bsnyen sogs gtsang mas byed/ thams cad kyis khrus bya/ gos bzang po gyon/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad 'don bzhin du las byed/ ja bur/ mar thud/ zho 'bras sogs dkar gsum gyis thams cad tshim par byed pa phyis kyang longs spyod kyi rten 'brel du gda'/ 'di bzhin mdzad pas yon mchod sku tshe brtan zhing 'byor pa rgyas pa dang shin du bkra shis par 'gyur ro// ā nanta bha dras sbyar ba'o// //

༄༅// gnod sbyin gyi 'khor lo'i sngags la zhus dag mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /mo 'khor gyi lte ba la/ oṃ ba su dhā ri nor 'dzin ma ṇyai kye ma bdag la ma dha naṃ nor de hi stsol stsol de hi swā hā/ shar gyi pad 'dab la/ oṃ tsand+ra kānt+yai ma ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ shar lhor/ oṃ su bha dra yai ma ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ lhor/ oṃ dattā yai ma ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ lho nub tu/ oṃ guptā ye ma ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ nub tu/ oṃ su dattā yai ma ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ nub byang du/ oṃ de byai ma ma dha daṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ byang du/ oṃ ārya yai ma ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ byang shar du/ oṃ dbyangs can ma sa ra swa tyai ma bdag la ma nor dha naṃ de hi stsol stsol de hi swā hā// pho 'khor gyi lte bar/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya ma ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ shar gyi 'dab mar/ oṃ ma ṇi bha drā ya ma ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ shar lhor/ oṃ tsa rend+rā ye ma ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ lhor/ oṃ bai shrā wa ṇā ya ma ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ lho nub tu/ oṃ mu khend+ra ye ma ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ nub tu/ oṃ dha na dā ye ma ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ nub byang du/ oṃ rtsi mi kuṇḍa la ye ma ma naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ byang du/ oṃ pūrṇa bha drā ye ma ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ byang shar du/ oṃ ki rol pa'i li mā phreng ba li na ye kye ma bdag la ma dha nor naṃ de hi de stsol stsol hi swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di rnams mus pa'i lha chen gyi 'khor lo 'bri dus/ rje nyid kyis zhu dag mdzad nas dag par yod pa 'di bzhin ring thung 'dogs 'brel rnams ma nor par ci lta ba bzhin bri'o//

// ༄// dge tshul gyi bslab bya mdor bsdus pa rags sdom bcu'i 'bru 'grel bzhugs so// ༈ /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dge tshul gyi bslab bya ni/ rags sdom bcu ste/ ji skad du/ gang zhig srog gcod gzhan gyi nor 'phrog dang*// mi gtsang spyod rdzun bcos pa'i chang la sogs// gar sogs phreng sogs mal stan mtho ba dang*// phyi dro'i kha zas gser dngul len pa spang*// zhes pa ltar ro// de la dang po srog gcod ni/ gzhi bsam pa sbyor ba mthar thug ste/ yan lag bzhi tshang na pham par 'gyur te/ de la gzhi ni mi'am mir chags pa/ bsam pa ma 'khrul zhing gsod par 'dod pa/ sbyor ba dug mtshon mthu g.yo sgyu'i 'chi bar gtong ba/ gzhan gyis gsod par zhu ba gnang ba/ gnod sems kyis bsad 'os su ston pa sogs rang ngam bskos pa'i mis mi 'gyod par bsad par brtsams pa'o// mthar thug rkyen de rnams kyi shi ba'o// gnyis pa ma byin len la/ gzhi'i yan lag mi yi yin pa rang las nor tha dad pa'i rdzas rin thang tshang ba ste/ bod du dngul skya zho gang gi brgyad cha brkus na rin thang tshang ngo*// bsam pa'i yan lag gzhan gyi rdzas yin par shes pa/ rang gi ched du thob 'dod rgyun mi chad pa/ sbyor ba thabs sna tshogs kyis rang ngam gzhan rkur 'jug par brtsam pa/ mthar thug gi yan lag brkus nas thob blo skyes pa'o// gsum pa mi tshangs spyod la/ gzhi'i yan lag bud med kyi kha bshang lam zag byed de gsum du nor bu las su rung bar stsal pa/ bsam pa'i yan lag 'du shes 'khrul ma 'khrul ba 'dra zhing*/ gnyis sbyor bdag gi byed 'dod rgyun mi chad pa/ sbyor ba'i yan lag mi tshangs spyod pa byed par brtsams pa/ mthar thug gi yan lag bcug cing nyams su myong ba'o// bzhi pa rdzun ni/ gzhi smra ba'i yul mi yin pa/ smra shes don go shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa/ ma ning dang mtshan gnyis pa ma yin pa la zag med kyi yon tan bzang po yod par shes pa'i tshig go

/bsam pa 'du shes ma 'khrul ba/ sbyor ba rang gi ngag gis mi chos bla ma rang gi thob par smra ba brtsams pa/ mthar thug smra zhing yul des go ba'o// lnga pa chang sogs ni/ phab btab pa 'bru'i chang dang*/ ma btab pa bur chang*/ rgun chang sogs myos par 'gyur ba'i chang hub gcig yan mid na ltung bar 'gyur ro// drug pa gar sogs ni/ dgod pa'i bsam pas/ glu dang*/ gar dang*/ rol mo sna tshogs dgos med du byed pa'o// bdun pa phreng sogs ni/ sor gdub dang*/ gos khra bo dang*/ dgos med du li khri la sogs pa byug pa dang*/ spos lus la byug pa dang*/ me tog phreng ba'i thod bcing ba rnams so// brgyad pa mal stan mtho ba ni/ rin po che dang ba so la sogs pa'i khri khru gang las lhag pa la 'dug pa dang*/ nyal ba dang*/ de bzhin du stan khru gang las lhag pa la dgos pa med par 'dug pa dang nyal ba'o// dgu pa phyi dro'i kha zas ni/ gling 'di'i nyi ma phyed yol nas/ sang gi skya rengs dang po ma shar bar la/ nad la sogs pa'i rkyen med par/ phye dang thud la sogs pa dus rung gi zas bza' ba'o// bcu pa gser dngul len pa ni/ gser dang dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che chos ldan gyi rkyen med bzhin du/ bdag tu bzung na'o// 'di rnams la rtsa ba bzhi nyams na slar gso rgyu med/ lhag ma drug nyams na sdom ldan gyi drung du bshags la nyes pas ma gos par bya'o// dge tshul gyi bslab bya mdor bsdus pa ste/ rgyas par 'od ldan du shes par bya'o// // ༄// bka' gyur ro cog gi dkar chag bstan pa gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rin po che 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag bstan pa gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// phun tshogs dge legs rgya mtsho'i dpal las 'khrungs// ji lta ji snyed gzigs pa'i rba rlabs g.yo// phrin las yid bzhin nor bu'i gter mnga' ba// dpal ldan bla ma yid bzhin rgya mtshor 'dud// 'gro ba'i don slad byang chub thugs bskyed nas// dpag med dus nas tshogs gnyis rdzogs mdzad pas// byang chub brnyes nas chos 'khor rab bskor ba// sangs rgyas skyabs kyi yul la gus phyag 'tshal// de gsung zhi ba chags bral gsung rab tshogs// sems kyi tha ba ma lus rlan byed cing*// dge legs thar pa'i lo thog rab bskrun pa// dam chos bdud rtsi'i dpal la bdag cag dad// de bcud thos bsam snyim pas gus blangs nas// nyams len ro 'dzin dbang pos legs myangs pas// 'gro la phan bde'i dga' ston bskrun mdzad pa// tshogs mchog dge 'dun kun nas rgyal gyur cig

/gang la dpag yas mthu stobs spyan stong ldan// rnam dag phrin las ye shes rdo rje yis// nag phyogs lha min g.yul ngo 'joms mdzad pa// bka' srung nag po chen pos bstan pa skyongs// de ltar yul khyad par can du gyur pa rnams la mchod par brjod nas/ skabs kyi don ni/ 'gro ba'i phun tshogs bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rag las shing*/ bstan pa'i ngo bo yang lung dang rtogs pa'i dam pa'i chos ji skad bshad pa bzhin nyid yin no// de'i phyir bstan pa mig 'bras ltar gces par 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams kyis bsgrub pa nyams len gyi tshul gyis rtogs pa'i chos 'dzin dgos la/ de la lung gi chos shes pa sngon du 'gro dgos te/ ma shes na nyams su len du med pa'i phyir ro// lung gi chos de ji ltar shes pa'i thabs kyang yi ger bkod pa'i gsung rab la nan tan du byed pa kho na yin no// de bas na/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba phyogs gcig gsung rab rnams yi ger bri ba dang*/ dag par bya ba dang*/ glegs bam gzhan dag la rgya cher spel ba dag yin cing*/ mdo sde rin po che za ma tog bkod pa dbang gi rgyal por yang*/ phyi ma'i dus su nga nyid yig 'bru'i gzugs kyis sems can la chos ston to// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ glegs bam rnams ston pa nyid kyang yin par bshad pas bstan pa la dbang phyug gi sgo nas bya ba tshul bzhin du byed par 'dod pa'i skye bo blo gros can dag gis/ gsung rab rin po che rnams glegs bam du 'bri ba dang*/ tshig dang*/ don gyi zhus dag legs par byed pa la 'bad par bya ba 'di nyid shin du rigs pa yin no// don gyi dbang 'di gzigs nas/ rmad du byung ba'i rigs dang rus dang*/ cho 'brang dang ldan zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i longs spyod dang*/ 'khor dang*/ sde srid rab tu mang po la mnga' bsgyur ba/ bstan pa rin po che dang*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa thams cad la shes nas dad pa thob pa/

rgyal ba'i bstan pa la zhugs pa'i dge bsnyen/ theg chen sems bskyed kyis rgyud gtams shing*/ 'gro ba mgon med pa dang*/ log par ltung ba sogs sdug bsngal can du gyur pa rnams la lhag par snying brtse la dngos su phan pa lhur mdzad pa'i rgyal sras chen po/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i brtul zhugs mchog la gnas pa'i sngags 'chang dam pa/ dpon po ya ma dpal bzang po rgyal mtshan zhes rnam par grags pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' ris kyi sa cha glo bo stod kyi bkra shis kyi gnas su sku 'khrungs pa/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams mang po la mnga' bsgyur ba'i sa bdag chen po khrims gnyis 'dzin pa des/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa sgo thams cad nas rgyas par bya ba dang*/ khyad par mnga' ris kyis phyogs su bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus nas brtsams te yun ring mo'i bar la bstan pa rin po che rma med par gnas su zin kyang*/ dus ha cang ring du gyur pa'i dbang gis glegs bam 'ga' zhig 'thor nas deng sang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi glegs bam tshang ba phyogs gcig mi bzhugs pa'i mun pas khyab pa'i skabs 'dir/ bka' 'gyur ro cog gi nyi ma'i 'od zer/ mnga' ris kyi sa'i cha thams cad du shar bar bya'o snyam pa'i dgongs pa zab mo thugs la shar ba ltar phyag len du btab nas bris pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i chos skor dang*/ rgyu phar phyin theg pa'i chos skor las/ re zhig dang por rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i glegs bam rnams la/ rgyud 'bum zhes rnam par grags pa la pusti nyi shu bzhugs pa'i/ ka pa la/ dpal kye rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa'i gnyis pa grub chen ga ya dha ra dang rje btsun 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ bshad pa'i rgyud mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud kyi rgyal po ga ya dha ra dang 'brog mi lotstsha ba'i 'gyur/ kye rdo rje 'bum phrag lnga pa'i bshad rgyud dpal phyag rgya chen po'i thig le paṇḍi ta shes rab gsang ba dang kaṃ chos kyi ye shes dang phyug mtshams dgra bcom rnams kyi 'gyur/

dpal ye shes snying po rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po paṇḍi ta shes rab gsang ba'i 'gyur/ dpal ye shes thig le shes rab gsang ba'i 'gyur/ dpal de kho na nyid sgron me paṇḍi ta shes rab gsang ba'i 'gyur/ rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi gsang ba dpal yang dag par sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ bod na sambu ṭa zhes bya ba/ rtsa rgyud la brtag pa bcu/ rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa grub chen ga ya dha ra dang rje btsun shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur zhing phyis kyang 'brog mi nyid kyis zhus dag mdzad pa ste/ chos kyi rnam grangs bdun bzhugs pa ni dpal kye rdo rje'i chos skor ro// kha pa la/ rgyud kyi rgyal po bde mchog nyung ngu zhes bya ba bod na bde mchog rtsa rgyud du grags pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po padma kā ra dang lotstsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba las slad kyi su ma ti kīrti dang mal jo blo gros grags kyi 'gyur/ nges par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ bod na a bhi dha na'am mngon brjod bla ma zhes grags pa le'u drug cu rtsa dgu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na shrī dang blo gros snying po dang dge slong rab zhis bsgyur ba/ rnal 'byor ma kun du spyod pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di la 'gyur byang mi 'dug kyang*/ grags mchog shes rab kyi 'gyur yin pa 'dra'o// dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud paṇḍi ta a tu la badzra dang*/ la chings yon tan 'bar gyis 'gyur te chos kyi rnam grangs bzhi bzhugs/ ga pa la/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang lotstsha ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud kyi rgyal po paṇḍi ta dza ya se na dang*/ lotstsha ba dar ma yon tan gyis 'gyur te chos kyi rnam grangs gnyis bzhugs/

nga pa la/ dpal bde mchog sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud khe rgad 'khor lo grags kyis 'gyur/ mai tri mkha' spyod kyi rgyud chung ngu dar ma yon tan gyi 'gyur/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi kha sbyor zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po la 'grel ba glan dar ma blo gros kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje phag mo mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal sgyu ma chen po paṇḍi ta zhi ba bzang po dang glog skya shes rab brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ bde mchog bshad rgyud du 'dod pa ra li'i skor la/ gsang ba rdo rje'i rgyud/ gsang ba spyod pa'i rgyud/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud/ nam mkha' chen po'i rgyud/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud/ rin chen phreng ba'i rgyud/ dam tshig chen po'i rgyud/ stobs po che'i rgyud/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba'i rgyud/ ye shes phreng ba'i rgyud/ ye shes 'bar ba'i rgyud/ dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud/ zla ba phreng ba'i rgyud/ rin chen 'bar ba'i rgyud/ nyi ma 'khor lo'i rgyud/ ye shes rgyal po'i rgyud/ mkha' 'gro sdom pa'i rgyud/ gsang ba me 'bar gyi rgyud 'di rnams la ra li'i rgyud skor zhes gnyos lotstsha ba yon tan grags kyis byas pa'i rgyud the tshom can du bzhed na'ang*/ sngon gyi rgyud 'bum thams cad du bris 'dug pa dang rdzogs rim gyi gdams ngag zab mo mang po 'dug pas 'dir bris so// dpal gtum po khro bo chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba bod na mi g.yo bla med du grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal gyi sku drin las lotstsha ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba ste chos kyi rnam grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhugs/ ca pa la/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma smṛ ti'i rang 'gyur/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po paṇḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang lotstsha ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyi 'gyur/

rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/ rgyud kyi rgyal po zla gsang thig le mchog tu gsang ba zhes bya ba gnyan ban bsod nams kyis 'gyur/ dpal mgon po nag po mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta ā nanta dang rwa rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/ mi g.yo ba'i rgyud gsang ba chen po le'u bzhi pa/ lag na rdo rje drag po gsum 'dul zhes bya ba 'khor lo chen po'i rgyud dge slong chos bzang gi 'gyur dang*/ bde khros kyi rgyud/ gsang ba bdud rtsi'i rgyud/ dpal chags pa'i rgyud/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba'i rgyud de bzhi po the tshom can yin yang sngon gyi rgyud 'bum thams cad du bris 'dug pas 'dir yang bris so// de ltar na chos kyi rnam grangs bcu gcig bzhugs/ cha pa la/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde ba mchog gi rtsa ba'i rgyud rtog pa bcu pa/ de'i rgyud phyi ma rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa zhes bya ba smṛ ti'i rang 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi rtsa ba'i rgyud paṇḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i bshad pa'i rgyud mant+ra aṃ sa ga ya dha ra dang 'gos kyi 'gyur/ gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga le'u gsum pa 'di slob dpon ārya de was mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor snying po mdor bsags zhes grags pa de yin pas rgyud 'bum gyi nang du 'bri don med kyang*/ sngon gyi rgyud 'bum dkar po dang gser ma thams cad na bris 'dug cing mdzad pa po sangs rgyas dang khyad med pas de lan yang bzhugs su gsol/ de ltar na chos kyi rnam grangs lnga bzhugs/ ja pa la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa phan yon dang bcas pa 'di bla med dang rnal 'byor rgyud gnyis char du bshad pa yin yang*/ nyi ma dpal ye shes kyis dus 'khor dang sgo bstun nas bshad pa ltar 'dir lhan cig tu bris so// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud le'u lnga pa paṇḍi ta sa manta shrī dang lotstsha ba rwa chos rab kyi 'gyur/

rgyud phyi ma lotstsha ba dar ma grags kyis 'gyur/ rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu dbang mdor bstan pa'i rgyud 'phro shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ bsdus rgyud las byung ba'i dbang gi rang byed rwa chos rab kyi 'gyur/ don dam bsnyen pa 'di padma dkar pos mdzad pa yin kyang*/ pad dkar spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa yin pas sngon gyi rgyud 'bum pa rnams kyis bkar bzhag go /dus 'khor bsdus rgyud kyi snying po gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ bla ma'i yon tan yongs bzung gi rgyud rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags kyis bsgyur ba ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor brgyad dang*/ rdo rje a ralli'i le'u bcu pa/ rigs kyi a ralli'i le'u lnga pa/ rgyud kyi rgyal po rnyog pa med pa ste/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud chung ngu gsum du grags pa rje btsun 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ ma hā mā ya'i rgyud 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ bde chen ral gcig khro phu lotstsha ba byams pa dpal gyis 'gyur te/ chos kyi rnam grangs bcu bzhi bzhugs so// nya pa la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa dang*/ rgyud phyi ma shraddha ka ra warma dang lotstsha ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dgongs pa lung ston pa'i rgyud paṇḍi ta dharmā shrī dang rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje phreng ba mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud lha bla ma zhi ba 'od kyi 'gyur/ lha mo bzhis zhus pa'i rgyud smṛ ti'i 'gyur/ ye shes rdo rjes kun las btus pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud ste/ chos kyi rnam grangs drug bzhugs so// ta pa la/ dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud lha btsun pa ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba bu ston kha che'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed dmar po le'u bcu dgu pa paṇḍi ta tsand+ra kīrti dang lotstsha ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis 'gyur/

dpal gshin rje gshed kyis rgyud le'u rtsa gnyis pa bu ston kha che'i 'gyur/ dpal gshin rje gshed dgra nag gi rgyud shes rab brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ gdong drug gi rgyud las thams cad 'grub par byed pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo'i rtog pa 'di the tshom can du mdzad do// rdo rje 'jigs byed rtog pa bdun pa'i rgyud rwa lotstsha ba'i 'gyur/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po lotstsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba ste/ chos kyi rnam grangs dgu bzhugs so// thabs shes zung 'jug ston pa mchog gi rgyud// mtha' drug tshul bzhis gsang bas rgyas btab pa// zab mo'i rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i mdo// bcu phrag bdun dang bdun gyis lhag pa bzhugs// tha pa la/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud 'phags pa de kho na nyid 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ rgyud nye bar bsdu ba dang bcas pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa zhes bya ba kun rig gi rgyud paṇḍi ta shāntiṃ garbha dang lotstsha ba dza ya rakṣi tas bsgyur ba las rma rin chen mchog gi skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa ste/ chos kyi rnam grangs gnyis bzhugs so// da pa la/ bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje rtse mo rgya gar gyi mkhan po karmā badzra dang lotstsha ba gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis 'gyur/ dpal mchog dang po theg pa chen po'i rtog pa'i rgyal po las dpal mchog shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul yan chad rgya gar gyi mkhan po shardhā ka ra warma dang lotstsha ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ de man chad rgyud yongs su rdzogs pa paṇḍi ta mant+ra ka la sha dang lotstsha ba lha bla ma zhi ba 'od kyi 'gyur te/ chos kyi rnam grangs gnyis bzhugs/ na pa la/ rdo rje phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bu chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen pos bsgyur ba/

yo ga rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas bsgyur ba'i 'phro dpang lotstsha ba blo gros brtan pas rdzogs par bsgyur ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gsang ba rgyan kyi bkod pa'i rgyud 'phags pa gsang ba'i nor bu thig le'i rgyud de/ 'di gsum la chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas bsgyur ba'i yo ga rgyud gsum zhes grags so// 'phags pa rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ sa 'og gi gsang ba chen po le'u gcig dang bcas pa/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta'i 'gyur/ rgyud 'dir bya rgyud kyi skabs dang*/ 'og gi phur pa rtsa dum bla med kyi skabs su 'bri rgyu yin na yang*/ 'gyur mdzad pa po gcig pa dang sngon gyi rgyud 'bum pa rnams kyis phyogs gcig tu bris pa ltar 'dir yang bris so// lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud le'u bdun pa the tshom can du 'chad do// 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i rgyud le'u bzhi pa nag tsho lotstsha ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gsang ba'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ de'i phyi ma le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa ste/ chos kyi rnam grangs brgyad bzhugs so// pa pa la/ yo ga'i bshad rgyud 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa chen po/ yo ga thams cad gsang ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur te/ de ltar na pusti tha pa dang da pa gnyis na gang bzhugs dang*/ na pa na chos rje pas bsgyur ba'i yo ga rgyud gsum/ pa pa 'dir khams gsum rnam rgyal/ thams cad gsang ba/ rab gnas kyi rgyud 'di rnams yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud du gtogs pa yin no// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi de nyid bcu// thabs shes gnyis su phye nas ston pa'i gzhung*// rnal 'byor rgyud ces yongs su grags pa'i mdo// bcu phrag gcig dang gcig gis lhag pa bzhugs// bya ba'i rgyud dam tshig gsum bkod pa kṛṣṇa paṇḍ-i ta dang lotstsha ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/

rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud 'bro shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ sgrol ma las sna tshogs 'byung ba'i rgyud le'u so lnga pa chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ ku ru kulle'i rtog pa kṛṣṇa paṇḍi ta dang tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ gos sngon can rdo rje be con gyi rgyud le'u bco lnga pa dang*/ gos sngon can rdo rje me lce'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa 'di gnyis brdzus mar snang yang*/ sngon gyi rgyud 'bum pa rnams kyis bris pa ltar bzhag ste/ chos kyi rnam grangs brgyad bzhugs so// pha pa la/ spyod pa'i rgyud rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bidyā ka ra sidha dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ de'i rgyud phyi ma shī lend+ra bo dhi dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud phyi ma le'u bcu pa phyi ma'i phyi ma le'u lnga pa ste/ chos kyi rnam grangs bzhi bzhugs so// ba pa la/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rtog pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud chen po rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal dga' ba'i bshes gnyen dang lotstsha ba mang 'or chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur ba bzhugs/ ma pa la/ 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje mngon par dbang bskur ba'i rgyud chen po 'di dpe thams cad na 'gyur byang mi snang yang*/ sngon gyi bka' bcad du ye shes sde'i 'gyur yod bya ba 'dug pas brtag go /'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/ gsang ba spyi rgyud dam pa/ dkyil 'khor chen po bkod pa'i rgyud/ spyan ras gzigs padma cod paṇa gyi rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa rong zom chos bzang gi 'gyur/ 'di rgyud the tshom can du bzhed do// de ltar na chos kyi rnam grangs bzhi bzhugs/ tsa pa la/ 'phags pa rig pa mchog gi rgyud kyi rgyal po bzhugs so// tsha pa la/ legs par grub pa'i rgyud chen po mi g.yo ba'i rgyud le'u bdun pa mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/

'phags pa mi g.yo ba brtul phod pa 'dul bar gsung pa'i rtog pa dar ma blo gros kyis 'gyur/ 'phags pa dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i gzungs/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud/ lotstsha ba chos kyi shes rab kyis 'gyur/ klu skrag pa'i khro bo 'byung po 'dul byed 'di brdzus mar snang yang sngon gyi rgyud 'bum rnams su bris pa ltar bzhag go /de ltar na chos kyi rnam grangs bdun bzhugs so// dza pa la/ ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rtog pa chen po zhes bya ba sgrol ma'i rgyud sgrub thabs kyi cho ga rim pa yan chad bzhugs/ wa yi srog yig a pa la/ de'i smad rgyud phyi ma dang*/ bcas pa lotstsha ba rin chen grub kyis bsgyur ba bzhugs/ ting 'dzin mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ lus ngag rnam par dag par byed pa'i tshul// gnyis med sbyor ba bya dang spyod pa'i mod// bcu phrag gnyis dang dgu yis brgyan pa bzhugs// bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag bstan pa gsal ba'i sgron me las/ rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs bshad pa ste skabs dang po'o// //da ni bya ba'i rgyud kyi bye brag gzungs 'dus gzungs 'bul gnyis su grags pa las/ dang po gzungs 'dus la glegs bam chen po gnyis 'byung ba/ 'di gras kyi dbang gis glegs bam gsum du byas pa'i/ ka pa la/ spyan 'dren rgyud gsum pa/ 'di bka' min kyang gzungs klog pa'i sngon du 'di mchod yul dang*/ chos kyi sbyin pa gtong ba'i yul rnams spyan drangs nas/ gzungs klog pas chos kyi sbyin par 'gyur la/ de'i spyan 'dren gyi tshig dang por bkod par snang ngo*// 'phags pa dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs/ shes rab bskyed pa'i gzungs/ sgrol ma mchog gi gzungs/ yangs pa can gyi grong khyer du 'jug pa'i gzungs/ stobs po che'i gzungs/
