nor rgyun ma'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/ 'phags pa dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ khyad par can gyi gzungs/ rgyal ba can gyi gzungs/ rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar rmongs byed kyi gzungs/ phyir bzlog rnam par rgyal ba can gyi gsang sngags/ mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo/ tsandan gyi yan lag gi gzungs/ 'phags pa gzungs chen mo/ gser can gyi gzungs/ be con chen po'i gzungs/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rdo rje mchu zhes bya ba'i klu rnams kyi dam tshig bya khyung mchu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa sprin chen po le'u drug cu rtsa bzhi pa cho ga dang bcas pa/ chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i mdo/ sgo mtha' yas pa bsgrub pa'i gzungs/ gtsug tor rol pa'i tant+ra/ 'di sa skya paṇḍi ta chen pos bod kyi lha 'dres byas par bzhed pa ltar don la gnas so// 'phags pa sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi snying po zhes bya ba'i mdo/ lag na rdo rje'i mtshan gsang sngags dang bcas pa'i gzungs/ lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po// sdong po rgyan gyi mchog 'di yang the tshom can no// bgegs sel ba'i mdo/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs/ rten cing 'brel pa 'byung ba'i mdo/ gsang ba ring bsrel za ma tog gi gzungs/ gdon mi za ba'i nye ba'i snying po/ 'phags pa snang brgyad 'di'ang the tshom can no// 'phags pa sgo bzang po/ lha mo rol pa/ 'di'ang the tshom can te chos kyi rnam grangs sum cu so bdun bzhugs/ kha pa la/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i gzungs/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs/ bar du gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas snying po'i gzungs zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po'i gzungs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i snying po'i gzungs/ tshe dpag med kyi gzungs kyi mdo/ me tog brtsegs pa'i gzungs/

sa'i dbang po chen po'i gzungs/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar can gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gzungs/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gzungs/ gtsug gi nor bu'i gzungs/ dbyig dang ldan pa'i gzungs/ bu mang po rton pa'i gzungs/ chos thams cad kyi yum gyi gzungs/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhus pa'i gzungs/ tshogs bdag gi gzungs/ yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags/ sher phyin sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ mig rnam par sbyong ba'i rig sngags/ mdangs phyir 'phrog pa'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yan lag dang ldan pa'i gzungs/ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa'i gzungs/ lha mo 'od zer can gyi gzungs/ gzhang 'brum rab tu zhi ba'i gzungs/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba'i gzungs/ dug sel ba'i rig sngags/ rims nad rab tu zhi ba'i gzungs/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa rin po che phreng ba'i gzungs/ phyir bzlog stobs chen gyi gzungs/ nag po chen po'i rims nad thams cad las thar pa'i gzungs/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo dbugs chen mo zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi gzungs sngags/ mig nad rab tu zhi ba/ sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa las/ thog mar sangs rgyas kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi byams pa'i/ nam mkha'i snying po'i/ kun tu bzang po'i/ phyag na rdo rje'i/ 'jam dpal gyi/ sgrib pa rnam sel gyi/ sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ smon lam btab pa bzhin 'grub pa'i gzungs/ kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba'i gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi mtshan dang gzungs chung ba/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs/ don yod zhags pa'i gzungs/ gza' yum gyi gzungs/ mi rgod rnam 'joms/ spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong rgya cher yongs su rdzogs pa thogs pa med pa'i gzungs/ thugs rje chen po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/

byang chub snying po rgyan 'bum/ las kyi sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba/ lus kyi dbyibs mdzes pa/ 'jam dpal shes rab blo 'phel gyi gzungs/ dpal chen mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis pa/ dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur ba/ lha mo nag mo'i gzungs/ gnod sbyin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ chu dbang snying rje can gyi gzungs/ nor bu bzang po'i gzungs/ stong 'khyil pa'i gzungs/ yon tan bsngags pa dpag tu med pa'i gzungs/ 'jam dpal gyi sngags yig 'bru gcig pa/ gzhan gyi mi thub pa chen po/ mdze nad gso ba'i gzungs/ so rtsil btab pa/ khros pa zhi ba/ 'jam dpal yig 'bru gcig pa'i sngags/ 'brum bu'i nad zhi ba/ shākya thub pa'i gzungs/ nad zhi ba'i gzungs/ don thams cad 'grub pa'i gzungs/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po'i gzungs/ nam mkha'i snying po'i gzungs/ ngan song yongs su sbyong ba'i gzungs/ ma zhu ba'i nad zhi ba gnyis/ sman la sngags kyis btab pa/ sher phyin gyi snying po/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i snying po/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo'i snying po/ so so 'brang ma'i snying po/ rma bya chen mo'i snying po/ nad med pa'i gzungs/ shlau ka stong lobs pa'i gzungs/ brgya lobs pa'i gzungs/ rims nad med pa'i gzungs/ rgyal ba'i bla ma'i gzungs/ skran zhi ba/ khros pa zhi ba/ thos pa 'dzin pa/ shlau ka sum stong 'dzin pa'i gzungs/ zas rnyed pa'i gzungs/ bltas pa dga' ba'i gzungs/ tshig btsan pa'i gzungs/ thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs/ rmi lam ston pa'i gzungs/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa/ skrangs pa zhi ba/ sdig pa zhi ba/ bdag srung ba/ thos pa 'dzin pa gong 'og gnyis/ padma'i spyan gyi gzungs/ shlau ka stong lobs pa/ gcan gzan gyis mi tshugs pa/ dran pa bskyed pa/ mgon po nag po'i gzungs/ gsang ba ring bsrel za ma tog gi gzungs/ rdo rje ri rab chen po'i zom gyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/

dpal ldan lha mo'i gzungs/ lha mo nag mo'i gzungs/ lha mo nag mo la bstod pa 'di bstan bcos yin yang sngon ma rnams kyi bris pa ltar bzhag go /'od zer can gyi gzungs/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi gzungs/ lang dkar gshegs pa'i gzungs/ nī la kaṇṭha'i gzungs/ lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa/ lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs/ me kha la'i gzungs/ yi dwags kha la me 'bar la skyabs mdzad pa'i gzungs/ sher phyin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ sher phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu pa/ sher phyin yi ge nyung ngu*/ rdo rje gnam lcags mchu'i gzungs/ 'phags pa bi ta'i rig pa'i rgyal mo/ 'phags pa rdo rje snying po'i gzungs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo ste/ chos kyi rnam grangs brgya dang sum cu bzhugs/ ga pa la/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa'i cho ga zhib mo/ spyan ras gzigs gsang ba'i mdzod thogs pa med pa'i yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i snying po bande chos 'grub kyis bsgyur ba/ spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i gzungs/ spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin 'khor lo smon lam 'byung ba/ nī la kaṇṭha'i gzungs/ 'phags pa gzungs grwa lnga/ yang 'phags pa bsil ba'i tshal lotstsha ba blo gros bzang po'i 'gyur/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin sa bzang lotstsha ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba ste chos kyi rnam grangs bcu gsum bzhugs so// gang gis dran cing zlos pa'i mod tsam la// phun tshogs dngos grub dpal kun thob 'gyur ba// bya ba'i rgyud dang rtogs pa'i phun tshogs gzhung*// brgya phrag gcig dang drug cus brgyan pa bzhugs// bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag bstan pa gsal ba'i sgron me las/ gzungs 'dus kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs bshad pa ste skabs gnyis pa'o// gnyis pa bya ba'i rgyud kyi bye brag gzungs 'bum la pusti drug yod pa'i/

ka pa la/ spyan 'dren rgyud gsum pa/ 'phags pa dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs/ yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po sngags dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/ ye shes phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin/ rdo rje snying po'i gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i sems can thams cad la gzigs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing bkod pa kun du ston pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi smon lam rgyas pa'i mdo brgyad brgya pa/ sgo mtha' yas pa bsgrub pa'i gzungs/ chos nyid rang bzhin gyis ngo bo nyid las mi g.yo bar thams cad la tha dad par snang ba'i mdo/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i gzungs/ sher phyin ko'u shi ka sher phyin yi ge nyung ngu*/ shes rab snying po/ sher phyin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sher phyin gyi gzungs/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i snying po'i gzungs/ tsandan yan lag gi gzungs/ dbang bskur ba'i gzungs/ dbyig dang ldan pa'i gzungs/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgrol ba'i gzungs/ me tog brtsegs pa'i gzungs/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs/ sgo drug pa'i gzungs/ shes pa thams cad mthar phyin par grub pa'i mchod rten zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ mchod rten gcig btab na bye ba gdab pa'i gzungs/ gsang ba ring bsrel gyi gzungs/ byang chub snying po rgyan 'bum gyi gzungs/ gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba'i gzungs te chos kyi rnam grangs bdun cu don brgyad bzhugs/ kha pa la/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po las bam po bcu dgu pa yan chad bzhugs/ ga pa la/ de'i 'phro bam po nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa yan chad bzhugs te da dung 'phro ma 'gyur ro// 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po le'u nyi shu rtsa dgu pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rend+ra bo dhi dang*/ bande rnam par mi rtog gis bsgyur ba/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde dbang po'i rgyal po chung ba le'u nyi shu pa ste chos kyi rnam grangs gsum bzhugs/

nga pa la/ 'phags pa 'dus pa rin po che tog gi gzungs le'u bcu gsum pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang gi cho ga zhib mo'i gzungs dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sgo bzang po'i gzungs/ ri rab brtsegs pa'i gzungs/ stobs po che'i gzungs/ rgyal ba can gyi gzungs/ 'phags pa rgyal ba can gyi gzungs/ me ltar rab tu rmongs byed ma'i gzungs/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa rin po che'i phreng ba'i gzungs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzungs/ lag na rdo rje mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ lag na rdo rje'i ming brgyad gsang sngags dang bcas pa/ lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi cho ga'i gzungs/ bdud rtsi thab sbyor bzhi'i snying po bzhi pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sher phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu pa/ sher phyin sgo nyi shu lnga pa/ ye shes ta la'i gzungs/ las kyi sgrib pa rnam par sbyang ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs te chos kyi rnam grangs nyi shu bzhugs/ ca pa la/ stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa'i mdo/ rma bya chen mo'i mdo/ so so 'brang ma'i mdo/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo/ gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa'i mdo/ gzungs chen grwa lngar grags pa dang*/ kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun pa'i mdo/ mdo chen po 'dus pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i mdo/ sprin chen po'i mdo/ klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs su bcad pa/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhus pa'i gzungs/ gnam lcags mchu'i gzungs/ lcags mchu nag po'i gzungs/ rdo rje mchu zhes bya ba'i klu'i dam tshig gi gzungs/ yi dwags kyi rgyal mo kha la me 'bar ba dbugs dbyung ba'i gzungs/ ye shes skar mda'i snying po ste chos kyi rnam grangs bcu drug bzhugs/ cha pa la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yan lag dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/

bar du gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i snying po'i gzungs/ lus kyi dbyibs mdzes pa'i gzungs/ stong 'gyur zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ stong 'khyil pa'i gzungs/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i gzungs/ snying rje mi shol ba'i gzungs/ kun tu bzang po'i gzungs/ don yod zhags pa'i gzungs/ phyir bzlog rnam par rgyal ba'i gzungs/ phyir bzlog stobs chen gyi gzungs/ snying rje mchog gi gzungs/ parṇa sha wa ri'i gzungs/ parṇa sha ba ri'i nad zhi ba'i rig sngags cho ga dang bcas pa/ spyan ras gzigs ha ya grī wa'i gzungs/ ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i gzungs/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi gzungs/ yon tan bsngags pa dpag tu med pa'i gzungs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs/ me kha la'i gzungs/ be con chen po'i gzungs/ khyad par can gyi gzungs/ sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo dbugs chen mo/ mdangs phyir 'phrog pa'i mdo/ chos thams cad kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa gzungs chen mo/ lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba'i gzungs/ rims nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba'i gzungs/ mgon po nag po'i gzungs/ nag po chen po'i gzungs/ rims nad thams cad las thar bar byed pa/ lha mo nag mo'i gzungs/ nad do cog gi bdag mo la bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ 'di bstan bcos yin yang snga ma rnams kyis bris pa ltar bzhag go /yangs pa can gyi grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo/ dri ma med pa'i gzungs/ yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags/ rims nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba'i mdo/ mig rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs/ gzhang 'brum rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mdo/ mtshan mo bzang mo'i mdo/ gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi gzungs/

gser can gyi gzungs/ thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i gzungs/ bu mang po rton pa'i gzungs/ tshogs bdag gi gzungs/ bgegs sel ba'i gzungs/ mi rgod rnam 'joms kyi gzungs/ 'od zer can gyi gzungs cho ga dang bcas pa/ nor rgyun ma'i gzungs/ nor bu bzang po'i gzungs/ gnod 'dzin chu dbang snying rje can gyi gzungs/ gnod 'dzin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sa'i dbang po'i gzungs/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo kun nas 'od kyi gzungs/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po'i gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bsngags par 'os pa'i bstod pa la/ thams cad mkhyen par grub par bstod pa/ stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la bstod pa dang*/ gsung la bstod pa dang*/ rtsod pa mi mnga' bar bstod pa dang*/ tshangs pa dang mthun par bstod pa dang*/ phan par bstod pa dang*/ lan mi gdon par bstod pa dang*/ sku'i phyogs gcig la bstod pa dang*/ ljags la bstod pa ste/ dgu po 'di bstan bcos yin pas 'dir 'ong don med kyang snga ma rnams kyis bris pa ltar bsod nams che bas bzhag go /sangs rgyas dang nye ba'i sras brgyad de/ dgu'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ sgrol ma mchog gi gzungs/ dra bi ta'i gzungs/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gzungs/ skul byed ma'i gzungs/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa'i gzungs/ 'jam dpal gyi yig 'bru gcig pa/ gtsug tor mchog tu grub pa'i gzungs/ don yod zhags pa'i gzungs/ shes rab blo 'phel gyi gzungs/ shes rab bskyed pa'i gzungs cha gnyis/ thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs/ shlau ka stong lobs pa/ brgya lobs pa/ thos pa 'dzin pa cha gsum/ shlau ka stong lobs pa/ sum brgya lobs pa/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa/ gos brgya thob pa/ rmi lam mthong ba/ padma'i spyan/ shags kyi lan thebs pa'i gzungs/ rgyal ba'i bla ma'i gzungs/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po'i gzungs/ nad med pa'i gzungs/ rims nad med pa'i gzungs/

skran zhi ba'i gzungs/ gcan gzan gyis mi tshugs pa'i gzungs/ 'brum bu'i nad zhi ba'i gzungs/ rims nang zhi ba'i gzungs/ ma zhu ba'i nad zhi ba'i gzungs/ sdang ba thams cad rab tu zhi ba'i gzungs/ log 'dren thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa'i gzungs/ sman la sngags kyis gdab pa/ bdag srung ba/ chom rkun srung ba/ khros pa zhi ba/ bltas pas dga' ba rma bya chen mo'i snying po/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo gzung bar 'gyur ba/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo gzung bar 'gyur ba/ so so 'brang ma'i mdo gzung bar 'gyur ba/ sher phyin 'bum gzung bar 'gyur ba/ las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa'i gzungs/ sdig pa thams cad zhi ba'i gzungs/ khros pa zhi ba/ shākya thub pa'i gzungs/ don thams cad grub pa'i gzungs/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gzungs/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa rnam par dbye ba'i mdo ste/ chos kyi rnam grangs brgya dang nyi shu rtsa dgu bzhugs so// dpal ldan 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rnam snang mdzad// rje 'bangs tshul gyis brtson pas legs bsgrubs nas// tshe 'di nyid la dngos grub thob byed mdo// brgya phrag gnyis dang bzhi bcu rtsa drug bzhugs// bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab bka' 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag bstan pa gsal ba'i sgron me las/ gzungs 'bum gyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs bshad pa ste skabs gsum pa'o// //

༄// bstan 'gyur dkar chag bzhugs so// ༈ /sa phyogs gang na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa tshang bar bzhugs pa de na bka' 'gyur ro cog dang*/ bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi glegs bam tshang bar bzhugs dgos/ 'di gnyis tshang bar mi bzhugs na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs par mi bzhugs pas bstan pa tshang bar mi bzhugs/ bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur gyi glegs bam dang*/ de 'chad byed kyi gang zag la rag las pa lags/ de la bka' 'gyur gyi dgongs pa rang stobs kyis 'chad mi shes pas/ tshul bzhin du 'chad pa la bstan 'gyur gal che bar gzigs nas/ 'gro ba'i bla ma ti shri kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong ba'i dus su/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyang ro byang chub 'bum la sogs pa mkhas pa du ma la bka' gnang nas phyogs gcig tu bsdus shing zhu dag dang do dam bgyis nas/ mgon po 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bla ma bdag nyid chen po'i thugs dam du bzhengs pa'i bstan 'gyur khyad par can 'di na/ dang por mchod brjod kyi tshul gyi sangs rgyas dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ rdo rje chos skyong rnams la bstod pa'i tshogs thams cad tshang bar bkod cing*/ de nas dus kyi 'khor lo/ kye rdor/ 'khor lo bde mchog rdo rje gdan bzhi/ sgyu ma chen mo/ gsang ba 'dus pa/ gshin rje'i gshed skor la sogs pa/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi bstan bcos mtha' dag dang*/ de nyid bsdus pa la sogs rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi chos skor dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang sogs spyod rgyud kyi chos skor dang*/ dpung bzang gi mdo 'grel sogs/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi chos skor te/ gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa/ sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog sbyin sreg gi cho ga bsgom rim gyi gdams ngag sogs tshang mar bzhugs pa dang*/ phar phyin theg pa'i phyogs la/ rgyas pa 'bum gyi ṭī ka sogs sher phyin gyi mdo mang po'i 'grel pa dang*/

mngon rtogs rgyan la sogs pa byams chos sde lnga rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa/ 'grel bshad/ sa sde lnga/ sdom rnam gnyis/ pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad sogs 'phags pa thogs med sku mched rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gzhung dag dang*/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i shes rab la sogs pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dbu ma'i gzhung lugs rnams dang*/ de dag gi dgongs pa 'grel pa/ slob dpon sangs rgyas skyong*/ legs ldan byed/ zla ba grags pa/ zhi ba 'tsho/ kā ma la shī la sogs pa dbu ma'i slob dpon chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ 'grel bshad/ gzhung phran dang bcas pa ji snyed pa dang*/ mngon pa mdzod rtsa 'grel sogs bye brag tu smra ba'i gzhung 'grel mtha' dag dang*/ spyod phyogs kyi gzhung brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ bslab btus la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la slob tshul gyi gzhung mtha' dag dang*/ 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i 'grel chen sogs 'dul ba'i 'grel pa 'grel bshad gzhung phran mang po dang*/ tshad ma sde bdun gyi 'grel pa 'grel bshad bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ gzhan yang sgra dang*/ snyan ngag dang*/ sdeb sbyor dang*/ mngon brjod dang*/ skar rtsis dang*/ sku gzugs kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ mi'i brtag pa dang*/ sman dpyad yan chad kyi bar gyi bstan bcos mtha' dag yongs su tshang bar bzhugs pa'i mthar bkra shis dang*/ smon lam dang*/ bden pa'i tshig gi rgya gzhung rnams yongs su rdzogs par bzhugs pa'i glegs bam rnams la bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal zhes yongs su rdzogs par grags pa 'di lags/ ding sang bod dbus gtsang gi sa la bstan 'gyur 'ga' re yod kyang*/ 'di bas legs pa bzang ba dag pa gzhan na med par mngon sum gyis grub pa de yin// //maṅga laṃ// // ༄// rdo rje theg pa'i bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi dkar chag bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi dkar chag gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas byed ces bya ba/

bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// 'od gsal chos sku'i sprin lam rab tu yangs// zung 'jug longs sku'i nyin byed dkyil 'khor rgyas// phrin las sprul sku'i tsha zer stong 'phro ba// dpal ldan bla ma 'od stong bdag por 'dud// rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rab zab mo'i don// mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i sbas don gsal mdzad nas// ma nor lam bzang 'gro la snang mdzad pa// 'phags yul mkhas pa'i dbang phyug thams cad rgyal// rab 'byams rgyud dang 'grel mang chu gter las// rnam dag dgongs don yid bzhin nor blangs nas// gangs can 'gro blo'i dbul ba sel mdzad pa// rje btsun sa skya pa rnams spyi bos mchod// bde gshegs bstan la bya ba byed 'dod pa'i// skal bzang de dag dam chos 'chad pa dang*// 'bri dang klog dang nyan dang sgrub sogs kyis// dal 'byor thob pa don yod bya bar rigs// 'dir dad pa dang blo gros dang bsod nams kyi dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba'i dge sbyong chen po/ a ma dpal bzang po rgyal mtshan gyi thugs dam du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog bzhengs shing*/ bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal rim gyis 'bri bar brtsams pa las/ thog mar 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung la/ thog mar dpal kye rdo rje'i chos skor rnams 'byung ba'i/ ka pa la/ brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs pa 'brog gi 'gyur/ dka' 'grel ku mu ti slob dpon sbyang dka' zla bas mdzad pa shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ dka' 'grel mu tig gi phreng ba slob dpon shānti pas mdzad pa dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ dka' 'grel padma can mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa khu dngos grub kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ kha pa la/ brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa dhaṃ ka da shas mdzad pa shong blo brtan gyi 'gyur/ brtag gnyis dka' 'grel snyan grags bzang po'i mdzad pa chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/

'di nā ro 'grel chen tu grag go /brtag gnyis kyi dka' 'grel padma'i myu gus mdzad pa 'di sngar gyi mtsho skyes kyi dka' 'grel gyi mgo nas tshigs bcad cung zad bzhag mjug tu padma'i myu gus mdzad zer ba sbyar ba tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan khyad par cung zad kyang med pas mtsho skyes kyi ṭī ka yin la/ padma'i myu gu'i ṭī ka yin ngos shes pa logs na yod do// ga pa la/ brtag gnyis kyi rnam 'grel bha wa bha dras mdzad pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa rin chen sbyor phreng dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ dpal sambu ṭa'i kha sbyor thig le'i 'grel pa ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ nga pa la/ sambu ṭa'i 'grel pa man ngag gi snye ma a bha yās mdzad pa dpyal lotstsha ba chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ sambu ṭa'i 'grel pa dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rin chen phreng ba/ rdo rje gur gyi dka' 'grel lha'i rig kyi blo gros kyis mdzad pa 'gos kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// ca pa la/ brtag gnyis kyi dka' 'grel rdo rje'i tshig bsdu ba ka ma dhe nus mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje gur gyi dka' 'grel nag po pas mdzad pa 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ gleng gzhi'i 'grel pa/ brda'i 'grel pa/ rtsa'i mngon rtogs che chung gnyis/ glu'i 'grel pa che chung gnyis/ dur khrod kyi gzhung gnyis rnams la skabs kyi 'grel chung brgyad du grags pa 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i 'od/ lhan cig skyes grub/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ tshogs 'khor gyi 'du ba bsgrags pa/ de nyid bcu pa rnams ḍombi he ru kas mdzad pa/ kye rdor dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs dang*/ kye rdor lha dgu'i sgrub thabs dpal mchog ḍombi pas mdzad pa/ kye rdor phyag gnyis pa lha dgu'i sgrub thabs slob dpon a la la badzras mdzad pa/

dran pa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs garbha ri pas mdzad pa/ bdag med ma dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa/ kye rdo rje'i dkyil chog bzang po yongs bzung dang*/ yan lag drug pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs dang*/ rdo rje gur mkha' 'gro lnga'i sgrub thabs dang*/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rnams slob dpon mi thub zla bas mdzad pa 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ kye rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa rin chen 'bar ba dge slong dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ kye rdo rje'i mngon rtogs don gsal ba/ kye rdo rje'i dkyil chog nas gling ma dang*/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes dang*/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga dang*/ bstod pa nyi shu pa dang*/ tshogs 'khor dam tshig lnga pa dang*/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rnams slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ kye rdor dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rim pa gsum pa'i sgrub thabs yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi 'grel pa dag pa rdo rje'i sgron me dza landha ri pas mdzad pa/ kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bde ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ he ru ka 'byung ba zhes pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon nyin 'byung zla bas mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs 'khrul spong dang*/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa mchog gi rdzogs rim rnams slob dpon shānti pas mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa mchog gi 'grel pa bram ze tha ga nas mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs 'khrul spong gi 'grel pa ye shes sgron me mngon par brjod pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nag po gzhung 'grel/ kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs 'khrul 'joms 'di sngar gyi 'khrul spong dang 'gyur khyad du 'dug kyang*/ bstan 'gyur snga ma na bris 'dug pa ltar bzhag go /kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs de nyid gsal ba nag po pas mdzad pa dang*/

dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs dang*/ tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga dang*/ rab gnas kyi cho ga dang*/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang*/ mchod rten gyi cho ga dang*/ gshin po'i cho ga rnams slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa/ kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang*/ kye rdor lha dgu'i sgrub thabs kyi rgyal po dang*/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs rnams gnyis med rdo rje'i mdzad pa/ gsang dbang gi rab tu dbye ba dpal birwa pas mdzad pa/ thig le chen po'i rim pa nag po pas mdzad pa/ phyag rgya bzhi'i sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang gtan la dbab pa dang*/ khro bo bcu'i rig pa'i cho ga rnams dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa/ rdo rje gur gyi sgrub thabs lha'i brtul zhugs kyis mdzad pa/ kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs byang chub snying pos mdzad pa/ kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs rin chen sgron me mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs de kho na nyid bzhi'i rim pa kaṃ pa las mdzad pa/ kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa'i thig le shākya srung gis mdzad pa/ kye rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs dril bu pas mdzad pa/ kye rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs gsung bsdus pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga buddha garbhas mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i de nyid bsdus pa dharmā ka ras mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga ā nanta badzris mdzad pa/ kye rdor gyi gtor ma nyi shu phyed pa nag po pas mdzad pa/ kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs nā ro ta pa'i zhal gyi lung sbyor/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs nā ro pa'i zhal gyi lung sbyor/ ro sreg gi cho ga nā ro pas mdzad pa/ kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs de kho na nyid snang ba rdo rje snying pos mdzad zer ba/ kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dpyal se bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/

cha pa la/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus pa'i rgyud shong gi 'gyur/ 'jig rten khams le'u'i 'grel pa/ nang le'u'i 'grel pa/ dbang gi le'u'i 'grel pa/ shong gi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ ja pa la/ sgrub le'i 'grel pa/ ye shes le'u'i 'grel pa shong 'gyur rnams dang*/ dus 'khor gyi dka' 'grel padma can so ma nā tha'i 'gyur/ dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa dus zhabs pas mdzad pa shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi 'grel pa/ sbas pa mig 'byed ces pa/ a wa dhū tī pas mdzad pa zla ba grags pa'i 'gyur/ dus 'khor gyi bskyed rim yan lag bzhi pa dus zhabs pas mdzad pa zla ba'i 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ dus 'khor gyi dkyil chog dus zhabs pas mdzad pa yon tan 'bar gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ nya pa la/ dus 'khor gyi dkyil chog sa dhu pu tras mdzad pa chos rab kyi 'gyur/ dus 'khor gyi bstod pa rgyun bshags sa dhu kī rtis mdzad pa tshul khrims seng ge'i 'gyur/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi 'grel pa nyi ma dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa bi bhū ta tsand+ra'i 'gyur/ dus 'khor nang gi snye ma bi bhu ta tsand+ras mdzad pa/ sbyor drug a nu pa ma rakṣi tas mdzad pa mi mnyam bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi sgrub thabs dus zhabs pas mdzad pa shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa chos rab kyi 'gyur/ dus 'khor snying po rgyan gyi sgrub thabs bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa zla ba'i 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ mtshan brjod dus 'khor lugs kyi 'grel pa mi yi dbang po grags pas mdzad pa rdo rje rgyal po'i 'gyur/ mtshan brjod phan yon gyi 'grel pa dus zhabs pas mdzad pa rdo rje rgyal po'i 'gyur/ mtshan brjod kyi mdor bshad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa nyi ma dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa zla bzang grags pas mdzad pa 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/

mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa sgron ma gsal ba a nu pa ma rakṣi tas mdzad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs shrī dha ras mdzad pa/ mtshan brjod kyi sgrub thabs byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa smṛ ti'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal rin po che'i sgrub thabs/ dge bsnyen ma grags sbyin gyis mdzad pa smṛ ti'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyi rdzogs rim shānti garbha sa mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs snyan grags dge mas mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs shānti garbhas mdzad pa/ mtshan brjod nyer bar bsdus pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ ta pa la/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dka' 'grel slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi dka' 'grel rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ mnyam sbyor gyi 'grel pa kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa smṛ ti'i 'gyur/ mnyam sbyor gyi 'grel pa dga' ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// tha pa la/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi 'grel pa brgya byin sdong pos mdzad pa lha rin po che'i 'gyur/ mnyam sbyor gyi dka' 'grel ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang don bkod pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi/ he ru ka yi/ padma gar dbang gi rdo rje nyi ma'i rta mchog rol pa'i gsang don bkod pa rnams ku ku rā dzas mdzad pa/ mnyam sbyor rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil chog rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gnyan ban bsod nams kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug pa ku ku rā dzas mdzad pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' rjes su dran pa'i cho ga rā dza ha tas mdzad pa/ he ru ka'i sgrub thabs hūm̐ mdzad kyis mdzad pa/

yan lag bzhi'i don snang ba hūm̐ mdzad grags pas mdzad pa/ he ru ka'i sgrub thabs hūm̐ mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa/ he ru ka'i sgrub thabs rā dza ha tas mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/ mnyam sbyor gyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i rim pa hūm̐ mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ da pa la/ phyag rgya chen po'i thig le'i 'grel pa zab pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa g.yung drung snying po'i 'gyur/ rang bzhin gyi dga' ba'i sgron ma rdo rje gsang bas mdzad pa/ dga' ba'i spyan shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dbang rin chen snang ba shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ rin chen phreng ba'i man ngag shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ rin chen char yang gi sgrub thabs shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ rin chen thigs pa'i sgrub thabs shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ dga' ba'i me tog gi phreng ba and+ri bhū tis mdzad pa/ dbang rin chen 'khor lo'i man ngag ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/ ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa shānti pas mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyis 'gyur/ rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa gzhon nu zla bas mdzad pa/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi phyag na rdo rje'i bstod 'grel shong gi 'gyur/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa bha wa bha dras mdzad pa rin chen grags kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ na pa la/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi dka' 'grel la wa pas mdzad pa 'gos kyi 'gyur/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa ba ri ba'i 'gyur/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa skal ldan grags pas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi dka' ba'i 'grel pa skar rgyal zla bas mdzad pa gu ṇa shrī'i 'gyur/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa laṅka rgyal bzang gis mdzad pa/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi gnyis ka'i bshad sbyar ta thā ga ta rakṣi tas mdzad pa dharma blo gros kyi 'gyur/

bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa lha sbas kyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// pa pa la/ bde mchog bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'grel pa bha wa bha dras mdzad pa 'gos kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dka' 'grel nor bzang gis mdzad pa zla ba'i 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs ka la ka pas mdzad pa 'gos kyi 'gyur/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi 'grel pa ratna rakṣi tas mdzad pa shong blo brtan gyi 'gyur/ ye shes 'byung ba'i man ngag ga ya dha ras mdzad pa shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ bde mchog gi bshad rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi 'grel pa ta thā ga ta rakṣi tas mdzad pa ba ri ba'i 'gyur/ bde mchog gi bshad rgyud/ khrag 'thung mngon 'byung gi 'grel pa zla ba gzhon nus mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ pha pa la/ bde mchog gi bshad rgyud mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'grel pa padma rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gru gzing dar ma yon tan gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ ba pa la/ bde mchog gi dkyil chog de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa bi bhu ti tsand+ra'i 'gyur/ bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs me tri pas mdzad pa mtshur dbang nge'i 'gyur/ bde mchog gi sgrub thabs phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa so ma nā tha'i 'gyur/ bde mchog gi sgrub thabs nyin mor mdzad kyis mdzad pa dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ bde mchog gi sgrub thabs 'khrul spong a bha yas mdzad pa chos rje dpal gyis 'gyur/ bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs ma na shrīs mdzad pa pradzñā kīrtis 'gyur/ he ru ka'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus bram ze bhṛṃ ka ras mdzad pa mar do'i 'gyur/ bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs jo bos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ bde mchog lus dkyil gyi dbang gi bya ba rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa/ lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa/

rdzogs rim rim pa lnga pa rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa/ lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa/ bde mchog lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa/ bde mchog gi dkyil chog la wa pas mdzad pa mar do'i 'gyur/ yi ge bdun pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa mar do'i 'gyur/ bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs garbha ri pas mdzad pa/ bde mchog gi bstod pa rgyun chags chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa chag lo'i 'gyur/ phag mo'i sgrub thabs pradzñā bha dras mdzad pa dang phag mo gzhung drug tu grags pa la zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs ldong ngar ras mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs che ba stong nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa/ phag mo don grub ma'i sgrub thabs chung ba a wa dhū tīs pas mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs che ba stong nyid ting 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa/ phag mo dbu bcad ma'i sgrub thabs chung ba dpal gyi blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs che ba birwa pas mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg sangs rgyas byin gyis mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams la gzhung drug sbyin sreg dang bcas pa zhes grags pa dang*/ keng rus kyi rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs dha ri ka pas mdzad pa/ phag mo'i bstod pa glog skya lotstsha ba'i 'gyur/ keng rus kyi rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs kyi ṭī ka ku mā ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ phag mo lha so bdun ma'i sgrub thabs 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ dā na shī la'i 'gyur/ rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa dha ri ka pas mdzad pa/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa dha ri ka pas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i dbang cho ga sha ba ri pas mdzad pa/ slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga /tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga sha ba ri pas mdzad pa/ phag mo don grub ma'i sgrub thabs gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams thar pa lotstsha ba'i 'gyur/ phag mo'i sgrub thabs mi dbang ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/

sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyi byin rlabs ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/ phag mo'i sgrub thabs yang dag grub pa'i 'grel pa brtson 'grus dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa thar lo'i 'gyur/ phag mo dkar mo'i sgrub thabs kaṃ ka spyan gyis mdzad pa chag lo'i 'gyur/ phag mo mngon 'byung gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga u ma pa tis mdzad pa chos rab kyi 'gyur/ phag mo mngon 'byung gi sgrub thabs u ma pa tis mdzad pa rā chos rab kyi 'gyur/ sgyu ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa shānti pas mdzad pa 'gos kyi 'gyur/ sgyu ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa nag po dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa 'gos kyi 'gyur/ sgyu ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa durdza ya tsand+ras mdzad pa ye shes dad pa'i 'gyur/ sgyu ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel dpal rgyan pas mdzad pa shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil chog 'gos kyi 'gyur/ sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rim pa gsal ba dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// ma pa la/ sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil chog 'dul bas byin gyis mdzad pa/ sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil chog ku ku ri pas mdzad pa 'gos kyi 'gyur/ sgyu ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs rmongs pa sgrol ba ku ku ri pas mdzad pa/ spros pa med pa'i man ngag ku ku ri pas mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga ku ku ri pas mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag gi 'grel pa dang*/ gzhung rtsa ba gnyis blo bzang snying pos mdzad pa/ sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil chog sbyin sreg dang bcas pa rgyan pas mdzad pa/ lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rgyan pas mdzad pa/ lha lnga'i sgrub thabs sku med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ lha lnga'i sgrub thabs shānti pas mdzad pa/ lha lnga'i sgrub thabs u rgyan nas byung ba rnams dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa slob dpon bha ba bha dras mdzad pa 'gos kyis 'gyur/

gdan bzhi'i dkyil chog snying po mdo bsags ārya de bas mdzad pa/ ye shes dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i sgrub thabs 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ shing gcig pa'i dka' 'grel 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ gdan bzhi'i sgrub thabs bha wa bha dras mdzad pa/ mchan khung gi sbyor ba 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ gdan bzhi'i de kho na nyid bzhi pa dze tā ris mdzad pa/ gdan bzhi'i yab bka'/ yum bka' gnyis kyi sgrub thabs rnam rgyal dpa' bos mdzad pa/ ye shes snang ba'i sgrub thabs gsham ma tshang ba gcig rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa sa ra has mdzad pa gyi jo'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel a bha yas mdzad pa chos grags kyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil chog sa ra has mdzad pa/ lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sgrub thabs sa ra has mdzad pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga sa ra has mdzad pa gyi jo'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ tsa pa la/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa bha nos mdzad pa shes rab brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi rnam bshad mjug ma tshang ba dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa le'u bcu bdun pa yan chad dang*/ le'u bco brgyad pa'i 'grel pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad par grags pa gzhon nu 'bum pa'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ tsa pa gnyis pa la/ gdan bzhi'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa dza ka paṇḍi tas mdzad pa/ padma drwa ba'i mchod pa'i cho ga dang padma drwa ba'i sgrub thabs rgyal ba dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ bde mchog nag po pa'i gzhung drug la/ bde mchog gi sgrub thabs/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sbyin sreg gi cho ga rdzogs rim gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba/ rim pa bzhi pa/ dpyid kyi thig le ste drug dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs rkang pa zhe brgyad pa bod skad du bsgyur ba/

dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sbyin sreg gi cho ga gtor ma'i cho ga maṇḍal gyi cho ga rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mchod pa'i cho ga rnams dza ya se nas mdzad pa/ mngon brjod bla ma'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa shu raṃ ga warmas mdzad pa/ gsang 'dus sgron gsal gyi 'grel bshad ārya de was mdzad pa/ sgron gsal gyi mdor bshad snying gi me long ku mā ras mdzad pa/ sgron gsal gyi dka' ba btus pa'i 'grel pa legs ldan byed kyis mdzad pa/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel pa gsang ba'i sgron me snyan grags bzang pos mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ tsha pa la/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud gyi 'grel pa sgron gsal zla ba grags pas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ sgron gsal gyi 'grel bshad skal ldan grags pas mdzad pa'i le'u gnyis pa yan chad bzhugs/ dza pa la/ 'grel pa'i smad le'u bcu bdun pa yan chad yongs su rdzogs pa ku mā ra'i 'gyur/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa ye shes zhabs kyi rjes su 'brang ba rdo rje bzhad pas mdzad pa bai ro tsa na'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// wa pa la/ gsang 'dus le'u bco brgyad pa'i dka' 'grel rgyal bas byin gyis mdzad pa/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa'i 'grel pa dri med sbas pas mdzad pa/ le'u bco brgyad pa'i 'grel pa de'i slob ma zla 'od kyis mdzad pa dar ma grags kyis 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ zha pa la/ gsang 'dus kyi bshad sbyar snyim pa'i me tog slob dpon shānti pas mdzad pa 'gos kyi 'gyur/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa gcig rnams bzhugs/ za pa la/ gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa rin chen ljon shing slob dpon tsi lu pas mdzad pa lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ gsang 'dus 'grel pa rab zhi ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa bi shwa mi tras mdzad pa/ gsang 'dus kyi dka' 'grel kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/

'a ya ra gsum la/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud kyi 'grel pa slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa paṇḍi ta 'phra la ras kyi 'gyur bzhugs/ 'grel pa 'di paṇḍi ta 'phra la ras 'pho ba grong 'jug byas pas/ rong pa chos bzangs su skyes/ des rdol chos mang po brtsams pa'i nang nas 'di yang khong gis brtsams chos yin no// la pa la/ lha mo bzhis zhus kyi rgyud kyi ṭī ka smṛ tis mdzad pa/ lha mo bzhis zhus kyi 'grel pa ye shes snying pos mdzad pa smṛ ti'i 'gyur/ gsang 'dus kyi dkyil chog 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ gsang 'dus kyi dkyil chog nyi shu pa klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa pa tshab kyi 'gyur/ gsang 'dus kyi dkyil chog nag po dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa 'gos kyi 'gyur/ gsang 'dus kyi dkyil chog sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi 'gyur/ sgrub thabs mdor byas mdo dang bsres pa rnams klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa pa tshab kyi 'gyur/ rnam gzhag rim pa klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa/ rdzogs rim rim pa lnga pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa pa tshab kyi 'gyur/ spyod bsdus sgron me ārya de bas mdzad pa/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa ārya de bas mdzad pa/ mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa ro sreg gi cho ga rnams ārya de bas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rim pa lnga'i 'grel pa don gsal klu byang gis mdzad pa/ rim pa khongs su bsdu ba klu byang gis mdzad pa pa tshab kyi 'gyur/ las kyi mtha' rnam par 'byed pa klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// sha pa la/ rim lnga'i 'grel pa nor bu'i phreng ba klu byang gis mdzad par grags pa gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis 'gyur/ 'jam rdor gyi sgrub thabs dpe med rdo rjes mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ mdor byas kyi 'grel pa rin chen phreng ba shānti pas mdzad pa karma badzra gyi 'gyur/

dbang bzhi'i rab tu 'byed pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa 'gos kyis 'gyur/ gsang 'dus mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs zla grags kyis mdzad pa gzhon nu 'bar gyi 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa ta thā ga ta rakṣi tas mdzad pa ba ri'i 'gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog nag po pas mdzad pa 'gos kyis 'gyur/ gtor ma'i cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i sgrub thabs rdo rje bzhad pas mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa bde ba chen po'i sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa bi ma la garbhas mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi man ngag bdud rtsi gsang ba slob dpon sgra dbyangs bcu gcig pas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// sa pa la/ gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa dang de'i 'grel pa slob dpon shānti pas mdzad pa/ dbang gi rab dbye ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i cho ga bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa/ dga' ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'jam rdor gyi sgrub thabs kun du bzang po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa tha ga nas mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs kun bzang gi 'grel pa dpal 'bras rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal lung sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa bi ta pa tas mdzad pa/ zhal lung chung ba/ shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ bdag grub pa/ grol ba'i thig le/ grol thig gi 'grel pa sman zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ yan lag bdun pa ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ ha pa la/ 'jam rdor gyi sgrub thabs kun du bzang po ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa smṛ ti'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa snying po snye ma kun tu bzang pos mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ he ru ka'i sgrub thabs sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa gsang 'dus sgrub thabs dngos grub 'byung ba'i gter sman zhabs kyis mdzad pa lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/

sbyor ba bdun pa bi ta pa tas mdzad pa/ mi shigs pa'i sgrub thabs bi ta pa tas mdzad pa/ bdag gis don grub pa bi ta pa tas mdzad pa/ bstan pa'i nor rdzas ratna kīrtis mdzad pa/ mi bskyod rdo rje'i sgrub thabs rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs jo bo rjes mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'jam rdor gyi mngon rtogs bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ gshin po bde ba la 'god pa'i cho ga ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa/ argha'i cho ga snang byed zla bas mdzad pa/ gsang 'dus sbyin sreg gi cho ga rab 'jigs rdo rjes mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'jam rdor gyi sgrub thabs kun tu bzang pos mdzad pa/ 'jam rdor gyi sgrub thabs rgyal bas byin gyis mdzad pa/ 'jam rdor gyi sgrub thabs puṇya shrīs mdzad pa gzhon nu 'bar gyi 'gyur/ khro bo bcu'i gtor ma'i cho ga rab gnas kyi cho ga mi 'jigs pa'i phyag gis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// a pa la/ dgra nag gi rgyud kyi 'grel pa nag po pas mdzad pa pradzñā shrī'i 'gyur/ dgra nag gi rgyud kyi 'grel pa grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ dgra nag gi dkyil chog gshin rje'i gshed 'byung ba la li ta badzras mdzad pa/ dgra nag gi sgrub thabs dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gsang rgyud kyi dkyil chog sbyin sreg gi cho ga tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga rnams ka ma las mdzad pa/ dgra nag gi dkyil chog dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs/ 'khor lo'i don rgyas par bshad pa mi bskyod pas mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dgra nag gi sgrub thabs ka ma la rakṣi tas mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ dgra nag gi sgrub thabs nyin mor byed pa'i grags pas mdzad pa 'gos kyi 'gyur/ dgra nag gi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/

gshin rje nag po dus mthar phyin pa'i sgrub thabs mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ rnam snang gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs rin 'byung gshin rje gshed/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed/ gshin rje'i gshed rdo rje rnon po/ rdo rje sems ma/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma/ rdo rje go ri rnams kyi sgrub thabs mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa re re/ gshin rje gshed mchod pa'i cho ga gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/ tho ba gshin rje'i gshed/ dbyug pa gshin rje'i gshed/ ral gri gshin rje'i gshed/ padma gshin rje'i gshed/ shes rab rnams kyi sgrub thabs/ dgra nag gi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs shes rab bla ma'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa/ rtog pa gsum par grags pa'i man ngag gshin rje gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor gzhon nu 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ dgra nag gi sgrub thabs rdo rje'i blos mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed rtog bdun gyi 'grel pa mi bskyod pas mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyis 'gyur/ rtog bdun gyi mdor bshad ta thā ga ta rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ rtog bdun gyi dka' 'grel gzhon nu zla bas mdzad pa ba ri ba'i 'gyur/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil chog a mo gha badzras mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed lha bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa'i sgrub thabs la li ta badzras mdzad pa shes rab brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'jigs byed kyi sbyin sreg a mo ghas mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mdzad pa rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/ 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs shrī bha dras mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga zhi ba ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ las sbyor drag po phyogs gcig pa zhi ba ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa las kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa/

mgon po mngon 'byung gi dkyil chog sa manta shrīs mdzad pa chos rab kyi 'gyur/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga sa manta shrīs mdzad pa chos rab kyi 'gyur/ gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa chag gi 'gyur/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bi rū pas mdzad pa dā na shī la'i 'gyur/ gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa chag lo'i 'gyur/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i sgrub thabs blo gros bzang pos mdzad pa chag gi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed dmar 'khrul 'khor gyi gsal byed dus 'khor lugs/ gshed dmar 'khor lo'i gsal byed byang chub snying pos mdzad pa dpyal lo'i 'gyur/ ting nge 'dzin gyi cho ga dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ gshed dmar gtso bo rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs rnam snang srung bas mdzad pa/ gtso bo rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs birwa pas mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga birwa pas mdzad pa/ mchod pa'i cho ga dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ las tshogs kyi sgrub thabs dpa' bo rgyal pos mdzad pa/ 'khrul 'khor gyi phreng ba birwa pas mdzad pa dā na shī la'i 'gyur/ gtor ma'i cho ga blo bzang snying pos mdzad pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'di rgya dpe 'khrugs pa las bsgyur 'dug go /gshed dmar gyi las tshogs kyi sgrub thabs dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ gshed dmar gyi maṇḍal gyi cho ga dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ ki pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje phreng ba chag lo'i 'gyur/ sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor chag lo'i 'gyur/ sbyin sreg 'od kyi snye ma chag lo'i 'gyur/ dbang gi rab byed a bha yas mdzad pa shes rab dpal gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje dbyings bla med du bshad pa/ bya ba bsdus pa rig sbyin gyis mdzad pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rtogs brjod dpa' bo 'od gsal gyis bsdus pa/

spyod pa'i glu'i mdzod kyi 'grel pa thub pas byin gyis mdzad pa/ grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// khi pa la/ do ha mdzod/ spyod pa'i glu sa ra has mdzad pa/ mi zad pa'i gter mdzod kyi glu sa ra has mdzad pa/ do ha mdzod kyi dka' 'grel gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ nag po rdo rje'i do ha mdzod/ de'i 'grel pa paṇḍi ta 'od dpag med kyis mdzad pa/ mi zad pa'i gter mdzod kyi glu'i 'grel pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ka kha'i do ha sa ra has mdzad pa bai ro tsa na'i 'gyur/ sku'i mdzod 'chi med rdo rje'i glu/ gsung gi mdzod 'jam dbyangs rdo rje'i glu/ thugs kyi mdzod skye med rdo rje'i glu/ sku gsung thugs yid la mi byed pa'i glu/ rdo rje gdan gyi rdo rje'i glu mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'di rnams la do ha mdzod/ de kho na nyid rnal 'byor du mtshon pa/ don dam pa'i yi ge ces pa'i mtshan dang ldan pa'i do ha mdzod dang*/ mar me mdzad kyis rdo rje gdan gyi glu zhes pa gnyis ma gtogs gzhan rnams bal po skye med mdzod kyis byas nas/ sa ra ha la kha g.yar ba yin no// zhes mkhas pa rnams gsung ngo*// rdzogs rim gyi gzhung rnam par dag pa la/ gsang ba grub pa padma badzras mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ thabs shes rab gtan la dbab pa grub pa yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa 'gos kyis 'gyur/ ye shes grub pa ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ gnyis med grub pa lcam legs smin gyis mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid grub pa rnal 'byor pa tsintos mdzad pa 'gos kyi 'gyur/ dpal kho na nyid grub pa ke ra ri pas mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes grub kyi gzhung 'grel lcam dpal mos mdzad pa shes rab grags kyi 'gyur rnams la/ grub pa dang snying po'i chos skor zhes grags so// slob dpon mai tri pa'i gzhung*/

a ma na se'i chos skor la/ lta ba ngan sel mai tris mdzad pa/ lta ba ngan sel gyi dran pa/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag rin po che'i phreng ba/ rmi lam nges bstan/ sgyu ma nges bstan/ dbu ma drug pa/ rab tu mi gnas pa/ gsal bar ston pa/ de kho na nyid bcu pa/ de kho na nyid bcu pa'i 'grel pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ theg chen nyi shu pa/ rang bzhin lnga pa/ phyag rgya lnga'i rnam par bshad pa/ dbang der brtad/ dbang bskur nges par bstan pa/ de'i dka' 'grel dga' ba skyong gis mdzad pa/ bde chen gsal ba/ de kho na nyid nyi shu pa/ de kho na nyid rab tu bstan pa/ zung 'jug gsal ba/ lhan cig skyes drug pa/ mi phyed pa lnga pa/ brtse ba lnga pa/ dga' gcugs lnga pa/ dbang gi dgos pa mdor bsdus pa/ yid la mi phyed pa ston pa/ shes rab ye shes gsal ba de wa tsand+ras mdzad pa rnams so// rdo rje'i tshig brtag gnyis las btus pa badzra pā ṇis mdzad pa/ dpa' bo chen po rim pa gsum pa/ gsang dbang gi rab tu byed pa/ sgom rim drug pa/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa'i man ngag de kho na nyid kyi man ngag dha ri ka pas mdzad pa 'gos kyi 'gyur/ lhan cig skyes grub ḍombi pas mdzad pa/ byang chub sems 'grel klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa nyi ma grags kyis 'gyur/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ phyag rgya bzhi rjes su bstan pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ bsam mi khyab pa'i man ngag dpal tog tse pas mdzad pa 'gos kyis 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ gi pa la/ u rgyan sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ dbang bskur gyi cho ga mchod pa'i cho ga gtor ma'i cho ga /gtor ma'i cho ga nyung ngu*/ u rgyan sgrol ma la bstod pa/ bstod pa rgyas pa/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag de'i 'grel pa rnams shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ u rgyan sgrol ma dpa' mo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ rigs kyi 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs ma ṇi kas mdzad pa/

rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bi ma la me tris mdzad pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs kyi snang ba ma hi mas mdzad pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyis 'gyur/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs thogs med kyis mdzad pa dge bshes ston pa'i 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje me lce'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa bha wa pas mdzad par grags pa/ phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil chog bha wa pas mdzad pa/ phyag rdor gyi sgrub thabs gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs/ gtor ma'i cho ga tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga sbyin sreg gi cho ga drag po'i sbyin sreg maṇḍal cho ga rnams bha wa pas mdzad par grags pa/ rdo rje snying po'i man ngag dzñā na shrīs mdzad pa rnams dang*/ sgrub thabs kun las btus sam sgrub thabs rgya mtsho zhes grags pa yar lung pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba la/ sgrub thabs nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe drug yod pa/ bla ma ba ri lotstsha bas bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa la sgrub thabs dgu bcu go drug bzhugs pa/ phyag rdor gyi sgrub thabs dza wa ri pas mdzad pa/ don zhags lha lnga'i sgrub thabs e ra pa tis mdzad pa/ bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ ngi pa la/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa/ 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'grel pa de'i dkyil chog gis skabs nag 'jam zur du phyung ba/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel chung 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa sngags don rnam gzigs sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa shes rab brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid ldan pa byang chub bzang po'i mdzad pa/ byang chub sems kyi bsgom don bcu gnyis pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/

ci pa la/ de nyid 'dus pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa de nyid snang chen la/ dum bu dang po'i bstod 'grel/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur ba dang*/ dum bu lhag ma gsum gyi 'grel pa zangs dkar lotstsha bas bsgyur ba las dum bu gnyis pa'i 'grel pa'i stod yan chad bzhugs/ chi pa la/ de nyid snang chen gyi smad yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel pa/ ko sa la'i rgyan gyi stod bzhugs/ ji pa la/ ko sa la'i rgyan gyi smad yongs su rdzogs pa slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur bzhugs/ nyi pa la/ dpal mchog shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'byung ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa las/ dum bu dang po'i 'grel pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur dang*/ dum bu gnyis pa'i 'grel pa bzhugs/ ti pa la/ dum bu gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i 'grel pa yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ dum bu 'og ma gsum po/ maṇḍal ti la ka dang lha bla ma'i 'gyur bzhugs/ thi pa la/ dpal mchog sher dum gyi 'grel pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ sbyong rgyud kyi 'grel pa gsal ba'i sgron me kun dga' snying pos mdzad par grags pa/ khyung po chos brtson gyis 'gyur/ sbyong rgyud kyi 'grel pa mdzes rgyan rdo rje go chas mdzad par grags pa rnams bzhugs/ di pa la/ de nyid bsdus pa'i don 'grel a wa ta ra sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rgyud kyi 'grel pa mur kti ka ko kas mdzad pa/ rdor dbyings kyi dkyil chog rdo rje 'byung ba kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje 'byung ba'i dka' 'grel mu hant+ra bha dras mdzad pa/ chos kyi shes rab kyis 'gyur/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dkyil chog kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal mchog rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil chog kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/

ni pa la/ gtsug dgu'i dkyil chog slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga zhi ba snying pos mdzad pa/ sems dpa' 'byung ba chung ba slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa dge blo'i 'gyur/ gtsug dgu'i cho ga sa ra hi tas mdzad pa/ ro sbyong ba'i cho ga bskal bzang dga' bas mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rab 'byor skyong gis mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje chos rnal 'byor gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan rgya che'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje lta bu'i sgrub thabs/ kun tu bzang po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rab gnas kyi cho ga rab gnas kyi rgyal po/ thugs rje 'byung ba'i bsgom bzlas rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshul brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa dzñā na mi tras mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal khro bo gsang ba'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa pra ti wa na tsand+ras mdzad pa/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar gyi 'grel pa shu raṅga warmas mdzad pa grags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ pi pa la/ rnam snang mngon byang gi bsdus 'grel slob dpon gsang bas mdzad pa/ dpung bzang gi rgyud kyis bsdus don gyi 'grel pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ dpung bzang gi tshig don bshad pa'i brjed byang slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ kri ya sa mu tstsha'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga darban ā tsaryas mdzad pa/ sa bzang lo tstsha ba'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ phi pa la/ dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud kyi 'grel pa shu pa ka ras mdzad pa dā na shī la'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi 'grel pa bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ rnam 'joms kyi 'grel pa padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ legs grub kyi sgrub thabs byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i sgrub thabs ku mu ta ā ka ras mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/

so 'brang gi 'khor lo bri thabs shānti pas mdzad pa/ so 'brang*/ rma bya chen mo/ stong chen rab 'joms/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin/ bsil ba'i tshal rnams kyi sgrub thabs chung ngu re re/ so 'brang gi cho ga su ma ti kīrti'i mdzad pa dharmā kīrtis 'gyur/ so 'brang gi 'khor lo bri tshul/ paṇḍi ta pu ru ṣotta ma las nyan te/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ srung ba lnga'i cho ga shānti pas mdzad pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ srung ba lnga'i cho ga shānti pas mdzad pa nam mkha' rdo rje'i 'gyur/ 'di dang gong ma gnyis 'gyur khyad tsam ma gtogs gcig par snang ngo*// so 'brang gi cho ga gzungs las btus pa gong 'og gnyis/ srung ba lnga'i sgrub thabs dze tā ris mdzad pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ srung ba lnga'i cho ga phyed dang nyis brgya pa dze tā ris mdzad pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ so 'brang gi 'khor lo bri tshul dze tā ris mdzad pa ba ri ba'i 'gyur/ so 'brang gi 'khor lo bri tshul shānti pas mdzad pa/ so 'brang gi 'khor lo bri tshul ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa nam mkha' rdo rje'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gzungs kyi 'grel pa rdo rje go chas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rnam 'joms kyi dkyil chog drug pa shu raṅga warmas mdzad pa/ rnam 'joms sngon po'i chos skor la/ gtso bo rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs gaṃ ga dha ras mdzad pa/ lha bcu dgu'i cho ga ma ṇi badzras mdzad pa/ rnam 'joms la bstod pa/ bum pa'i cho ga sbyin sreg gi cho ga gtor ma'i cho ga las bzhi bsgrub pa'i cho ga las bzhi'i sbyin sreg las bzhi'i bum chog las bzhi'i 'khor lo'i cho ga las bsgrub pa'i gdams ngag las sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i cho ga rnams ma ṇi badzras mdzad pa rab zhi'i 'gyur/ rnam 'joms kyi khrus kyi cho ga'i 'grel pa rdo rje go chas mdzad pa/ las bco brgyad kyi sgrub thabs rdo rje go chas mdzad pa/

sgrol ma'i bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgrub thabs nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa mal jo'i 'gyur/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gi las kyi cho ga nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa mal jo'i 'gyur/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bi bhū ti tsand+ras mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i sgrub thabs shraddhā ka ras mdzad pa/ a ra pa tsa na mchod pa'i cho ga nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub thabs dze tā ri'i mdzod pa gzhon nu 'bar gyi 'gyur/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i sgrub thabs dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ gtso bo rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sgrub thabs dā na shī las mdzad pa/ mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad drug pa/ dā na shī las mdzad pa'i rtog pa bdun brgya pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rta mgrin phyag brgyad pa'i sgrub thabs tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ rta mgrin lha lnga'i sgrub thabs pra bha ka ras mdzad pa thar lo'i 'gyur/ rta mgrin phyag drug gi sgrub thabs mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ rta mgrin phyag bzhi'i sgrub thabs mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs stong nyid ting 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad par grags pa/ rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa 'jam dpal go cha'i 'gyur/ gos sngon can gtso bo rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs nyin mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga klu sgrub dang 'gro bzang snying po'i lugs don gcig tu bkod zer ba/ phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs 'gro bzang gis mdzad pa zangs dkar gyi 'gyur/ gter ma'i cho ga klu gtor gyi cho ga tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga rnams 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad par grags pa/ rnam sras kyi sgrub thabs 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa zangs dkar gyi 'gyur/ rnam sras drag byed kyi cho ga 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa zangs dkar gyi 'gyur/

rnam sras dmar po'i gsang sgrub dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad par grags pa/ rnam sras ljang gu lus ngan po'i sgrub thabs dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rnam sras kyi sgrub thabs shu raṅga warmas mdzad par grags pa zangs dkar gyis 'gyur/ dzambha la ser po'i sgrub thabs sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dzambha la lha dgu'i sgrub thabs sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ nor rgyun ma lha dgu'i sgrub thabs/ dzambha la nag po'i sgrub thabs sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa dā na shī la'i 'gyur/ dzambha la nag po'i sgrub thabs a bha yās mdzad pa chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ dzambha la nag po'i bstod pa btsun pa zla bas mdzad pa pa tshab 'gyur/ dzambha la ser po'i sgrub thabs ārya ma tis mdzad pa dharma grags kyi 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi cho ga mkhan po bo dhi sa twas mdzad par grags pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi cho ga mkhan po bo dhi sa twas mdzad pa shin tu dag pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ dge ba'i 'dod 'jo 'gos lotstsha bas bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// de ltar rdo rje theg pa'i dgongs 'grel mchog /'phags yul mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis gsal mdzad pa// gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal du byon pa rnams// glegs bam rin chen phung por bsgrubs pa 'di// dad pa'i phul gyi skyabs gsum gtsug gis mchod// snying rje'i stobs kyis 'khor 'bangs byams pas bskyangs// sbyin bdag chen po bzang po rgyal mtshan gyis// lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i bsam pas bsgrubs// 'dir 'bad dge bas sbyin pa'i bdag po dang*// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i// rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang thob par shog /gnas skabs kun du sbyin bdag yab sras rnams// tshe ring nad med bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub// mi mthun phyogs kyi gnod pa kun zhi nas// dpal 'byor yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par shog

/sangs rgyas bkra shis sku bzhi'i dpal gyi rtsen// dam chos bkra shis lung rtogs yon tan brnyes// dge 'dun bkra shis rim gnyis rtogs pas 'byor// bkra shis dam pas sbyin bdag bkra shis shog /ces pa glo bo brag dkar gyi gtsug lag khang du bris pa 'dis sbyin bdag gis thog drangs sems can thams cad bkra shis par gyur cig/ //

༄// bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi dkar chag thub bstan rgyas pa'i nyi 'od bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi dkar chag thub bstan rgyas pa'i nyi 'od ces bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// rmad byung tshogs gnyis chu gter dbus su 'khrungs// rnam dag byang chub spyod pa'i khams las grub// 'phags sras gser ri'i dbus na nyer mdzes pa// thub dbang rin chen rdul brtsegs la phyag 'tshal// rgyal bas gdul bya'i bsam pa ji bzhin du// sna tshogs tshul gyis gsungs pa'i mdo sde rnams// drang nges ji bzhin gsal bar 'grel mdzad pa// 'phags yul shing rta'i srol 'byed rnams la 'dud// dam chos lha yi skad las rang skad du// legs par bsgyur nas dam chos snang ba'i dpal// gangs can khrod du rgyas shing gsal mdzad pa// sgra bsgyur 'jig rten mig 'byed rnams la 'dud// rgya bod mkhas pa'i gsung rab ji snyed pa// mkhyen bzang gang gis thugs su legs chud nas// mtha' med 'gro la bstan pa spel mdzad pa// sa skya paṇa chen mkhas pa'i dbang phyug rgyal// mthu stobs chos kyi gaṇḍis bdud dpung 'joms// nus mthu ye shes rdo rje brtan pa dang*// bstan 'dzin legs bsrung nag po chen po yis// sbyin bdag rnams la kun du dge legs mdzod// chu skyes tshal du bung ba'i tshogs 'du ltar// gang gi gnas su gzhung bzang kun tshogs nas// glegs bam pad mo'i 'dab brgya gsal ba 'di// rnam dkar sngon dge las gzhan byed po su// 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa la gces spras su mdzad pa'i rgyal po dang*/ sbyin bdag dag ni/ chos smra ba'i gang zag la bsti stang phul du phyin pa mdzad nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas rgyas par mdzad pa yin la/ de dag gi bshad sgrub gang la bya ba'i chos kyang*/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhir bsdus pa'i gsung rab dri ma med pa rnams nas 'byung ba bzhin byed dgos la/

de'i ched du gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i glegs bam rnams 'bri ba dang*/ dag par bya ba dang*/ mi nub par bya ba ni chos ldan gyi rgyal po'i bya ba'i las yin no// don gyi dbang 'di gzigs nas dge legs kyi gnas/ glo bo'i sa'i cha smos thang bkra shis lhun gyis grub pa'i gling du/ rab byung gi lo bod kyi me mo yos kyi lor grags pa la/ bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi glegs bam brgya phrag gcig bzhengs pa'i thog mar/ ka pa la/ dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa slob dpon ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa rgyal ba'i sras kyis mdzad pa lotstsha ba dpal gyi lhun po'i 'gyur/ dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas gyi mtshan la bstod pa ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ bsngags par 'os pa la bsngags pa ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ de'i 'phros ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ gcig las 'phros pa'i bstod pa ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstod pa mtho btsun grub rjes mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa shes rab go chas mdzad pa/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas 'gyur bcos pa/ lha las phul byung gi bstod pa bde byed bdag pos mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa shes rab go chas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas la bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa shākya blo gros kyis 'gyur/ brgya lnga bcu pa'i bstod pa'i 'grel pa dga' byed snyems pas mdzad pa shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa/ bstod pa'i don bsdu ba/ phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa la bstod pa dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la bkra shis kyi bstod pa ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/

sangs rgyas kyi mtshan la bstod pa ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ rab tu snga bar nam langs pa'i bstod pa/ shrī ha ri ṣe de bas mdzad pa yon tan dpal gyi 'gyur/ spel mar bstod pa slob dpon ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa bsod nams bzang po'i 'gyur/ tshig brgyad pa'i bstod pa mtha' yas lhas mdzad pa/ rgyal ba brgyad kyi bstod pa mtha' yas lhas mdzad pa/ gaṇḍi'i bstod pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa dar ma yon tan gyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba'i bstod pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul la bstod pa/ chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa/ sems kyi rdo rje la bstod pa/ dpe med par bstod pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa la bstod pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa/ bstod pa las 'das par bstod pa/ bla na med pa'i bstod pa/ don dam par bstod pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la bstod pa/ gnas brgyad kyi mchod rten la bstod pa/ gnas chen po brgyad kyi mchod rten la bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gyi don dam pa'i bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gyi snying rje la bstod pa/ sku gsum la bstod pa ste/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis nas/ 'di'i bar rnams 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ sku gsum la bstod pa'i 'grel pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ sher phyin sbyor bzhi'i lha la bstod pa ratna kīrtis mdzad pa bal po ma hā pā ṇi'i 'gyur/ sems can mgu par bya ba'i bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ phyag 'tshal ba'i bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ dmyal ba nas 'don pa'i bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bstod pa/ sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga la bstod pa ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ rgyal ba rigs lnga la bstod pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun la bstod pa/ bde gshegs brgyad la bstod pa zhi ba 'tsho'i mdzad par grags pa/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas la bstod pa kha che paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa/

sangs rgyas la bstod pa nor rgyun mas mdzad pa/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'dul ba la bstod pa slob dpon chos kyi tshong dpon gyis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa dul lhas mdzad pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis 'gyur/ sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa la bstod pa chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa/ bshags pa'i bstod pa tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa sangs rgyas zhi bas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa mi g.yo seng ges mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa rdo rjes mtshon chas mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub la bstod pa ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po la bstod pa jo bo ma tis mdzad pa/ gsung gi dbang phyug la bstod pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis 'gyur/ 'jam dpal la khyad par gyis bstod pa/ ā nanta shrī mi tras mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma rnams kyi bstod pa rgyal ba'i snyan bzang pos mdzad pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis 'gyur/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal rnon po la bstod pa ngag gi dbang phyug la bu mo brgyad kyis bstod pa/ 'jam dpal la khye'u bcu drug gis bstod pa/ ngag gi dbang phyug lha lnga la bstod pa thig le bum pas mdzad pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa brgyad pa shri badzra de bas mdzad pa shong gi 'gyur/ don zhags lha bcu bdun la bstod pa/ thugs rje chen po la bstod cing bskul ba tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa tsarya kri bas mdzad pa/ don zhags lha lnga la bstod pa e ra pa tis mdzad pa/ spyan ras gzigs la bstod pa dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor bcas la bstod pa tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/

'jig rten dbang phyug la bstod pa dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa'i 'gyur dag shes/ nor bu gling gi thugs rje chen po lha lnga la bstod pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ 'jig rten mgon po la bstod pa/ yid 'phrog sdig 'joms tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ bcu gcig zhal la bstod pa dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gtso 'khor gsum la bstod pa dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa/ snying rje la bstod pa dge bsnyen kun sbyin gyis mdzad pa/ don zhags lha lnga la bstod pa tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ thugs rje chen po la smre sngags kyis bstod pa zla ba grags pas mdzad par grags pa/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon can la bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa birya tsand+ras mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa sku mchog 'bar ba/ mi g.yo ba sngon po la bstod pa dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ mi g.yo ba rigs lnga la bstod pa mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma la bstod pa me tog phreng 'dzin slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dpal chen mo la bstod pa tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ ku ru kulle la bstod pa ḍombi he ru kas mdzad pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ me tog phreng 'dzin gyi bstod pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob la bstod pa nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa/ dam tshig sgrol ma'i bstod pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad par grags pa/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma la bstod pa akṣo bhya badzras mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo la bstod pa ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa/

'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa paṇḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pas mdzad pa/ sgrol ma la don thams cad grub pa'i bstod pa ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi bstod pa bcu drug pa/ sgrol ma la bstod pa me tog phreng ba tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa yon tan dpal gyi 'gyur/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal la bstod pa tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ gdugs dkar can la bstod pa gi ri wartes mdzad pa/ nor rgyun ma la bstod pa dza ma ris mdzad pa/ dbyangs can ma la bstod pa bram ze phur bus byas pa/ rnam thos sras la bstod pa thugs rje ba 'jo mar grags pa rnams bzhugs so// de ltar bstod pa'i gzhung dri ma med pa rnams mchod brjod kyi tshul gyis bkod nas/ ༈ /da ni bstan bcos rnams kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs bshad par bya ste/ de yang theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par ma byas na// 'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te// de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes bzung dang*// bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed// ces bshad pa ltar/ gzhung thams cad rig pa'i gnas lngar 'du la/ de dag kyang bstan pa la rim gyis 'jug pa'i dbang du byas nas/ skye bo gso thig la sogs pa 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos la mkhas shing lag len la 'debs pa'i gang zag gcig gi thog mar bzo rig pa'i gzhung la bslab/ de nas gso ba rig pa sman gyi gzhung dang*/ de nas sgra rig pa/ tha snyad sde lnga'i gzhung mtha' dag dang*/ de nas gtan tshigs rig pa tshad ma'i gzhung lugs rnams dang*/ de'i rjes su zab mo nang rig pa'i sde snod rnams la slob pa yin kyang*/ 'dir bstan bcos rnams glegs bam du sgrig pa'i tshe/ mchog dman gyi rim pas thog mar zab mo nang rig pa'i sde snod kyi skor dang*/ gtan tshigs rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ gso ba rig pa/ bzo rig pa dang lnga'i dang po la/ rdo rje theg pa dang*/

pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa gnyis las/ rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa rnams kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs logs su bkod zin la/ 'dir skabs su bab pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang 'brel ba'i bstan bcos dri ma med pa rnams kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs bshad par bya ba la gsum/ bka' dang po bden pa bzhi dang 'brel pa'i gzhung*/ bar pa mtshan nyid med pa dang 'grel pa'i gzhung*/ tha ma don dam rnam par nges pa dang 'grel pa'i gzhung rnams las/ sngon gyi bstan 'gyur mkhan po rnams kyis bka' bar pa nas mgo brtsams pas/ de ltar bshad na/ chos 'khor bar ba'i mdo yi 'grel pa dang*/ dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos gnyis kyi dang po ni/ kha pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'bum pa dang*/ nyi khri lnga stong pa dang*/ khri brgyad stong pa rnams kyi bshad pa/ slob dpon chen po dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur bzhugs so// ga pa la/ paṇḍi ta daṃṣṭa se na'i 'bum ṭīka tu grags pa'i stod bzhugs so// nga pa la/ de'i smad yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ 'bum gyi bshad pa kha che dharmā shrīs mdzad pa/ yum gyi ṭī ka paṇḍi ta smṛ tis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// ca pa la/ slob dpon seng ge bzang pos nyi khri le brgyad ma'i le'u lnga pa yan chad bzhugs so// cha pa la/ de'i le'u drug pa'i 'grel pa bzhugs so// ja pa la/ le'u brgyad pa yan chad yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'grel pa lotstsha ba tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ nyi khri'i 'grel pa 'phags pa rnam grol sdes mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// nya pa la/ nyi khri'i gzhung 'grel slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ nyi khri'i 'grel pa dag ldan slob dpon shānti pas mdzad pa dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje gcod pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/

chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po'i 'grel pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// ta pa la/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i 'grel chen slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa/ blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// tha pa la/ brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa/ man ngag gi rjes su 'brang ba/ rgyal po dza gaddha la mar grags pa tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyi 'gyur/ brgyad stong pa'i don bsdus kyi 'grel pa kha che gzhon nu dpal gyis mdzad pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ brgyad stong pa'i don bsdus sgron ma mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// da pa la/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa gnad kyi zla 'od slob dpon a bha yās mdzad pa shes rab dpal gyi 'gyur/ brgyad stong don bsdus slob dpon phyogs glang gis mdzad pa/ shes phyin don bsdus/ tshigs bcad dgu pa'i 'grel pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa shes rab snying po'i 'grel pa bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa bande nam mkha'i 'gyur/ sher snying gi 'grel pa don gyi sgron me/ sher snying gi sgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad par grags pa stag pa lotstsha ba'i 'gyur/ shes rab snying po'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ sher snying gi 'grel pa padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad par grags pa/ sher snying gi 'grel pa dzñā na mi tras mdzad pa/ sher snying gi 'grel pa ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// na pa la/ 'phags pa sdud pa'i dka' 'grel ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ sdud pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ sdud pa'i lde mig kha che dharmā shrīs mdzad pa/ sher phyin bdun brgya pa'i 'grel pa dri med bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ shes phyin bdun brgya pa'i 'grel pa ka ma la shī las mdzad pa nam mkha' skyong gi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/

pa pa la/ sa lu ljang pa'i mdo 'grel tshig le'ur byas pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ sa lu ljang pa'i mdo yi 'grel pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa sa lu ljang pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ mdo kun las btus pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ mdo kun las btus pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// de ltar shar phyogs kyi mdo'i 'grel pa rnams bkod nas/ de'i dgongs pa 'grel pa'i gzhung la/ sbas don nyams len gyi rim pa ston pa'i gzhung dang*/ dngos stong nyid ston pa'i gzhung gnyis kyi dang po ni/ pha pa la/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rgyal ba byams pas mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa don gsal slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'grel pa don gsal gyi dka' 'grel gser gling pa chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'grel pa don gsal gyi 'grel bshad dbu ma pa chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa kha che buddha shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa byams pa dpal gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// gnyis pa dngos bstan stong nyid ston pa'i gzhung la/ gzhung phyi mo'i bstan bcos dang*/ dgongs pa 'grel pa'i bstan bcos gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ ba pa la/ bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ rig pa drug cu pa/ stong nyid bdun bcu pa khu'i 'gyur/ stong nyid bdun bcu pa'i rang 'grel ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ zhib mo rnam 'thag gi rang 'grel gzhon nu mchog gi 'gyur/ rtsod pa bzlog pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ rtsod bzlog gi rang 'grel rnams bzhugs shing*/

'phags pas mdzad pa'i dbu ma'i gzhung gzhan rnams dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa'i dbu ma'i gzhung gzhan rnams kyang 'dir bsdu'o/ gnyis pa dgongs pa 'grel pa'i bstan bcos la/ thal rang gnyis las/ dang po thal 'gyur ba'i skor la/ rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel pa buddha pā li tas mdzad pa cog ro'i 'gyur/ rtsa she'i 'grel pa tshig gsal slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa pa tshab kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// ma pa la/ dbu ma bzhi brgya pa slob dpon ārya de bas mdzad pa pa tshab kyi 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa zla ba grags pas mdzad pa pa tshab 'gyur/ rig pa drug bcu pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa pa tshab 'gyur/ dbu ma la 'jug pa'i gzhung dang*/ de'i rang 'grel gnyis slob dpon zla ba grags kyis mdzad pa pa tshab 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// tsa pa la/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel bshad dza ya ā nandas mdzad pa kun dga' grags kyi 'gyur bzhugs so// gnyis pa rang rgyud pa'i chos skor ni/ tsha pa la/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying po/ de'i 'grel pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ dbu ma 'khrul pa bzlog pa ārya de bas mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ dbu ma lag pa'i tshad ārya de bas mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa ārya de bas mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel pa ga las 'jigs med 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad par grags pa/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa shes rab sgron me slob dpon legs ldan byed kyis mdzad pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// dza wa zha/ gsum la 'grel pa shes rab sgron me'i 'grel bshad/ slob dpon spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs kyis mdzad pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur bzhugs so// za pa la/ rtog ge 'bar ba/ slob dpon bha byas mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ dbu ma rin chen sgron ma slob dpon bha byas mdzad par grags pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// 'a pa la/
