dbu ma bden gnyis kyi 'grel pa slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa/ bden gnyis kyi dka' 'grel slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa/ dbu ma rgyan gyi gzhung slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dbu ma rgyan gyi dka' 'grel slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel pa slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dbu ma snang ba slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par grub pa slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ de kho na nyid snang ba'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ dbu ma shes rab 'jug pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa 'gos kyis 'gyur/ dbu ma rnam pa med pa'i tshig dga' ba'i dpal gyis mdzad pa/ rtog ge'i tho ba dza ya ā nantas mdzad pa mdo sde 'bar gyi 'gyur/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag thub dbang zla bas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ ye shes snying po kun las btus 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa gnas brtan byang bzang gis mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dbu ma'i snying po mdor bsdus pa bidyā ka ra pra bhās mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ rin po che'i phreng ba tsand+ra ha ris mdzad pa ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i 'gyur/ lta ba 'thad pa rnam par phye ba dbu ma seng ges mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dbu ma'i man ngag rin po che'i za ma tog kha phye ba mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ bsgom pa'i rim pa mdo kun las btus pa/ shes phyin bsgom pa'i man ngag dzñā na kīrtis mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom don bcu gnyis pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ sku gsum la 'jug pa'i sgo klu'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/

de'i 'grel pa ye shes zla bas mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// de ltar bka' bar pa'i dgongs 'grel rnams bkod nas/ ༈ /da ni bka' tha ma don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos skor la/ mdo'i 'grel pa dang*/ dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ya pa la/ 'phags pa dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i rnam bshad slob dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi rgya cher 'grel pa rgya'i mkhan po wan brtsegs kyis mdzad pa'i stod rnams bzhugs so// ra pa la/ 'grel pa de nyid kyi smad rdzogs pa chos grub kyi 'gyur bzhugs/ la pa la/ dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi 'grel chen gu ṇa shrī'i mdzad pa bzhugs so// sha pa la/ lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa dzñā na badzras mdzad pa bzhugs so// sa pa la/ dam pa'i chos padma dkar po'i 'grel pa sa'i rtsa lag gis mdzad pa/ lang dkar gshegs pa'i 'grel pa ye shes dpal bzang pos mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// ha pa la/ 'phags pa blo gros mi bzad pas bstan pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa slob dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa 'od srung gi le'u'i 'grel pa slob dpon blo brtan gyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// a pa la/ 'phags pa sa bcu pa'i gleng gzhi'i bshad pa shākya blos mdzad pa/ sa bcu'i rnam par bshad pa dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ sa bcu pa'i mdo'i 'grel bshad nyi ma grub kyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ ki pa la/ 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo'i 'grel pa slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas sa'i 'grel pa slob dpon ngang tshul bzang pos mdzad pa/ rten cing 'brel pa 'byung ba dang po dang*/ rnam par dbye ba bshad pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa dge slong nam mkha'i 'gyur/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang po dang*/

rnam par 'byed pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa slob dpon yon tan blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ dge slong nam mkha'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// khi pa la/ sangs rgyas rjes dran gyi 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas rjes dran gyi 'grel pa/ chos rjes dran gyi 'grel pa/ dge 'dun rjes dran gyi 'grel pa slob dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ ga ya go ri'i mdo'i 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa ga ya go ri'i mdo dang*/ dbyig gnyen gyi 'grel pa gnyis spel mar sbyar ba shākya blos mdzad pa/ 'phags pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i gzungs kyi 'grel pa slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ sgo mtha' yas pa bsgrub pa'i gzungs kyi rnam par bshad pa dang*/ de'i 'grel pa gnyis ka slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'da' ka ye shes kyi 'grel pa pradzñā sa mu dras mdzad pa/ 'da' ka ye shes kyi 'grel pa slob dpon zhi ba lhas mdzad pa 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas phal po che'i mdo'i dum bu/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi 'grel pa phyogs glang gis mdzad pa/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi 'grel pa rgyan bzang pos mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ bzang spyod kyi rgya cher 'grel pa shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ bzang spyod smon lam gyi bshad sbyar klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo'i dum bu/ byang chub ltung bshags kyi 'grel pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ byang chub ltung bshags kyi 'grel pa pra bha ka ra shrī mi tras mdzad pa shes rab legs kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa'i bshad pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/

tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i bshad pa slob dpon mdzes bkod kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa sgo drug pa'i gzungs kyi bshad pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa chos bzhi pa'i rnam par bshad pa dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ chos bzhi pa'i rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon ye shes byin gyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ gnyis pa bka' tha ma'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos ni/ gi pa la/ theg pa chen po'i dgongs 'grel mdo sde'i rgyan rgyal ba byams pas mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel pa dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ mdo sde rgyan gyi rgya cher bshad pa ngo bo nyid med pas mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ ngi pa la/ mdo sde rgyan gyi tshigs bcad dang po gnyis kyi bshad pa slob dpon gzhan phan bzang pos mdzad pa gzhon nu mchog gi 'gyur/ mdo sde rgyan gyi don bsdus dzñā na shrīs mdzad pa/ chos kyi brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur dang*/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel bshad chen po slob dpon blo brtan gyis mdzad pa'i stod bzhugs/ ci pa la/ de'i smad yongs su rdzogs pa lce bkra shis kyi 'gyur bzhugs/ chi pa la/ dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa rgyal ba byams pas mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed kyi 'grel bshad slob dpon blo brtan gyis mdzad pa/ chos nyid rnam 'byed kyi gzhung tshigs bcad ma seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ gzhung lhug pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ chos dang chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos rgyal ba byams pas mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/

rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ ji pa la/ rgyas pa'i bstan bcos sa sde lnga las/ sa'i dngos gzhi dang*/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa dang*/ sa bcu bdun pa dang*/ sa mang po pa ste/ mtshan bzhi dang ldan pa'i gzhung dang*/ sa'i stod 'grel bsgyur 'phro rnams bzhugs/ nyi pa la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang*/ nyan thos kyi sa gnyis tshang bar bzhugs so// ti pa la/ rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba tshang bar bzhugs/ thi pa la/ gzhi bsdu ba/ 'dul ba bsdu ba/ rnam grangs bsdu ba/ rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bsdu ba ste/ sa sde lnga yongs su rdzogs pa 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa ye shes sde dang klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur rnams dang*/ byang sa'i 'grel pa yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ sdom pa nyi shu pa slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa mañdzu shri'i 'gyur/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i dka' 'grel byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa byang chub shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ di pa la/ byang sa'i 'grel pa slob dpon rgya mtsho sprin gyis mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur bzhugs/ ni pa la/ theg pa chen po bsdus pa 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ theg bsdus kyi 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ theg bsdus kyi bshad sbyar ngo bo nyid med pas mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ theg bsdus kyi bshad sbyar don gsang rnam phye bsgyur 'phro rnams bzhugs/ pi pa la/ mngon pa kun las btus pa 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ kun las btus kyi 'grel pa slob dpon rgyal ba'i sras kyis mdzad pa/ 'grel pa rgyal sras ma 'gyur chad bsabs shing*/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis dag par bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// phi pa la/

phung po lnga'i rab byed dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ phung po lnga'i rab byed kyi 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ phung po lnga'i rab byed kyi 'grel pa blo brtan gyis mdzad pa/ phung po lnga'i rab byed kyi 'grel pa yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ nyi shu pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon dul lhas mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ sum cu pa dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ sum cu pa'i bshad pa blo brtan gyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sems tsam gyi gzhung dbu ma rgyan dang*/ de'i 'grel pa gnyis slob dpon shānti pas mdzad pa shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ phung po lnga'i rab byed slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// bi pa la/ rnam bshad rig pa'i mdo sde'i dum bu brgya pa mañdzu shrī dharmā'i 'gyur/ rnam bshad rig pa dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa de wend+ra rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ rnam bshad rig pa'i 'grel pa de wend+ra rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ las grub pa'i rab tu byed pa dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ las grub pa'i 'grel pa blo bzang ngang tshul gyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// mi pa la/ thub pa dgongs rgyan slob dpon a bha yā ka ras mdzad pa dpang lotstsha ba blo gros brtan pa'i 'gyur bzhugs so// tsi pa la/ spyod pa la 'jug pa'i gzhung slob dpon zhi ba lhas mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ spyod 'jug gi 'grel pa nag po pas mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ spyod 'jug gi 'grel pa bai ro tsa nas mdzad pa/ spyod 'jug gi 'grel pa sher 'byung blo gros kyis mdzad pa chos grags kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// tshi pa la/ spyod 'jug gi mdo sbyor pra dzñā dzwa la kīrtis mdzad pa/

spyod 'jug gi 'grel pa bi bhū ti tsand+ras mdzad pa de nyid kyi rang 'gyur/ spyod 'jug gi don bsdus slob dpon chos skyong gis mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ spyod 'jug gi bsdus don don bcu gcig pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ shes rab le'u'i dka' 'grel sbyangs pa'i yon tan bstan pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// dzi pa la/ bslab pa kun las btus pa rtsa ba slob dpon zhi ba lhas mdzad pa/ bslab pa kun las btus pa chen po zhi ba lhas mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur la/ blo ldan shes rab kyis bcos pa/ bslab btus kyi don bsdus jo bo rjes mdzad pa/ sdig bshags kyi cho ga slob dpon zhi ba lhas mdzad pa/ ltung ba spyi bshags mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ bslab pa me tog snye ma bai ro tsa nas mdzad pa/ gzhon nu 'bar gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// wi pa la/ bshes pa'i spring yig slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ bshes spring gi 'grel pa blo gros chen pos mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ gtam bya rin chen phreng ba klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ rin chen phreng ba'i 'grel pa mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu'i gtam slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa grags mchog gi 'gyur/ sbyin pa'i gtam/ srid pa las 'das pa'i gtam/ yon tan yongs su brjod pa'i gtam rnams slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ tshul khrims kyi gtam dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ tshul khrims kyi gtam gyi 'grel pa rab gsal grags kyis mdzad pa/ tshogs kyi gtam slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ mi khom pa brgyad kyi gtam rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ phyin ci log bzhi spong ba'i gtam ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi gtam ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/

legs bshad rin chen za ma tog lta bu'i gtam slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa/ slob ma la springs pa tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ slob spring gi dka' 'grel bai ro tsa nas mdzad pa/ slob spring gi 'grel pa sher 'byung blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ rgyal po ka ni ska la springs pa ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ dri ma med pa'i dris lan rin chen phreng ba don yod 'char gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis dge slong rab gsal gzhon nu la springs pa/ shes rab kyi spring yig padma rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sems rnam par sbyangs pa'i spring yig dgra las rgyal bas mdzad pa/ bla ma la springs pa dge slong dgon pa bas mdzad pa/ bu la springs pa sadzdza nas mdzad pa rnams so// de nas spyod phyogs su grags pa la/ skyabs 'gro bdun cu pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa bi ma las mdzad pa/ skyabs 'gro bstan pa shākya shrīs mdzad pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa bzung ba'i cho ga 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ sems bskyed dang yi dam blang ba'i cho ga dgra las rgyal bas mdzad pa/ sems bskyed dang sdom pa'i cho ga mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ dge ba'i sdong po ratna kīrtis mdzad pa/ dran pa nyer gzhag gi tshig le'ur byas pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ legs pa'i lam bstan pa'i lam dpa' bos mdzad pa/ chos dang chos smra ba la gus par bya ba'i gtam 'tsho sbyin gyis mdzad pa/ ched du brjod pa'i gtam zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ mi rtag pa'i don gyi gtam dga' ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ shes rab brtsam pa'i dus kyi gtam gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i bsam gtan ka ro pas mdzad pa/ phar phyin gyi bsgom rim ye shes 'byung gnas zla bas mdzad pa/ shes phyin bsdus pa ārya shwa ras mdzad pa/ shes phyin gyi man ngag shānti pas mdzad pa 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// zhi pa la/

jo bo chen po rjes mdzad pa'i chos chung brgya rtsa grags pa la/ thog mar byang chub lam gyi sgron ma/ spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma/ bden pa gnyis la 'jug pa/ dbu ma'i man ngag snying po bsdu ba/ snying po nges par bsdu ba/ byang chub kyi sems nor bu'i phreng ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdo tsam du bya ba/ spyod pa'i glu/ theg chen lam gyi sgrub thabs/ theg chen lam gyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa rang gi bya ba'i rim pa/ mdo sde kun las btus pa'i man ngag 'khor ba las yid 'byung ba'i glu/ mi dge ba bcu'i lam bstan pa/ las rnam par dbye ba/ rdo rje gdan gyi glu/ ting nge 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yan lag bdun pa/ kha ton dang glegs bam bklag pa'i sngon du bya ba'i cho ga pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyi tsha tsha gdab pa'i cho ga bla ma'i bya ba'i rim pa/ sems bskyed sdom pa'i cho ga ste/ 'di yan chad jo bo chen po rjes mdzad pa'o// de'i rjes su byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i cho ga byang bzang gis mdzad pa/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ sems bskyed dang yi dam blang ba'i cho ga dgra las rgyal bas mdzad pa/ las dang po ba'i spyad pa dgra las rgyal bas mdzad pa/ sems sbyang ba'i rim pa'i spring yig dgra las rgyal bas mdzad pa bshes pa'i spring yig slob ma la springs pa/ rgyal po ka ni ska la springs pa/ dri ma med pa'i dris lan/ rab gsal gzhon nu la spring yig shes rab brgya pa/ dran pa nyer gzhag gi tshig le'ur byas pa/ mi dge ba bcu'i las lam bstan pa dang*/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bstan pa gnyis rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ mya ngan bsal ba/ gzhon nu ma bdun gyi rtogs brjod/ yon tan yongs su brjod pa'i gtam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam/ tshogs kyi gtam/ mi khom pa brgyad kyi gtam/ legs par bshad pa za ma tog lta bu'i gtam/ phyin ci log bzhi spong ba'i gtam/

rtsod pa'i dus kyi gtam/ dben pa'i gtam/ yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga sems can mgu bar bya ba'i tshigs bcad/ smon lam bdun cu pa/ don dam byang chub sems kyi bsgom tshul/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi bsgom tshul/ dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa/ 'dod yon lnga'i nyes dmigs bshad pa/ mdo sde rtog pa chen po'i cho ga de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa'i cho ga maṇḍal gyi cho ga sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga dgra las rgyal bas mdzad pa/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga rnyog med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga kaṃ pa las mdzad pa/ ting nge 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa/ ting nge 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u nag po pas mdzad pa/ bsam gtan gyi chos drug a wa dhū tī pas mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa dā na shī las mdzad pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs bsal ba/ rnal 'byor rtog pa'i gegs sel ba sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid bden pa byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa la 'jug pa ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i lam ye shes snying pos mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor la 'jug pa phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa/ mi sdug pa bsgom pa'i rim pa lus yongs su bcad pa'i bsgom rim nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ phar phyin theg pa'i bsgom rim ye shes grags pas mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom pa blo gros chen pos mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i man ngag chos kyi dbang pos mdzad pa/ shes phyin bsgom pa'i man ngag ye shes zla bas mdzad pa/ chos kyi dbyings su blta ba'i man ngag jo bos mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur rnams so// mdo kun las btus pa chen po zhes bya ba jo bo chen po rjes mdzad pa mdo sde 'bar gyi 'gyur/ mdo kun las btus pa'i don bsdus jo bos mdzad pa/

mdo kun las btus pa'i man ngag jo bos mdzad pa/ las kyi sgrub pa rnam par sbyong ba'i cho ga jo bos mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// zi pa la/ thub pa'i skyes rabs sum cu so bzhi pa slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa mañdzu shri barmā'i 'gyur/ skyes rabs kyi 'grel pa dharmā kīrtis mdzad pa shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur bzhugs so// 'i pa la/ skyes rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing shong ston gyi 'gyur bzhugs so// yi pa la/ skyes rabs kyi phreng ba slob dpon seng ge zhabs 'bring pas mdzad pa tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyi 'gyur/ gzhon nu ma bdun gyi rtogs brjod rgyas pa gsang ba byin gyis mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ gser mdog gi rtogs brjod rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs brjod shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ ku na li'i rtogs brjod rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dgra bcom pa dge 'dun 'phel gyi lung bstan pa/ mya ngan med pa'i sgo nas klu brtul ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ dpe'i phreng ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ li'i yul lung bstan pa/ gnas brtan spyan drangs tshul rnams bzhugs so// //da ni bka' dang po bden pa bzhi bstan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs 'grel la/ lta ba'i cha gtan la 'bebs pa'i gzhung dang*/ spyod pa'i cha gtan la 'bebs pa'i gzhung gnyis kyi dang po ni/ ri pa la/ 'jig rten gdags pa'i mdo/ rgyu gdags pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ las gdags pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rgyu gdags pa'i don rigs pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ tshigs su bcad pa bsdus pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ mngon pa la 'jug pa/ snying po kun las btus pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// li pa la/ chos mngon pa mdzod kyi gzhung dang*/ 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa gnyis bzhugs/

shi si gnyis la/ mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel bshad/ slob dpon rgyal po'i sras grags pa bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa dang*/ mdzod kyi dka' 'grel gang ba spel gyis mdzad pa nyung ngu nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// hi i gnyis la/ mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel bshad gang ba spel gyis mdzad pa nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur bzhugs/ ku pa la/ mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa slob dpon zhi gnas lhas mdzad pa shes rab 'od zer gyi 'gyur bzhugs/ khu pa la/ mdzod kyi 'grel pa slob dpon phyogs glang gis mdzad pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ mdzod kyi 'grel pa mdo dang mthun pa slob dpon 'dul bzang gis mdzad pa bzhugs/ gu pa la/ ched du brjod pa'i tshom dgra bcom pa chos skyob kyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ ched du brjod pa'i tshom gyi 'grel pa pradzñā warmas mdzad pa shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// ngu cu gnyis la/ chos 'khor gsum dang*/ grub mtha' bzhis bsdus pa'i gzhung rnams rig pas gtan la 'bebs pa la/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i gzhung slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis bsgyur ba dang*/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa grags mchog shes rab kyis bsgyur ba bzhugs so// //gnyis pa chos 'khor dang po'i spyod pa'i cha gtan la 'bebs pa'i gzhung la/ dka' 'grel dang*/ dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ chu pa la/ so so thar pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa yon tan phun tshogs mar grags pa/ dge slong ma'i so so thar pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa rnams bzhugs/ ju pa la/ so so thar pa'i mdo'i gzhung 'grel bam po nyer bdun pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur bzhugs so// nyu tu gnyis la/ so so thar pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa bam po lnga bcu pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur bzhugs so// thu pa la/ 'dul ba bsdus pa khyad par bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa shākya bshes gnyen gyi 'gyur/

so so thar pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa mi brjed dran byed rnams bzhugs/ de nas bshad lung gi 'grel pa ni/ du pa la/ lung bzhi'i 'grel pa 'phro can/ rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa slob dpon dul lhas mdzad pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// nu pa la/ gzhung bla ma'i 'grel pa dum bu/ lung phran tshegs kyi 'grel pa slob dpon tshul khrims skyong gis mdzad pa dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ gnyis pa lung sde bzhi'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos ni/ pu pa la/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ mdo rtsa'i 'grel pa nyid kyi rnam bshad du grags pa'i stod bzhugs/ phu pa la/ nyid kyi rnam bshad kyi smad dang*/ las brgya rtsa gcig pa slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// bu mu gnyis la/ mdo rtsa ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ slob dpon chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur bzhugs/ tsu pa la/ mdo rtsa'i 'grel chung slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa bzhugs/ tshu pa la/ mdo rtsa'i 'grel pa slob dpon shes rab byed pas mdzad pa/ 'dul ba sum brgya pa'i gzhung slob dpon shākya 'od kyis mdzad pa/ sum brgya pa'i rang 'grel 'od ldan de wend+ra rakṣi ta'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// dzu pa la/ 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud/ 'phags pa sa ga'i lhas mdzad pa shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ 'dul ba dri ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa dang*/ de'i 'grel pa gnyis dge legs bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'dul ba bya ba'i phung po bsgyur 'phro/ 'dul ba sum brgya pa'i 'grel pa dul ba'i lhas mdzad pa dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ ka ri ka lnga bcu pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ ka ri ka lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/

dge tshul gyi bya ba/ gzhung tha dad pa rim par bklag pa'i 'khor lo las/ sde pa tha dad bstan pa rnams dul lhas mdzad pa/ gzhung lugs kyi bye brag bkod pa dbyig bshes kyis mdzad pa bzang skyong gi 'gyur/ sde pa tha dad pa rnam par bshad pa bha byas mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ dge slong gi dang po'i lo dri ba padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ dge tshul gyi dang po'i lo dri ba/ dge tshul gyi bslab pa'i gzhi mdo dge legs bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa gzhon nu mchog gi 'gyur/ gleng gzhi dang gang zag bsdus pa'i gzhung ba la shris mdzad pa gzhon du mchog gi 'gyur/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa brgyad pa rtsa ba dang 'grel pa gnyis puṇye shrīs mdzad pa/ dar ma grags kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// de ltar chos 'khor rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa dang*/ dgongs 'grel gyi gzhung ji snyed pa rnams bkod nas/ da ni gtan tshigs rig pa tshad ma'i skor la/ wu pa la/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa'i tshad ma kun las btus pa'i rtsa ba/ de'i rang 'grel gnyis zha ma seng rgyal gyi 'gyur/ rig pa la 'jug pa'i sgo grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dus gsum brtag pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ gtan tshigs 'khor lo dharmā ā lo ke'i 'gyur/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po'i gzhung rnam grangs lnga dang*/ slob dpon chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i tshad ma rnam par 'grel pa chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta'i 'gyur/ tshad ma rnam par nges pa lotstsha ba blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rigs pa'i thigs pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ gtan tshigs thigs pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'brel pa brtag pa bande nam mkha'i 'gyur/ rgyud gzhan grub pa'i rab tu byed pa/ rtsod pa'i rig pa shong blo brtan gyi 'gyur/ rnam 'grel le'u dang po'i 'grel pa yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa'i gzhung bdun rnams bzhugs so// zhu pa la/

rnam 'grel le'u dang po'i rang 'grel gyi stod/ 'gyur rnying 'phro can/ rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa man chad kyi 'grel pa/ slob dpon lha dbang blos mdzad pa dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// zu 'u gnyis la/ rnam 'grel le'u dang po'i rang 'grel/ le'u gnyis pa man chad lha dbang blos mdzad pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'grel bshad/ slob dpon shākya blos mdzad pa dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur bzhugs so// yu ru gnyis la/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'grel bshad rgyan/ slob dpon shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur bzhugs so// lu shu gnyis la/ rnam 'grel gyi rgyan gyi 'grel bshad slob dpon rgyal ba can gyis mdzad pa byang chub shes rab kyi 'gyur bzhugs so// su pa la/ rnam 'grel rgyan gyi le'u dang po'i 'grel bshad/ slob dpon ya ma ris mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur bzhugs so// hu pa la/ rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa bzhugs so// u pa la/ rnam 'grel le'u dang po'i stod kyi 'grel bshad/ slob dpon bram ze chen pos mdzad pa bzhugs so// ke pa la/ rigs thigs kyi phyogs snga ma bshad pa slob dpon ka ma la shi las mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ rigs thig kyi don bsdus dzi na mi tras mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rigs thigs kyi 'grel pa slob dpon chos mchog gis mdzad pa dharmā ā lo ke'i 'gyur/ rigs thigs kyi 'grel pa slob dpon dul ba lhas mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dmigs pa brtag pa slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa/ dmigs pa brtag pa'i rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon dul ba'i lhas mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ tshad ma rnam par nges pa'i 'grel pa ye shes dpal bzang pos mdzad pa chos kyi brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ tshad ma rnam par nges pa'i 'grel pa/

slob dpon chos mchog gis mdzad pa'i le'u dang po rnams bzhugs/ khe pa la/ rnam nges le'u gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon chos mchog gis mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur bzhugs/ ge pa la/ gtan tshigs thigs pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon dul lhas mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ gtan tshigs thigs pa'i 'grel pa bram ze ardza ṭas mdzad pa/ 'grel pa brtag pa'i 'grel pa lha dbang blos mdzad pa/ 'grel pa brtag pa'i rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon dul lhas mdzad pa bande nam mkha'i 'gyur/ 'brel pa brtag pa'i 'grel pa/ bram ze shang ka ra nandas mdzad pa dga' ba'i rdo rje'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// nge pa la/ rgyud gzhan grub pa'i 'grel bshad slob dpon dul lhas mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ rtsod rigs kyi 'grel pa bsgyur 'phro gcig rtsod rigs kyi 'grel pa slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa 'phags pa shes rab dang 'bro seng dkar gyi 'gyur/ rgyu 'bras ngo bo grub pa dzñā na shris mdzad pa shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ byis pa 'jug pa'i rtog ge dgra las rgyal bas mdzad pa suṃ pa lotstsha ba'i 'gyur/ chos dang chos can gtan la phab pa dze tā ris mdzad pa/ gtan tshigs kyi de kho na nyid bstan pa dze tā ris mdzad pa shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ nang gi khyab pa rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ rnam rig tsam du grub pa rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa shes rab brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ phyi rol don grub dge srung gis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ thams cad mkhyen pa grub pa/ thos pa brtag pa/ gzhan sel brtag pa/ dbang phyug 'jigs pa rnams dge srung gis mdzad pa/ tshad ma brtag pa che ba slob dpon chos mchog gis mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ tshad ma brtag pa chung ba chos mchog gis mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ gzhan sel gyi rab tu phyed pa/ skad cig ma 'jigs pa grub pa rnams slob dpon chos mchog gis mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/

skad cig ma 'jigs pa grub pa'i 'grel pa bram ze mu tig bum pas mdzad pa grags mchog shes rab kyi 'gyur/ sel ba grub pa chung ba/ sel ba grub pa che ba gnyis shang ka rā nandas mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// de nas sgra rig pa'i skor ni/ ce pa la/ sgra'i bstan bcos tsand+ra pa'i gzhung*/ nyer bsgyur nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ sgra ka la pa'i gzhung grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ sgra ka la pa'i 'grel pa bgrod dka' seng ges mdzad pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ smra ba kun la 'jug pa dang*/ de'i 'grel pa gnyis su bha ṣa kīrtis mdzad pa/ rab tu sbyor ba'i sgo'i 'grel pa/ bsgyur 'phro gcig ldog pa bsdus pa'i rtsa ba dang*/ 'grel pa slob dpon ni bi dharmās mdzad pa/ smra sgo mtshon cha smṛ tis mdzad pa/ de'i rang 'grel du grags pa gcig su wanta dpyal lotstsha bas bsgyur ba dang*/ sngon gyi sgra sbyor bam po gnyis mar grags pa rnams bzhugs so// ce pa gnyis pa la/ sgra ka la pa'i 'grel pa jo bo drag 'byor gyis mdzad pa dpang blo gros brtan pa dang lotstsha ba byang chub rtse mos bsgyur/ uṇa rgyas par bshad pa lotstsha ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// che pa la/ sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa bcu gnyis snyan ngag tu sbyar ba slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ snyan ngag me long slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa shong blo brtan gyi 'gyur/ gtam rgyud lnga pa'i snyan ngag khyab 'jug dpal gyis mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur te snyan ngag gi gzhung gsum mo// sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos rin chen 'byung gnas slob dpon shānti pas mdzad pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'jig rten gsum kun du dga' ba'i zlos gar tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ klu kun du dga' ba'i zlos gar dga' ba'i lhas mdzad pa/

shong gi 'gyur te zlos gar gyi gzhung gnyis so// de nas gso ba rig pa'i skor la/ 'tsho ba'i mdo 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ sman sbyor ba brgya pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa shong gi 'gyur te gso ba rig pa'i gzhung gnyis so// yan lag brgyad pa rtsa 'grel gnyis glegs bam ches pas 'og tu bris so// de nas bzo rig pa'i skor la/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ de'i 'grel pa drang srong e dra'i bus mdzad pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur te gnyis so// de nas 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos ni/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi gtsug lag 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ drang srong gar gha'i ltas bshad pa'i gtsug lag le'u bco lnga pa/ gza' skar gyi bzang ngan brtag pa mdo las btus pa/ lugs kyi bstan bcos/ skye bo gso thig 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ shes rab brgya pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur te/ lugs kyi bstan bcos bco lnga bzhugs so// je pa la/ sman yan lag brgyad pa'i gzhung*/ slob dpon pha khol gyis mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur bzhugs so// nye te gnyis la/ sman yan lag brgyad pa'i 'grel pa zla zer slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas mdzad pa lotstsha ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur bzhugs so// the pa la/ bod kyi lotstsha ba chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos dpe dkon pa rnams ji ltar rnyed pa bzhin bris pa la/ mdo sde sna tshogs las btus pa'i gsung rab rin po che'i gtam zhes bya ba/ lotstsha ba chen po dpal brtsegs kyis mdzad pa/ chos kyi rnam grangs kyi brjed byang chen mo dpal brtsegs kyis mdzad pa/ lta ba'i rim pa'i man ngag dpal brtsegs kyis mdzad pa/ sems kyi nyams len mdor bsdus nas brjod pa/ lhag mthong bskyed pa'i thabs/ 'di gnyis la mdzad byang mi snang*/

sher snying gi 'grel pa lotstsha ba bai ro tsa nas mdzad pa/ bod rje 'bangs la brdzangs pa lotstsha ba dpal dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ bzang spyod kyi 'grel pa gzhi sbyor ma lotstsha ba chen po ye shes sdes mdzad pa rnams so// de nas sbyin bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba dang*/ bkra shis pa'i ched du de dag gi tshigs su bcad pa rnams bris pa la/ gtam bya rin chen phreng ba las btus pa'i smon lam nyi shu pa byang chub 'byung ba'i smon lam klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ smon lam bdun cu pa slob dpon gzhan la phan pa'i dbyangs dgon pa bas mdzad pa dpal gyi lhun po'i 'gyur/ btsun pa zla ba'i smon lam nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rgyal ba'i lam 'jug las 'byung ba'i smon lam buddha shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ rigs kyi smon lam mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ spyod 'jug bsngo ba'i le'u/ btsun pa rta dbyangs kyi bsngo ba dā na shī la'i 'gyur/ bod kyi mkhan po bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyis mdzad pa'i bsngo ba chen mo rnams so// dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i bkra shis mtshan mang du grags pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas rab bdun kyi bkra shis/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis rigs mi 'dra ba gsum/ rigs gsum mgon po'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rnams bzhugs so// de ltar bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mdo'i phyogs kyi dgongs 'grel/ 'phags pa'i yul nas gangs can gyi khrod du snga phyi ji snyed gcig 'gyur ba de snyed thams cad phyogs gcig tu glegs bam tu bsdebs pa bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog 'di/ dad pa dang shes rab dang bsod nams kyi dpal gyis mngon par mtho zhing*/ gcig tu dge ba la thugs gzhol ba rgyal ba'i sras kyi rnam thar lhur len pa/ drung chen a mgon bzang pos sbyin pa rnam bzhi rdzogs par yongs su tshang ba'i tshul gyis legs par bsgrubs shing*/

rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rnam par dag pas mthar phyin par grub pa'o// //rmad byung dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan// ma lus blo yi gcig tu rab bsdus nas// ma gyur 'gro bas byang chub thob slad du// bla med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /gnas skabs kun du bstan pa'i dpal gyur pa// grags dang bsod nams dge bas mngon mtho ba// sbyin bdag sku mched sras dang btsun mor bcas// slad nas 'byon 'gyur zhal ngo thams cad kun// sku tshe lhun po lta bur cher brtan zhing*// dpal 'byor rgya mtsho bzhin du ngang gis 'du// snyan grags nyi zla lta bur cher gsal bas// rgyal srid 'dzin ma'i khyon ltar rgyas gyur cig /mthun pa'i grogs byed rnams dang zhal ta ba// zhus dag mkhan dang yi ge pa la sogs// dge ba'i phyogs 'dir zhugs pa ji snyed pa// de snyed thams cad sangs rgyas sar 'gro shog /sangs rgyas bkra shis sku gsum dpal gyis mthong*// dam chos bkra shis bden gnyis yon tan ldan// dge 'dun bkra shis bslab gsum yon tan 'byor// skyabs gsum dam pas bkra shis deng 'dir shog /theg pa chen po mdo yi phyogs kyi bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi dkar chag 'di ni/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos rab byung gi lo smal po zla ba'i yar tshes bco lnga la/ glo bo'i sa yi cha dpal brag dkar theg chen gling gi gtsug lag khang chen por bris pa'o// 'dis dam pa'i chos phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/ //

༄// rje btsun sa skya pa'i bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ rje btsun sa skya pa 'gran zla dang bral ba'i grub chen gsum gyi gsung rab rin po che rnams kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs gsal bar bshad pa dkar chag rin po che'i lde mig zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// brtse chen gang gis 'gro kun dga' ba'i dam chos snying po mchog brnyes pas// phun tshogs bsod nams mkhyen pa'i rtse mor legs bshad 'od stong rab rgyas shing*// grags pa'i 'od dkar phyogs bcur gsal bas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin pa// skye dgu'i 'dren pa sa skya par grags rgyal ba gnyis pa rnams la 'dud// gang gi gsung rab nyin mor byed pa yis// bstan pa padmo'i tshal brgya kha 'byed cing*// nyes bshad mun pa'i drwa ba mthar mdzad pa// legs bshad rin chen phung po'i glegs bam rnams// lhag bsam dag pas ji ltar 'bri tshul dang*// grangs dang go rim sde tshan la sogs pa// yin lugs ji bzhin bsgrubs pa'i dkar chag rnams// legs par bshad kyis don gnyer dga' bas nyon// 'dir g.yeng ba med par rtse gcig tu bsgrubs pa'i brtul zhugs kyis rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang*/ dpal stobs kyi mgon pos byin gyis brlabs pas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag la bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen rab dang*/ rnam par dag pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po dang*/ de nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo sku tshe dpag tu med par gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta bar ma chad par gyur pas/ sku tshe 'dir rtsod pa dang bral ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rab 'byams pa blo gros phyogs med du rgyas pa/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo dang*/ yang srid bdun du 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis byin gyis brlabs pas rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob cing*/

gzungs dang*/ mngon par shes pa dang*/ mthu stobs la sogs pa yon tan rin po che du ma la dbang 'byor pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mkhas pa chen po rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan te/ de ltar khams gsum gyi bla ma dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bla ma gong ma gsum zhes/ sa'i steng rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas kyi bar du mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dbang phyug tu rnam par grags pa zhig go /grub pa'i dbang phyug slob dpon 'di gsum gyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab rin po che rnams ni/ ma rtogs pa dang*/ log par rtog pa dang*/ the tshom gyi dri ma mtha' dag dang bral zhing bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi don ji ltar yin pa bzhin gsal bar ston pa/ skal ldan gyi skyes bu byang chub tu bgrod pa'i man ngag rin po che kho na yin pas bdag legs su 'dod pa'i skyes bu blo gros can rnams kyis 'di dag 'bri ba dang*/ nyan pa dang*/ 'chad pa dang*/ don bsgom pa la brtson par bya bar rigs pa yin no// de'i phyir blo gros dang brtson 'grus dang dad pa phun sum tshogs pas rgyal ba'i gsung rab spyi dang*/ bye brag tu rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la legs par sbyangs shing*/ tshul khrims dang bsgrubs pa'i nor gyis rgyud phyug pa bla ma kun dga' gzhon nus dad pa chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ bstan pa rin po che rgyas par bya ba'i ched du/ la ba lha khang steng gi gtsug lag khang nas 'bul ba dang zang zing gi longs spyod gya nom pa dang bcas te/ rang gi tsha bo dad pa dang tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i bshes gnyen gzhon nu bzang po zhes bya ba dam pa'i chos kyi ched du dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen por brdzangs te/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang slob dpon du gyur pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la longs spyod kyi mchod pa rab tu mang po phul zhing*/

bye brag tu gsung rab rin po che 'di rnams me pho rta'i lo 'phags pa'i yul na zil gnon gyi lo zhes grags pa'i dbyar zla gsum dang*/ ston zla gong ma gnyis la legs par bsgrubs shing zhus dag byas pa yin no// de la thog mar re zhig ka pa la/ rje sa skya pa chen po'i gsung rab rnams bzhugs pa la/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag brtag gnyis kyi sa bcad/ brtag gnyis kyi tshig 'grel/ gur gyi tho yig gur gyi bshad pa'i chings/ rdo rje'i glu'i bshad pa/ rtsa yi mngon rtogs kyi bshad pa'i dka' 'grel/ rdo rje snying 'grel gyi yig sna/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi sa bcad/ slob dpon mtsho skyes kyi lo rgyus/ bdag med ma'i byin brlab 'di rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa yin kyang*/ ma dpe la 'dir shor ba ltar bris 'dug go /mtsho skyes kyi bshad pa tshigs bcad ma/ gur gyi rgyud kyi zin bris/ gur gyi dbang gi bshad pa/ rgyud kyi dka' gnas bshad pa/ sambu ṭa'i rgyud kyi dga' 'grel/ rdzogs rim gyi man ngag rgyud phyi ma'i bshad pa gnyis/ sambu ṭa'i rdor dbyings kyi dkyil chog kye rdo rje'i gdan gyi rnam dag sngon 'byung gi rnam 'phrul/ ḍombi he ru kas mdzad pa'i de nyid bcu pa'i dka' 'grel/ kag chol gyi sgrub thabs/ rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi le 'grel/ sa bcad/ dka' 'grel/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dkyil chog gi yig sna/ 'di the tshom can yin gsung*/ nag po gzhung drug gi ṭī ka dang man ngag nag 'bum du grags pa la/ slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje'i lo rgyus/ gzhung drug spyi'i rnam gzhag dkyil chog sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba/ o la pa ti/ dpyid thig rnams kyi sa bcad re re/ ras bris la brten pa'i dkyil chog mngon rtogs kyi gsal byed/ sbyin sreg gi ṭī ka de'i lag len/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba'i ṭī ka

o la pa ti'i rnam bshad/ o la pa ti'i man ngag dpyid thig gi ṭī ka rnams so// 'jigs byed rtog bdun kyi ṭī ka sgrol ma bcu bdun ma'am/ bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog man ngag gces bsdus su grags pa la/ birwa pa'i sgrub thabs sogs man ngag gi rnam grangs bzhi bcu zhe drug phyogs gcig tu bris pa/ gur gyi khro bcu'i gdams ngag bha ya na'i gdams ngag bla ma skyu ra a skyabs la zhu yig bum gter gzhug tshul gyi man ngag rnams bzhugs so// kha pa la/ slob dpon rin po che'i gsung rab bzhugs pa la/ rje sa skya pa chen po la bstod pa/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rgya sgom tshul khrims grags pa la spring yig slob dpon phywa pa la bstod pa/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag chos rje pas zhus dag mdzad pa/ brtag gnyis kyi sa bcad/ rgyud kyi rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer/ sambu ṭa'i rgyud kyi sa bcad/ sambu ṭa'i ṭī ka gnad kyi gsal byed/ gnyis pa'i rab byed/ gnyis pa'i ṭī ka sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi ṭī ka nas gling ma'i lugs kyi kye rdo rje'i dbang chog ḍombi he ru ka'i lugs kyi kye rdo rje'i dbang chog bzang po yongs bzung gi rab gnas dang*/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i ṭī ka rnams bzhugs so// ga pa la/ kye rdo rje'i man ngag lugs kyi mngon rtogs rgyas pa/ dbang gi chu bo/ rab gnas bzang drug zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bdag med ma'i dbang gi tho yig bde mchog dril bu pa'i sgrub thabs/ dril bu pa'i dbang gi bya ba'i ṭī ka lo nag gi mchod phreng*/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rtog pa'i ṭī ka dang sa bcad/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub skor/ don yod zhags pa'i lo rgyus/ don zhags rgyud chung gi sa bcad/ lha lnga'i bstod pa/ don yod zhags pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa/ rdo rje gdan pa'i man ngag chos drug mi g.yo ba sngon po'i chos skor gdams ngag dang bcas pa/ de la nye bar mkho ba'i srung 'khor gyi rgya gzhung yang zhor la bris so// gtor chen gyi cho ga

spyod 'jug gi ṭī ka chos la 'jug pa'i sgo/ byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa rnams bzhugs shing*/ pusti kha long pa'i ched du bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi ṭī ka mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla chen mal dang*/ rje sa chen gnyis kar gyi slob ma rje btsun sku mched gnyis kar gyi slob dpon bla ma gnyan phul chung bas mdzad pa yang bzhugs so// nga pa la/ rje btsun rin po che'i gsung rab bzhugs pa la/ lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rje sa chen gyi rnam thar/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i ṭī ka tshar gsum khugs pa'i man ngag brtag gnyis kyi rnam bshad dag ldan/ rgyud gsum gyi mngon rtogs rin po che'i ljon shing stong thun sa bcad/ rgyud sde'i dum bu/ rdo rje gur gyi sa bcad/ 'grel pa gur gyi rgyan/ gur gyi thig gi cho ga kye rdo rje'i mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ bdag med ma'i mngon rtogs/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams par bskur ba/ tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rdo rje dril bu dang*/ bgrang phreng gi de nyid/ rga ston rdo rje grags pa la gdams pa/ rgyud 'bum gyi dkar chag bla ma gong ma'i chos skor gyi dkar chag kye rdo rje'i chos skor gyi dkar chag dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga rin chen 'bar ba'i sa bcad/ dus tha ma'i cho ga gzhan phan bdud rtsi/ kye rdo rje'i bstod pa daṇḍa ka bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i bstod pa/ kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis rnams bzhugs so// ca pa la/ he ru ka'i byung tshul/ bde mchog lo hi pa'i mngon rtogs/ bde mchog lo hi pa'i dkyil chog gi sa bcad/ 'khrugs can dang 'khrugs med gnyis/ nag po pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ sbyin sreg la sa bcad re re/ nag po pa'i dkyil chog gi 'grel pa/ dkyil chog lag tu blang ba'i rim pa/ dril bu pa'i lo rgyus/ dril bu pa'i sgrub thabs/ rim lnga'i ṭī ka

tshes bcu'i mchod pa bya tshul/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ sngags kyi de nyid kyi byin rlabs zhes bya ba'i rdzogs rim/ las bcu'i gsal byed/ mai tri mkha' spyod kyi rgyud kyi dum bu/ sgrub thabs gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rjes gnang gi cho ga rgyal ba'i sdes mdzad pa/ 'di gsum rje btsun gyis mdzad pa min kyang phyogs gcig bsgrigs mkhan dang*/ mchan dang zin bris phreng re ba 'di rnams mdzad pa yin pas 'dir bris so// na ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ phyi mchod mdor bsdus gsal byed/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ tshogs 'khor/ sbyin sreg mar me'i sbyin sreg pra phab pa/ gnod sbyin mo sgrub pa'i man ngag sman chen po'i bcud len/ 'di sa chen gyi yin pas gong du 'bri rgyu yin na'ang*/ phag mo skor gsum gyi gdams ngag phyogs gcig tu bya ba'i phyir snga ma rnams kyis 'dir bris pa bzhin bzhag go /rtsa dbu ma'i khrid yig nges brjod bla ma'i 'khor lo bri ba'i gdams ngag rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi rgyud kyi don bsdus/ ṭī ka ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs/ tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs/ dgra nag gi mngon rtogs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i gdams ngag sgrol ma zhi khro'i sgrub thabs/ bstod pa 'don thabs las kha tshar ba dang bcas pa/ nā ro pa'i gdams ngag sgrol ma spyi'i sgrub thabs/ so so'i sgrub thabs/ bstod pa 'don thabs kyi brjed byang*/ phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgrub thabs kyi ṭī ka de'i sa bcad/ sgrol ma lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs mchims chos seng gi don du mdzad pa/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sa bcad/ de'i ṭī ka gsal ba'i 'od zer/ 'di rje btsun gyis sgrol ma la mchan mdzad pa de gang zag rjes ma gcig gis mtshan dkyus su bcug par snang ngo*// sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/ sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi'i gsol 'debs/

rje btsun nyid kyi rnal lam ji ltar byung tshul/ 'di khams pa sbal ston gyis bris pa yin kyang*/ rje btsun gyi gsung ji lta ba bzhin yin pas 'dir bris 'dug go /nang gi lhung bzed brtag pa/ 'di rje btsun gyi gsung bzhin nā ro'i bande bshes gnyen pas byas pa'i zin bris yin kyang 'dir bris 'dug go /ga rings rgyal po la rtsis bsdur du bskur ba/ he ru ka'i chas drug gi bshad pa/ rtsa ltung gi 'grel pa 'khrul pa spong ba/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa la gzhung dgu bcu go drug yod pa'i ṭīka chung re re/ spyi'i rnam gzhag gcig sa bcad re re dang bcas pa la sgrub thabs bsdus pa'i yig sna zhes grags pa rnams bzhugs so// cha pa la/ ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi spyi don/ sbyong rgyud kyi sa bcad/ rdo rje 'byung ba'i ṭī ka kun rig gi cho ga gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/ cho ga bsdus pa gzhan phan nyer mkho/ arga'i cho ga rab gnas don gsal/ rigs gsum spyi'i dkyil chog go /dpa' bo gcig tu bsgrub pa'i rgyud kyi ṭī ka mi g.yo ba sngon po'i bstod pa 'thad ldan/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa rgyud gsum gyi 'khor lo/ mtshan brjod 'don thabs/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma/ 'di sngon gyi dpe rnying zhig la rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos mdzad bya ba snang ste de dag pa yin no// a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ 'di sidha shrī zer ba gcig gis byas par snang kyang*/ ma dpe na bris pa bzhin 'dir shor ba yin no// a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dkyil chog don yod zhags pa'i cho ga maṇḍal gyi cho ga bstod pa/ srung 'khor bri tshul/ lag na rdo rje'i gzungs kyi man ngag rnam 'joms kyi rgyud kyi ṭī ka sa bcad/ dpung bzang gi rgyud kyi ṭī ka nam mkha' lding gi gdams ngag mi g.yo ba gsang rgyud le'u bzhi pa'i gdams ngag gtor chen don lnga'i cho ga 'di rje btsun rtse mo'i gtor chen dang mi mthun pas min pa 'dra na'ang snga ma rnams kyi bris pa bzhin bzhag go

/gtor ma brgya rtsa gtang tshul/ shākya'i rgyal rabs/ bod kyi rgyal rabs rgya bod kyi dge 'dun gyi gyes mdo/ dus tshod bzung ba'i rtsis yig gza' skar 'phrod mi 'phrod brtag pa/ zhes dgu phrugs kyi yi ge phyag rgya chen po gces bsdus zhes bya ba/ bla ma so so'i gdams ngag zab mo rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa la phyag rgya chen po gnyis med/ 'od gsal la sogs gdams ngag sum cu tham pa/ chos spyod rin chen phreng ba/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i rnam bshad/ spyod 'jug gi sa bcad/ ye shes rdo rje la gdams pa'i nyams dbyangs/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi man ngag khams bde 'dri ba'i don gyi nyams dbyangs/ sa skya'i gnas la bstod pa'i nyams dbyangs/ rmi lam nyams len brgyad kyi nyams dbyangs/ gnyen po bsten tshul gyi nyams dbyangs/ sems 'dul tshul gyi nyams dbyangs/ bsgrub pa nyams su len tshul/ gsang sngags nang gi nyams len/ rang la rang gis bskul ba/ nyams dbyangs chen mo/ 'di gling ras kyi zur za chen mo la bcos nas gzhan zhig gi byas pa yin nam/ zhes bdag gi bla ma gsung ngo*// sman dpyad rgyal po'i dkor mdzod ces grags pa'i sman dpyad kyi gdams ngag chen mo 'di sman yan lag brgyad pa'i man ngag 'phags pa klu sgrub nas lotstsha ba rin chen bzang po'i bar rim par brgyud de/ bla ma mal lotstsha ba chen po las byung ba'i gdams ngag rnams rje sa chen/ rje btsun chen po/ bla ma dpal chen 'od po rnams kyi gdams ngag thor bur mdzad pa rnams/ phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa yin pas/ dang po 'du ba spyi'i rnam gzhag nas/ mthar mgo bcos kyi man ngag gi bar la sman dpyad/ thor dpyad/ rten 'brel gyi gdams ngag rab tu mang po zhig bzhugs so// phun tshogs dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen 'di// mkhas kun dga' ba'i blo gros bzang po can// rgyal sras gzhon nu'i spyod pa rjes bsgrubs pa// gsang sngags 'dzin pa de yis bskul ba yin// bstan pa rgyas dang gsung rab spel phyir dang*// rab 'byams tshogs gnyis rnam par rgyas phyir du// dad can blo ldan gzhon nu bzang pos kyang*// dge ba'i bsam pas legs par bskul ba yin// 'dir 'bad dge ba 'od stong bdag po des// thub bstan gling bzhi phyogs kun gsal ba dang*// sbyin bdag sgrib pa'i mun pa zhi ba dang*// kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po thob phyir bsngo// gnas skabs kun du sbyin bdag 'khor bcas rnams// tshe ring nad med dam chos 'phel ba dang*// tshul khrims dag cing 'byor pa rgyas pa sogs// ci bsam don kun chos bzhin 'grub par shog

/bla ma'i bkra shis dngos grub kun stsol zhing*// mchog gsum bkra shis mkhyen brtse phun sum tshogs// chos skyong bkra shis mthu stobs dpag med pa// gsum gyi bkra shis dam pas dge legs shog/ //dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
